  • Applicants must submit documentary evidence/certificates to support the quality of work, including details of visual assignments, specialization areas and other relevant credentials.
  • Applicants should have adequate facilities and equipment including cameras, audio equipment, lights and preferably ENG equipment as specified in the application form and guidelines.

Salary/Stipend

  • Stringers will be paid Rs. 1,500/- per local coverage of duration less than 6 hours, inclusive of transportation and delivery charges.
  • If the duration of local coverage exceeds 6 hours or involves locations apart by more than 10 kms, it will be treated as two coverages and the second coverage will be paid at Rs. 1,000/-.
  • For outstation coverage undertaken beyond the geographical limits of the District headquarters where the Stringer is empanelled, the Stringer’s fee will be Rs. 1,800/- per coverage, inclusive of transportation and delivery charges.

  • Applications will be scrutinised and eligibility of candidates will be assessed based on qualification, experience, equipment, technical facilities, credibility etc. as per the Assessment Scale in the guidelines.
  • Shortlisted applicants will be asked to provide test coverages using their own equipment and raw material to ascertain the quality of their work.
  • Applicants will have to undergo interview and verification of equipment and documents, including physical verification of equipment by the Empanelment Committee or Technical Committee.
  • A test coverage assignment will be given to all applicants for submission to RNU before their interview date; submission on time is essential for being called for interview.
  • The final panel of Stringers will be drawn by the Committee based on assessment scale, interview and quality of test coverages, and names of selected Stringers will be published and informed in writing.
  • Stringers will be removed from the panel for reasons such as refusal to cover assignments, poor content or technical quality, delay in coverage, subcontracting work, cartel operations, incorrect information or any act causing embarrassment to Prasar Bharati.

General Information/Instructions

  • The Regional News Unit, Doordarshan Kendra, Vijayawada invites applications for Empanelment as Stringers from individuals with experience in news coverages for districts of Andhra Pradesh listed in the notification.
  • Applicants should mention in the application form the name of the district where they wish to be empanelled and must be based in that district.
  • The key person for operation of stringership must be clearly mentioned and he/she must be working in the applied district and must continue to be in the same district once selected.
  • Empanelled Stringers are expected to cover news and short features on news, current affairs, sports, business and other subjects and also alert RNU on major news or breaking stories.
  • Applications should be submitted in sealed cover with superscription “Empanelment of Stringers of DD News-2026” on or before the last date of submission.
  • Proof in duplicate of Academic and Technical Qualifications, Experience and Equipment ownership must be submitted along with the application in the model form provided in the notification.
  • Separate annexures can be given along with the application detailing experience or qualification of the applicant and team, if required.
  • For any clarification, candidates may write to the RNU Email ID – [email protected] as mentioned in the notification.
  • The panel of Stringers shall be revised every two years and existing Stringers will also go through the processes as per revised guidelines.

How to Apply

  • Provide details such as district headquarters for empanelment, personal particulars, academic qualifications, technical qualifications, experience, equipment and facilities, and corporate status as required in the form.
  • Enclose attested copies of certificates supporting qualifications, experience, equipment ownership and other information furnished in the application.
  • Attach a Demand Draft of Rs. 1,180/- (inclusive of GST) towards non refundable processing fee in favour of “DDO/ DDK, Vijayawada” payable at Vijayawada.
  • Submit the completed application in triplicate in a sealed cover with superscription “Empanelment of Stringers of DD News-2026”.
  • Send the application to: The Head of News, Regional News Unit, Doordarshan Kendra, Punnamathota, Opp; TTD Kalyanamadapam, Vijayawada – 520010, Andhra Pradesh, on or before 20 February 2026 till 5 PM.

Vacancy Details & Eligibility Criteria

Post Name / Area Total Posts Eligibility Criteria
Para Legal Volunteer – Samastipur 50 Indian citizen (male/female/third gender), Matric (10th pass), resident of Samastipur district, interested in voluntary social service and legal awareness; persons like teachers (including retired), retired government servants, senior citizens, Anganwadi workers, doctors, students, NGO/club members, SHG members, Jeevika/mitra group members and other individuals (except advocates) may apply.

Reservation: As this is a voluntary, non-salaried position and not a government job recruitment, no reservation roster is applied to the posts; however, adequate representation will be given to all sections of society as per the scheme, and the panel will be valid for one year.

Educational Qualification

  • Minimum educational qualification: Matric (10th pass).
  • Preference to candidates actively engaged in social service, legal awareness, community activities, SHGs, NGOs, etc.
  • Advocates are not eligible to apply for PLV positions.
  • Previously selected Para Legal Volunteers may also apply again.

Roles and Responsibilities of Para Legal Volunteers

  • To create legal awareness in their area and work as a bridge between victims in need of legal aid and the District Legal Services Authority.
  • To assist in legal aid work at the DLSA office and Legal Aid Centres as and when directed.
  • To participate actively in legal awareness camps and outreach programmes organized by DLSA.
  • To perform any other legal services work assigned by the District Legal Services Authority under NALSA PLV Scheme.

Honorarium & Allowances

Daily Honorarium Rs. 750/- per day under NALSA PLV Scheme (PLV) for those specific days on which DLSA assigns special work or when the PLV brings a person from the village for legal aid / ADR centre or actively participates in legal awareness camps.

  • Preparation of shortlist/panel on the basis of eligibility, local residence, social service interest and other criteria fixed by DLSA.
  • Issue of interview call letter (interview letter format is enclosed in the notification) to shortlisted candidates.
  • Interview and interaction at DLSA Samastipur for final selection.
  • Preparation of final panel of PLVs; panel period will be valid for one year.

How to Apply for Samastipur DLSA Para Legal Volunteer Recruitment 2026

  1. Download or obtain the prescribed application form for Para Legal Volunteer (PLV) as annexed with the advertisement.
  2. Fill the application form completely in Hindi/English, providing all required personal, educational and contact details.
  3. Attach self-attested copies of educational certificates (Matric), other qualification/experience certificates, and a clear photocopy of Aadhaar card.
  4. Attach a declaration/affidavit stating that no criminal or civil case is pending against you and you have not been convicted by any court.
  5. Affix a self-attested passport size photograph at the designated place on the application form.
  6. Place the application form and enclosures in an envelope, write your complete address on a self-addressed envelope with adequate registered postage stamps for correspondence.
  7. Send the application by Registered Post/Speed Post/Ordinary Post or submit by hand to the office of the Secretary, District Legal Services Authority, Samastipur, so that it reaches on or before 09 March 2026 up to 5:30 PM.
  8. Applications received after the last date or found incomplete/incorrect are liable to be rejected without any information.
  9. Mention your mobile/WhatsApp number clearly in the application form for communication regarding interview, etc.

Important Instructions

  • The applicant must be an Indian citizen and a resident of Samastipur district.
  • The applicant should be physically and mentally healthy, of good character and interested in social service.
  • No candidate should have been convicted by any court, and no criminal or civil case should be pending against them; a declaration/affidavit to this effect must be attached.
  • Applications received after 09 March 2026 (5:30 PM) will not be accepted under any circumstances.

Application fee must be paid online only while filling the form, and is non-refundable. Candidates should retain proof of successful payment for document verification.

Reservation & PwBD Details

  • Reservation for EWS/OBC-NCL/SC/ST as per Central Government rules.
  • 4% horizontal reservation for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBDs).
  • Physical requirements: S, ST, BN, MF, W, SE, RW, H, C.
  • Suitable categories: OA (One arm), OL (One leg).

OBC-NCL candidates must have a valid non-creamy layer certificate for Central Govt. posts, issued not earlier than one year from the last date of application.

EWS candidates must have a valid EWS certificate for Central Govt. posts, issued within one year from the last date of application.

AIIMS Patna JR Selection Process & Exam Pattern

  • Selection through Written Test (MCQ-based) only.
  • Total questions: 100 MCQs, 1 mark each, no negative marking.
  • Exam duration: 1 hour 30 minutes.

Qualifying marks:

  • UR: 50%
  • OBC-NCL / EWS: 45%
  • SC/ST: 40%

Final selection list will be prepared solely on written examination marks; in case of tie, older candidate (earlier date of birth) is ranked higher.

Tenure & Terms of Appointment

  • Initial appointment: 06 months.
  • May be extended once for another 06 months based on HOD recommendation and Executive Director approval.
  • Maximum total tenure as Junior Resident (Non-Academic) at AIIMS Patna: 12 months; no further extension beyond this.

How to Apply Online for AIIMS Patna JR Recruitment 2026

  1. Keep prerequisites ready: Valid email ID, mobile number, Aadhaar, scanned passport-size photo (JPG), scanned signature (JPG), and online payment details.
  2. Visit official website: Go to www.aiimspatna.edu.in and click on the Junior Resident (Non-Academic) Recruitment 2026 application link.
  3. Register and login: Complete registration to get User ID and Password via email, then log in to fill the online application.
  4. Fill application form: Enter personal, academic, category, and contact details carefully and select the correct options.
  5. Upload documents: Upload photo, signature, and required documents (DOB proof, MBBS degree, internship, registration, category/PwBD, experience, NOC, research/publications, etc.) in prescribed formats and sizes.
  6. Pay application fee: Proceed to online payment via Internet Banking or Debit/Credit Card, noting the Payment Reference Number after successful transaction.
  7. Submit & print form: Submit the application, then download and print the registered application form for records and document verification.

Important: After final submission, no changes are allowed in crucial fields like name, category, department, and PwBD status; incomplete forms, incorrect uploads, or unpaid fees may lead to rejection.

Selection Process for RRB Group D CEN 09/2025

The recruitment consists of 4 successive stages:

Stage 1: Computer Based Test (CBT)

Duration: 90 minutes (120 minutes for candidates using scribe)

Total Questions: 100 (Each of 1 mark)

Subject Number of Questions
General Science 25
Mathematics 25
General Intelligence and Reasoning 30
General Awareness and Current Affairs 20
TOTAL 100 Questions = 100 Marks

Exam Pattern:

  • Objective type with multiple choices
  • Questions available in English, Hindi, and 13 regional languages (Assamese, Bengali, Gujarati, Kannada, Konkani, Malayalam, Manipuri, Marathi, Odia, Punjabi, Tamil, Telugu, Urdu)
  • Negative Marking: 1/3 mark deducted for each wrong answer
  • Section-wise distribution may vary slightly in actual exam

Minimum Qualifying Marks:

  • UR: 40%
  • EWS: 40%
  • OBC-NCL: 30%
  • SC: 30%
  • ST: 30%
  • PwBD: May be relaxed by 2 marks in case of shortage

Syllabus (Indicative):

  • Mathematics: Number system, BODMAS, Decimals, Fractions, LCM, HCF, Ratio & Proportion, Percentages, Mensuration, Time & Work, Time & Distance, Simple & Compound Interest, Profit & Loss, Algebra, Geometry, Trigonometry, Elementary Statistics, Square root, Age Calculations, Calendar & Clock, Pipes & Cistern
  • General Intelligence & Reasoning: Analogies, Alphabetical & Number Series, Coding & Decoding, Mathematical operations, Relationships, Syllogism, Jumbling, Venn Diagram, Data Interpretation & Sufficiency, Conclusions & Decision making, Similarities & Differences, Analytical Reasoning, Classification, Directions, Statement-Arguments & Assumptions
  • General Science: Physics, Chemistry, Life Sciences of 10th standard level (CBSE)
  • General Awareness & Current Affairs: Science & Technology, Sports, Culture, Personalities, Economics, Politics, and other important subjects

Normalization: Marks will be normalized if CBT conducted in multiple sessions

Stage 2: Physical Efficiency Test (PET)

Shortlisting: 3 times the total vacancies (may vary) based on CBT merit

Nature: Qualifying (Mandatory to pass - marks not counted for final merit)

Candidate Type Test 1: Weight Carrying Test 2: Running
Male Candidates Lift and carry 35 kg weight for 100 meters in 2 minutes (in one chance, without putting down) Run 1000 meters in 4 minutes 15 seconds (in one chance)
Female Candidates Lift and carry 20 kg weight for 100 meters in 2 minutes (in one chance, without putting down) Run 1000 meters in 5 minutes 40 seconds (in one chance)
Transgender Candidates Same relaxed standards as Female candidates

Important PET Notes:

  • Two-stage test: First weight carrying, then running (after recovery gap)
  • Failing in weight carrying means elimination (no running test)
  • Weight carrying involves lifting sandbag (without handle) from waist-height bench and carrying without dropping
  • Candidates' responsibility to ensure medical fitness for PET - Railways not responsible for injuries
  • Exemptions from PET:
    • Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) - must pass medical examination
    • Course Completed Act Apprentices (CCAA)
    • Ex-Servicemen (ExSM)
  • Pregnant Candidates: Must submit self-declaration. If pregnant, PET deferred till 6 weeks post-confinement. Vacancy kept reserved.

Stage 3: Document Verification (DV)

  • Shortlisting: 1:1 ratio of vacancies based on CBT merit + PET qualification
  • Candidates must produce original certificates
  • No additional time given - absence leads to candidature cancellation
  • Scanned copies to be uploaded before DV at https://oirms-ir.gov.in/rrbdv
  • Certificates must be in English/Hindi (translated version required otherwise)
  • Hard copy of signed application form to be brought

Stage 4: Medical Examination (ME)

  • Conducted by Railway Medical Authorities
  • Must pass requisite medical fitness test as per IRMM
  • Visual acuity standards strictly enforced
  • Medical appeal option available (one final opportunity on payment)
  • Candidates found medically unsuitable will NOT be given alternative appointment

Final Merit & Selection

  • Based on CBT marks (after normalization if applicable)
  • Subject to PET qualification, DV clearance, and medical fitness
  • Post/Railway allotment as per candidate's preference, merit, medical fitness, and vacancy
  • In case of tie: Older candidate ranked higher; if age also same, alphabetical order of name (A to Z)
  • No right to appointment - RRB/RRC only recommends; appointment by Railway Administration

Desirable Qualification

  • Knowledge of Hindi, Punjabi, and English

Age Limit (as on closing date 02.03.2026)

  • General Category: 18-25 years
  • OBC Category: 18-28 years (3 years age relaxation)

Physical Fitness & Health

  • Must have sound health both mentally and physically
  • Free from organic defect or bodily infirmity that could interfere with duty performance
  • Weight must be proportionate to height as per medical standards
  • Weight and height will be checked during medical examination

Trade Proficiency Requirements

  • Ability to operate both automatic and manual (foot/hand driven) sewing machines
  • Knowledge of fabric types and human body shapes
  • Knowledge of sewing equipment and tailoring techniques

Selection Process

Step 1: Written Test (50 marks)

  • 100 Multiple Choice type questions (MCQ)
  • Each correct answer: 0.5 marks
  • Negative marking: 0.25 marks deducted for incorrect answer
  • Question level: Class 10th standard
  • Total marks: 50
  • Subjects covered: Cutting & Tailoring/Sewing Technology, Elementary Arithmetic, General English, Logical Reasoning/Mental Ability, General Awareness/Knowledge and Current Affairs
  • Medium: English, Hindi, Punjabi

Step 2: Trade Proficiency Test (TPT) (50 marks)

  • Practical examination by expert panel
  • Assessment of tailoring skills and sewing machine operation
  • Candidates called: 4 times the number of posts in each category (merit-based)
  • If multiple candidates score same marks, all will be called for TPT
  • Total marks: 50

Final Merit List

  • Based on combined marks: Written Test (50) + TPT (50) = Total 100
  • In case of tie: Older candidate gets higher rank
  • If same age and marks: Ranked by marks percentage

  17. Keep printed copy of submitted form and fee receipt

Eligibility Criteria

  • For Lower Division Clerk (LDC) - Post Code 2/26:
    • Class XII pass certificate from a recognized Board or Institution
    • Typing Speed test of 35 words per minute on computer (35 words per minute corresponds to 10500 Key Depression per hour - KDPH on an average of 5 Key Depression for each word)
  • For Junior Secretariat Assistant (JSA) - Post Code 3/26:
    • Class XII pass certificate from a recognized Board or Institution
    • Typing Speed test of 35 words per minute on computer (35 words per minute corresponds to 10500 Key Depression per hour - KDPH on an average of 5 Key Depression for each word)
  • For Driver - Post Code 4/26:
    • Class X/ITI or equivalent pass certificate from a recognized Board or Institution
  • Minimum Qualifying Service for LDC & JSA:
    • Multi-Tasking Staff (MTS) of the concerned Department with 8 (Eight) years of regular service in the grade, and possessing Class-XII pass certificate from a recognized Board/Institution, OR
    • Skilled Contingency Staff with minimum of 12 (Twelve) years of continuous service as skilled contingency in the concerned Department/office and possess educational qualification of Class-XII pass certificate from a recognized Board/Institution
  • Minimum Qualifying Service for Driver:
    • Contingency skilled driver who possess Class X/ITI or equivalent pass certificate from a recognized Board or Institution with 10 (Ten) years of service in the concerned Department/Office, OR
    • Handyman who possess Class X/ITI or equivalent pass Certificate from a recognized Board/Institution with 6 (Six) years of regular service in the concerned Department/Office
  • General Eligibility:
    • The candidate must be a citizen of India
    • The educational qualification, required length of service, age, category as stipulated shall be determined as on the closing date of submission of application i.e. 25-02-2026
    • The name of the candidate should be in the certified list of eligible candidates submitted by the HoD/HoO
    • Only those candidates who have been certified as eligible by their Head of Department are eligible to apply

Salary/Stipend

  • Pay Matrix Level: Level-4
  • Salary Range: Rs. 25,500 - Rs. 81,100 Per Month
  • This pay scale is applicable for all three posts: Lower Division Clerk (LDC), Junior Secretariat Assistant (JSA), and Driver

Age Limit (as on 25-02-2026)

  • For LDC (Post Code 2/26) & JSA (Post Code 3/26):
    • Multi-Tasking Staff (MTS): Should not be more than 45 years (50 years in case of candidates belonging to APST)
    • Skilled Contingency Staff: Not applicable (eligibility determined by the Departments)
  • For Driver (Post Code 4/26):
    • Not applicable (eligibility determined by the Departments)

Application Fee

Category Fee Amount
APST Candidates Rs. 150
General Candidates Rs. 200
Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) Nil (Exempt)
  • Payment Mode: Online only
  • The application fee is non-refundable

Important Dates

Event Date
Opening Date of Application 12/02/2026 (Thursday)
Closing Date of Application 25/02/2026 (03:00 PM) (Wednesday)
Tentative Date of Written Examination 29/03/2026 (Sunday)

Selection Process

  • For LDC (Post Code 2/26) & JSA (Post Code 3/26):
    • Stage-I (Written Examination): Objective Type Multiple Choice Questions - 200 Marks, Duration: 2 Hours
      • General Awareness: 50 marks (25 questions of 2 marks each)
      • General Intelligence & Reasoning Ability: 50 marks (25 questions of 2 marks each)
      • Arithmetical & Numerical Ability: 50 marks (25 questions of 2 marks each)
      • Test of English Language and Comprehension: 50 marks (25 questions of 2 marks each)
    • Minimum Qualifying Marks: 33% aggregate marks in the written examination paper
    • Stage-II (Skill Test): Typing Speed Test of 35 words per minute on computer (10500 KDPH). The Typing Test is of qualifying nature only and marks will not be counted for final merit
  • For Driver (Post Code 4/26):
    • Stage-I (Written Examination): Objective Type Multiple Choice Questions - 200 Marks, Duration: 2 Hours
      • General Awareness: 25 marks (10 questions of 2.5 marks each)
      • General Intelligence & Reasoning Ability: 25 marks (10 questions of 2.5 marks each)
      • Arithmetical & Numerical Ability: 25 marks (10 questions of 2.5 marks each)
      • Test of English Language and Comprehension: 25 marks (10 questions of 2.5 marks each)
      • Technical Paper: 100 marks (50 questions of 2 marks each)
    • Minimum Qualifying Marks: 33% aggregate in both the papers separately i.e., for Common Paper and Technical Paper
    • Stage-II (Driving Test): Qualifying nature only. Candidate shall produce a valid Driving License for appearing in the Driving Test
  • Shortlisting for Stage-2: The total number of candidates shortlisted for Stage 2 will be in 1:3 ratio (if total vacancies are 10, then 30 candidates will be shortlisted)
  • Final Merit List: Will be prepared on the basis of marks secured in written examination only. Marks in Skill Test/Driving Test will not be counted but candidates must qualify
  • Note: There is no negative marking in the examination

General Information/Instructions

  • Application Mode: Only online applications will be accepted. Applications received through any other mode shall be summarily rejected
  • Login Credentials: Login credentials will be sent to eligible candidates through e-mail & SMS to their respective e-mail addresses and mobile numbers furnished by their Departments/Offices
  • Eligibility Determination: APSSB will not entertain any representations from candidates with regards to eligibility and the same shall be determined solely by the concerned Head of Department/Office
  • Provisional Candidature: Candidature of applicants shall be purely PROVISIONAL at all stages of the recruitment process
  • Examination Centre: The Centre for the examination will be ITANAGAR
  • ID Proof Requirement: Candidate will have to provide a valid Aadhar Card/Government authorized Photo Identity Card. They will have to carry the same ID card in original along with the admit card to the Examination Centre
  • Prohibited Items: Use of Calculator, Laptop, Palmtop, other digital instrument/Mobile/Cell Phone/Pager/Electronic watches etc. is not allowed. Candidates found in possession of any such gadget will be debarred from examination
  • Admit Card: Individual Admit cards will not be sent to candidates and have to be downloaded from the website www.apssb.nic.in
  • Vacancy Status: The vacancies published are provisional and subject to change. In case the vacancy position is reduced or withdrawn by the user department, the Board shall not be liable to compensate the applicant
  • No Re-evaluation: There is no provision of re-evaluation/re-checking of Answer sheet/Answer scripts
  • Board's Rights: The Board reserves the right to reject candidature at any stage, cancel part or entire examination process, change examination scheme, conduct medical test for PwBD candidates, and make any amendments as deemed necessary
  • Scribe Facility for PwBD: Facility of scribe will be provided to eligible PwBD/PwD candidates as per Government guidelines. Compensatory time of 20 minutes per hour of examination will be provided to persons allowed use of scribe
  • Multiple Applications: In case an applicant applies multiple forms for the same post, only the latest application form shall be considered by APSSB
  • Malpractice Action: Candidates found involved in violating guidelines, impersonation, using unfair means, submitting fabricated documents etc. will face strict action including police action, FIR lodging and debarment from all future APSSB examinations
  • Final Selection: The Board makes provisional selection and recommends to the Indenting/User Department. The Appointing Authority verifies and satisfies about authenticity of documents before finally appointing the candidate

How to Apply

  • Eligible departmental candidates are required to apply online only through the website www.apssb.nic.in using their unique login credentials/passwords
  • Login credentials will be sent to eligible candidates' respective mobile numbers & e-mail IDs by their departments
  • Application period: 12-02-2026 to 25-02-2026 (03:00 PM)
  • Only those candidates who have been certified as eligible by their Head of Department are eligible to apply
  • Documents to be scanned and uploaded at time of online application:
    • Scanned signature of the candidate on white paper with black ink pen (10-50 kb in jpg/jpeg/png format)
    • Latest/recent passport size photo (50-100 kb in jpg/jpeg/png format)
  • Documents to be submitted during Document Verification:
    • Recent passport size Photograph (2 copies)
    • Matriculation certificates/II issued by the Board/Institute for proof of date of birth
    • Class XII pass certificate & marksheet issued from a recognized Board/University
    • APST Certificate (if applicable)
    • Valid Driving License (for Driver post)
    • Print out of Admit Card
    • Any other documents as may be relevant
  • Shortlisted candidates will have to produce above-mentioned Certificates/Documents in original during Document Verification failing which candidature will be summarily rejected
  • The applicants are advised to fill up the application form carefully. They will not be allowed to edit/modify the details after the closing date
  • Application with incomplete or invalid details will be summarily rejected
  • Candidates are advised to keep track of the Board website www.apssb.nic.in for any latest information related to the examination
  • No request for change in date, time and centre of exam will be accepted under any circumstances

  • A compensatory time of twenty minutes per hour or otherwise advised shall be permitted for the candidates with locomotor disability and cerebral palsy where dominant (writing) extremity is affected to the extent of slowing the performance of function (minimum of 40% impairment).

Selection Process for RRB Group D CEN 09/2025

The recruitment consists of 4 successive stages:

Stage 1: Computer Based Test (CBT)

Duration: 90 minutes (120 minutes for candidates using scribe)

Total Questions: 100 (Each of 1 mark)

Subject Number of Questions
General Science 25
Mathematics 25
General Intelligence and Reasoning 30
General Awareness and Current Affairs 20
TOTAL 100 Questions = 100 Marks

Exam Pattern:

  • Objective type with multiple choices
  • Questions available in English, Hindi, and 13 regional languages (Assamese, Bengali, Gujarati, Kannada, Konkani, Malayalam, Manipuri, Marathi, Odia, Punjabi, Tamil, Telugu, Urdu)
  • Negative Marking: 1/3 mark deducted for each wrong answer
  • Section-wise distribution may vary slightly in actual exam

Minimum Qualifying Marks:

  • UR: 40%
  • EWS: 40%
  • OBC-NCL: 30%
  • SC: 30%
  • ST: 30%
  • PwBD: May be relaxed by 2 marks in case of shortage

Syllabus (Indicative):

  • Mathematics: Number system, BODMAS, Decimals, Fractions, LCM, HCF, Ratio & Proportion, Percentages, Mensuration, Time & Work, Time & Distance, Simple & Compound Interest, Profit & Loss, Algebra, Geometry, Trigonometry, Elementary Statistics, Square root, Age Calculations, Calendar & Clock, Pipes & Cistern
  • General Intelligence & Reasoning: Analogies, Alphabetical & Number Series, Coding & Decoding, Mathematical operations, Relationships, Syllogism, Jumbling, Venn Diagram, Data Interpretation & Sufficiency, Conclusions & Decision making, Similarities & Differences, Analytical Reasoning, Classification, Directions, Statement-Arguments & Assumptions
  • General Science: Physics, Chemistry, Life Sciences of 10th standard level (CBSE)
  • General Awareness & Current Affairs: Science & Technology, Sports, Culture, Personalities, Economics, Politics, and other important subjects

Normalization: Marks will be normalized if CBT conducted in multiple sessions

Stage 2: Physical Efficiency Test (PET)

Shortlisting: 3 times the total vacancies (may vary) based on CBT merit

Nature: Qualifying (Mandatory to pass - marks not counted for final merit)

Candidate Type Test 1: Weight Carrying Test 2: Running
Male Candidates Lift and carry 35 kg weight for 100 meters in 2 minutes (in one chance, without putting down) Run 1000 meters in 4 minutes 15 seconds (in one chance)
Female Candidates Lift and carry 20 kg weight for 100 meters in 2 minutes (in one chance, without putting down) Run 1000 meters in 5 minutes 40 seconds (in one chance)
Transgender Candidates Same relaxed standards as Female candidates

Important PET Notes:

  • Two-stage test: First weight carrying, then running (after recovery gap)
  • Failing in weight carrying means elimination (no running test)
  • Weight carrying involves lifting sandbag (without handle) from waist-height bench and carrying without dropping
  • Candidates' responsibility to ensure medical fitness for PET - Railways not responsible for injuries
  • Exemptions from PET:
    • Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) - must pass medical examination
    • Course Completed Act Apprentices (CCAA)
    • Ex-Servicemen (ExSM)
  • Pregnant Candidates: Must submit self-declaration. If pregnant, PET deferred till 6 weeks post-confinement. Vacancy kept reserved.

Stage 3: Document Verification (DV)

  • Shortlisting: 1:1 ratio of vacancies based on CBT merit + PET qualification
  • Candidates must produce original certificates
  • No additional time given - absence leads to candidature cancellation
  • Scanned copies to be uploaded before DV at https://oirms-ir.gov.in/rrbdv
  • Certificates must be in English/Hindi (translated version required otherwise)
  • Hard copy of signed application form to be brought

Stage 4: Medical Examination (ME)

  • Conducted by Railway Medical Authorities
  • Must pass requisite medical fitness test as per IRMM
  • Visual acuity standards strictly enforced
  • Medical appeal option available (one final opportunity on payment)
  • Candidates found medically unsuitable will NOT be given alternative appointment

Final Merit & Selection

  • Based on CBT marks (after normalization if applicable)
  • Subject to PET qualification, DV clearance, and medical fitness
  • Post/Railway allotment as per candidate's preference, merit, medical fitness, and vacancy
  • In case of tie: Older candidate ranked higher; if age also same, alphabetical order of name (A to Z)
  • No right to appointment - RRB/RRC only recommends; appointment by Railway Administration

Eligibility Criteria

Educational Qualification (Essential)

JRF Position: M.Tech./M.E. degree in one of the following specializations:

  • Electronics and Communication Engineering (ECE)
  • Electrical Engineering (EE)
  • Electronics & Instrumentation (E&I)

Minimum Marks Required:

  • General (GEN)/General-EWS/OBC-NCL Category: Minimum 60% aggregate marks OR 6.5 CGPA at both UG (Bachelor's) and PG (Master's) levels
  • SC/ST/PwD Category: Minimum 55% aggregate marks OR 6.0 CGPA at both UG (Bachelor's) and PG (Master's) levels

Desirable Qualifications

  • Valid GATE or NET score (not mandatory but preferred)
  • Solid understanding of digital communication, probability theory, optimization, and wireless communications
  • Experience with programming languages such as MATLAB or Python
  • Experience with simulation tools
  • Prior research or industrial experience in relevant fields

Age Limit

  • Maximum age: 35 years
  • Age will be calculated as on the closing date of application: 15-02-2026
  • Relaxation in age limit as per Government of India rules for SC/ST/OBC/Women/PwD/EWS candidates

Career Progression Promotion to Senior Research Fellow (SRF) after successful completion of 2 years
Performance Evaluation Annual performance review

Duration and Tenure

  • Initial Duration: 03 years or till completion of project, whichever is earlier
  • Extension: Based on satisfactory performance review at the end of each 12-month period
  • Performance Evaluation: Conducted annually

Application Submission Process

  1. Download the application form from NIT Silchar website or use the format provided in the notification
  2. Fill all required details in the application form carefully
  3. Enclose a copy of your bio-data/resume/curriculum vitae (CV)
  4. Attach recent passport size colored photograph
  5. Prepare soft copies of all supporting documents
  6. Send the duly filled application along with CV and all documents via email

Deadline: 21-02-2026 (11:59 PM)

Required Documents to Submit

  • Completed application form
  • Recent passport size colored photograph
  • Bio-data/Resume/Curriculum Vitae (CV)
  • Educational qualification certificates (10th onwards)
  • GATE/NET/ICMR/DBT-SRF scorecard (if applicable)
  • Category certificate (SC/ST/OBC/EWS) if applicable
  • PwD certificate (if applicable)
  • Identity proof (Aadhar, PAN, Passport, Driving License, etc.)
  • Address proof
  • Research/Industrial/Teaching experience certificates (if any)
  • Publications and conference participation details (if any)
  • No Objection Certificate from employer (if currently employed) - to be submitted at interview

Selection Process

  1. Screening: Applications will be screened based on eligibility criteria
  2. Shortlisting: The institute has the discretion to restrict the number of candidates for interview based on screening results
  3. Interview: Shortlisted candidates will be called for interview (mode: online or offline to be notified)
  4. Final Selection: Selection will be based on interview performance and overall merit

Note: Interview date, time, and venue will be duly notified through email to shortlisted candidates.

Terms and Conditions

  • This is a temporary research position under a sponsored research project
  • The position is contractual in nature for the project duration
  • Selected candidates must sign an agreement at the time of joining
  • Employed candidates must submit a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from their employer at the time of interview
  • SC/ST/OBC/Women/PwD/EWS candidates will get relaxation in qualification and age as per Government of India rules
  • The institute has the discretion to reject any or all applications if suitable candidates are not found
  • The institute reserves the right to modify/cancel the selection process if required

Job Responsibilities (JRF)

The Junior Research Fellow will be responsible for:

  • Assisting in research activities related to Terahertz Wireless Communications Systems
  • Conducting literature reviews and theoretical analysis
  • Developing hardware prototypes and testing systems
  • Working on AI/ML algorithms for beam training and resource management
  • Conducting simulations using MATLAB, Python, or other relevant tools
  • Preparing experimental setups and conducting measurements
  • Publishing research findings in peer-reviewed journals and conferences
  • Documenting research progress and maintaining project records
  • Collaborating with team members and faculty

Selection Process

Phases of Recruitment Tests:

  • Physical Efficiency Test (PET) and Medical Examination followed by Physical Standard Test (PST)
  • Written Test
  • Oral/Viva Voce

Physical Efficiency Test (PET) - 40 Marks:

For Male Candidates:

  • Race (20 marks): 1600 meters race to be completed within 450 seconds (7.5 minutes)
    • Maximum 20 marks for time 300 seconds or less
    • Minimum qualifying time: 450 seconds
    • Marks decrease progressively based on time taken
    • Conducted under CCTV surveillance using RFID chips
  • Long Jump (20 marks): Minimum 335 cm required
    • 3 chances given; longest valid jump considered
    • Minimum qualifying jump: 335 cm (10 marks)
    • Maximum 20 marks for jump of 500 cm or more
    • Conducted under CCTV surveillance

For Female Candidates:

  • Race (20 marks): 800 meters race to be completed within 240 seconds (4 minutes)
    • Maximum 20 marks for time 160 seconds or less
    • Minimum qualifying time: 240 seconds
    • Marks decrease progressively based on time taken
    • Conducted under CCTV surveillance using RFID chips
  • Long Jump (20 marks): Minimum 244 cm required
    • 3 chances given; longest valid jump considered
    • Minimum qualifying jump: 244 cm (10 marks)
    • Maximum 20 marks for jump of 389 cm or more
    • Conducted under CCTV surveillance

Medical Examination:

  • Conducted after qualifying in PET
  • Examination by Medical & Health Officer as per medical standards

Physical Standard Test (PST) - Qualifying (No Marks):

  • Conducted after qualifying in Medical Examination
  • Parameters checked as per physical standards mentioned

Written Test - 50 Marks:

  • Shortlisting: 5 times the number of posts in order of merit based on PET marks
  • 100 multiple choice questions on OMR sheet
  • Each correct answer carries 0.5 marks (Total 50 marks)
  • No negative marking
  • Questions of Class IX and X level
  • Subjects: Elementary Arithmetic, General English, Logical reasoning/Mental ability, Assam's History, Geography, Polity, Economy, General Awareness/GK and current affairs
  • Question paper available in Assamese/Bodo/Bengali/English languages
  • Date and venue to be notified in due course

Oral/Viva Voce - 5 Marks:

  • Shortlisting: 2 times number of vacancies based on total marks in PET & Written Test
  • Candidates scoring same marks as last selected candidate will also be called

NCC Weightage - Maximum 5 Marks:

  • NCC 'C' Certificate: 5 marks
  • NCC 'B' Certificate: 3 marks
  • NCC 'A' Certificate: 2 marks

Final Merit Calculation - Total 100 Marks:

  • Physical Efficiency Test (PET): 40 marks
  • Written Test: 50 marks
  • NCC Weightage: 5 marks
  • Oral/Viva Voce: 5 marks
  • Total: 100 marks

Tie-Breaking:

  • In case of tie in marks, older candidate placed higher in merit list
  • If same date of birth with equal marks, candidate with higher height placed higher

Physical Standards

Height Requirements:

  • Male (General/OBC/MOBC/SC): 162.5 cm
  • Male (ST P/ST H): 160 cm
  • Female (General/OBC/MOBC/SC): 144.5 cm
  • Female (ST P/ST H): 142 cm

Chest Measurement (Only for Men):

  • Measuring not less than 81 cm when deflated

Weight Requirements:

  • For both Male and Female candidates: Proportionate to height and age as per medical standard

Medical Standards:

  • Candidates must be of sound health both mentally and physically
  • Free from organic defect or bodily infirmity likely to interfere with efficient discharge of duties
  • Good mental and bodily health required
  • Free from physical deformities
  • Free from diabetes, heart disease, hernia, piles, respiratory diseases, knock-knee, flat foot or any physical deformity
  • Should not be colour blind or squint eyed
  • Eye Sight: Distance vision 6/6 for at least one eye and not poorer than 6/9 for other without correction; Normal near vision
  • Varicose vein considered as temporary disqualification
  • Candidates required to undergo Medical Examination as necessary before appointment

General Information/Instructions

  • Applicant must be a Citizen of India and Permanent Resident of Assam
  • Must be registered with a local Employment Exchange in Assam
  • Must speak Assamese or any other State language fluently
  • The present number of vacancies (138) is tentative and subject to final clearance by Government
  • Vacancies may increase or decrease at any time/stage of recruitment process
  • Selected applicants will have to submit Proof of Residence after publication of Final Select List (SC, ST, OBC/MOBC exempted)
  • Preliminary Identity Verification: Admit Card and identity proof (Aadhaar/Voter ID/Driving License) will be checked
  • Biometric verification conducted before PET & PST and at exit, also during Written Test and Oral/Viva Voce
  • CCTV surveillance for all PET events
  • PET is strenuous; only medically fit candidates should attempt
  • SLPRB not liable for any injury during tests due to pre-existing medical conditions
  • Applicants must register in portal only once for all Advertisements using single Application ID
  • Multiple Application IDs using different mobile numbers will lead to cancellation
  • Name must be exactly as per HSLC Certificate
  • Keep mobile number active and unchanged until recruitment completion
  • Edit option available for 5 days after last date (only once, subject to SLPRB approval)
  • All documents uploaded must be issued on or before 22-02-2026
  • Caste Certificate only from Competent Authority of Govt. of Assam accepted
  • Failure to produce original Caste Certificate during verification will result in treatment as GENERAL category
  • No changes in entries after document submission during PET & PST
  • Incomplete/defective/invalid applications will be summarily rejected
  • No TA/DA admissible for journey and stay during any recruitment stage
  • Height measurement is posture-dependent; candidates advised to stand in best posture
  • Earlier height certificates not valid in case of dispute
  • Re-measurement allowed same day if not qualified; Selection Committee decision final
  • Applicants eliminated as soon as they fail any PET or PST event
  • Appearing from more than one venue leads to cancellation
  • Final appointment subject to satisfactory Police Verification and Medical Examination Report
  • Selected candidates will undergo basic training at designated place and time
  • Training period can be extended by Competent Authority
  • Failure to complete training in three chances leads to discharge
  • Appointees must serve minimum 3 years after posting or refund training costs
  • Selected candidates can be posted anywhere in Assam
  • SLPRB may club this recruitment with other posts/recruitments
  • Decision of SLPRB final on all recruitment matters
  • Canvassing leads to immediate disqualification
  • Anonymous complaints not entertained

Status Institute of National Importance
Department Physics

About the Research Project

The research project focuses on "Quantum Dots integrated titania with plenty of heterojunctions and its utility for green hydrogen production: Beyond Proof of Concept". This cutting-edge project aims to develop advanced nanomaterials and photocatalytic systems for sustainable hydrogen production, which is crucial for clean energy solutions. The selected JRF will be involved in synthesis, characterization, and testing of quantum dots and titania-based heterojunctions for photocatalytic applications.

Job Description

  • Synthesis of Quantum Dots and Titania nanomaterials
  • Development of metal oxide heterojunctions
  • Fabrication of photocatalytic reactors
  • Testing and evaluation for green hydrogen generation
  • Literature review and data analysis
  • Technical report writing and publication support
  • Laboratory maintenance and safety compliance

Eligibility Criteria

Essential Qualifications

  • Educational Qualification: Any one of the following:
    • B.S. (4-year programme) with 55% marks minimum
    • B. Pharmacy (B. Pharm) with 55% marks minimum
    • MBBS with 55% marks minimum
    • Integrated BS-MS programme with 55% marks minimum
    • M.Sc. with 55% marks minimum
    • Bachelor of Engineering (BE) with 55% marks minimum
    • B.Tech. or equivalent degree with 55% marks minimum
  • Competitive Examinations: Must have passed either NET (National Eligibility Test) OR GATE (Graduate Aptitude Test in Engineering)
  • Percentage Criteria: Minimum 55% marks in the qualifying examination (45% for SC/ST/PwD candidates)

Desirable Qualifications

  • M.Sc. Physics with specialization in relevant field
  • Experience in Nanomaterials Synthesis and Characterization
  • Knowledge of photocatalytic techniques
  • Laboratory experience in material science
  • Published research papers or conference presentations

Age Limit

  • Maximum Age Limit: 28 years as on the date of application (05-03-2026)
  • Age Relaxation: Upper age limit is relaxable by 5 years for candidates belonging to:
    • SC (Scheduled Caste)
    • ST (Scheduled Tribe)
    • OBC (Other Backward Class)
    • WOMEN candidates
    • PwD (Person with Disability) candidates
  • Calculation: Age will be calculated as on 05-03-2026 (Application deadline date)

Fellowship & Remuneration

  • Monthly Fellowship: ₹37,000/month
  • Nature of Remuneration: Fixed monthly fellowship on contractual basis
  • Duration: 3 years (subject to satisfactory performance)
  • Basis: CSIR norms for JRF fellowship

How to Apply

  1. Download the prescribed application form from the official notification PDF or NIT Silchar website
  2. Fill the application form legibly with all required information
  3. Prepare a comprehensive CV highlighting academic achievements and research interests
  4. Gather all required supporting documents (certificates, marksheets, exam scores, etc.)
  5. Scan all documents clearly (application form, CV, and documents)
  6. Prepare an email with the subject line: "Application for the post of JRF under CSIR project"
  7. Attach all scanned documents to the email
  8. Send the email to the Principal Investigator: [email protected]
  9. Application submission deadline: 05-03-2026

Required Documents

  • Duly filled application form (prescribed format)
  • Curriculum Vitae (CV) - comprehensive and detailed
  • Educational certificates and marksheets from Class X onwards
  • NET/GATE Admit Card and Scorecard/Certificate (mandatory)
  • Bachelor's degree certificate and official transcripts
  • Master's degree certificate and official transcripts (if applicable)
  • Character certificate from college/institution principal
  • Caste certificate for SC/ST/OBC candidates (if applicable)
  • Disability certificate for PwD candidates (if applicable)
  • Proof of age (Birth certificate or School leaving certificate)
  • Copy of national-level ID proof (Aadhaar/PAN/Passport)
  • Research papers or publications (if any)

Selection Process

  1. Application Screening: All applications will be reviewed against eligibility criteria
  2. Shortlisting: Eligible candidates will be shortlisted based on academic performance and NET/GATE scores
  3. Interview: Shortlisted candidates will be called for interview (mode to be communicated)
  4. Interview Focus: Subject knowledge, research interest, aptitude for research
  5. Final Selection: Based on interview performance and overall merit
  6. Agreement Signing: Selected candidates must sign the JRF agreement at the time of joining

Important Terms & Conditions

  • Employment Type: Temporary, contractual, time-bound project position
  • Duration: 3 years (May be extended based on project progress and performance)
  • Reporting: To the Principal Investigator (Dr. Ranjith G. Nair), Department of Physics
  • No Objection Certificate: Employed candidates must submit NOC from their employer at the time of interview
  • Institute Rights: The Institute reserves the right to:
    • Restrict the number of candidates called for interview based on screening
    • Not recruit if suitable candidates are not found
    • Modify project duration based on funding or progress
  • Agreement Binding: Selected candidates must sign a JRF agreement before joining
  • Compliance: Must adhere to all NIT Silchar rules, regulations, and CSIR guidelines

Important Instructions

  • Ensure all information in the application form is accurate and true
  • Double-check that copies of all certificates are scanned clearly and legibly
  • Keep NET/GATE scorecard ready as it is mandatory documentation
  • Email subject line must be exact: "Application for the post of JRF under CSIR project"
  • Do not miss the application deadline - no late applications will be accepted
  • Use official email only ([email protected])
  • Interview date and mode will be communicated via email to shortlisted candidates
  • Attend interview on specified date and time (important for selection)
  • The Institute decision is final and binding

Important Dates

Application Start Date 22 January 2026

Selection Process

  • After scrutinizing received applications, prepare merit list based on marks obtained in educational qualification for shortlisting, then prepare provisional list of 10 times the number of vacancies category-wise for document verification.

  • Invite eligible candidates for computer proficiency/skill test.

  • Posting of selected candidate in district office or subordinate project offices.

  • All information regarding direct recruitment only through https://kawardha.gov.in; no other correspondence.
  • Ineligibility: Candidate married before minimum marriage age; male with more than one living wife or female married to such male; not medically fit; not suitable after inquiry; convicted of offense against women.

If at any stage during the screening, recruitment and selection process and even after appointment, it is found that candidates have furnished false or incorrect information, their candidature will be rejected/cancelled/terminated immediately. The institute takes no responsibility for incomplete/incorrect information. No correspondence in this regard shall be entertained at later date.
  • Applicants should take due care while filing online information for different positions. Application once submitted online cannot be altered/resubmitted, under any circumstances. Further, no request with respect to making changes in any data/ particular entered by the candidate in the Online Application will be entertained, once the application is submitted successfully. Therefore, please keep all data/details ready before you start filling up the Application Online.

Eligibility Criteria

  • BE/B. Tech or Equivalent Degree with 60% or equivalent CGPA OR
  • ME/M. Tech/Equivalent Degree OR
  • Post Graduate Degree in Science/Computer Application or in relevant Domain with 60% or equivalent CGPA OR
  • PhD. in relevant discipline

in  Computer Science and Engineering and aligned branches - AI, data science, cybersecurity, IoT, etc., or Information Security, or Electronics & Communication Engineering or Electrical Engineering

 Age Limit and Relaxation

  • Maximum Age limit: 56 Years
  • Age relaxation is applicable as per rules.

Upper Age limit will be as specified against each post

Applicants belonging to reserved category (SC/ST/OBC) / physically challenged/Ex-servicemen could be eligible for relaxations according to the ‘Government of India’ norms.

 Government employees on payscale will be eligible for relaxation in age by 5 years including  other  age relaxations as applicable.

 The cut-off date for ascertaining the age and experience will be Last Date of submission of    application.

Candidates seeking age relaxation need to submit a copy of caste certificate when called for document verification.  

 SSLC/SSC/ISC mark sheet/ certificate and any other valid document will be considered as proof of date of birth.

The Economically Weaker Section’s Certificate should be strictly in the format prescribed by DoPT.  The format is available on the website www.persmin.nic.in

The application of the candidates not meeting the prescribed age criteria will be reject/cancelled without any prior intimation.

Candidates belonging to OBC category (Non creamy layer) should produce the certificate issued in prescribed format.

Application Fee

  • No application fee is charged by C-DAC for applying to this advertisement.

Important Dates

  • Notification Release Date: 01-02-2026
  • Starting Date for Apply Online: 01-02-2026
  • Last Date for Apply Online: 20-02-2026
  • Interview Dates: Will be communicated via email to shortlisted candidates

Selection Process

  • Candidate should meet the eligibility criteria as specified in the advertisement.  
  • The qualification and experience prescribed, are the minimum requirements and possession of the  same does not automatically make the candidates entitled to be called for written test and / or selection processes. 
  • There will be an initial screening based on the academic records and other parameters declared in  the on-line application and only screened-in candidates will be considered for further selection process. 
  • The management reserves the right to increase/alter the minimum eligibility criteria/cut off  limits, in  the event of the number of applicants are more, for any post(s), at its discretion. 
  • Candidates will be selected on the basis of their academic credentials, experience profile, written   test marks (if any), performance in the interview and such other selection processes/parameters, as adopted and deemed fit by management. e. Mere application and fulfilment of the mentioned qualifications etc., does not entitle a candidate  to be called for written/skill test/ interview.
  • C-DAC may restrict the number of candidates to be  called to participate in interview/selection process to a reasonable limit, on the basis of qualifications and experience higher than that of the minimum prescribed in the advertisement. The  candidates should, therefore, furnish all the qualifications and experience possessed in the relevant field, over and above the minimum qualifications prescribed.  
  • The selection process shall be carried out by the respective C-DAC Centre based on its requirements and only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for further process.
  • All information submitted in the application will be verified with the original documents at the time  of document verification or at any stage of the recruitment process. If any documents/information provided by the candidate is found to be false or incorrect or Non- conformity with the eligibility criteria, then his/her candidature is liable to be rejected/cancelled at  any stage of the recruitment and selection process without any prior intimation.
  • The candidature is also liable for rejection at any stage if C-DAC comes across any evidence/knowledge that the qualification, experience and any other particulars indicated in the application/other    forms/formats are not recognized/false misleading and/or amounts to suppression of information/particulars which should have been brought to the notice of C-DAC

How to Apply

  • Before filling the online application form, Candidates should read General Terms and Conditions carefully.
  • Candidate should read all the eligibility parameters and ensure that he/she is eligible for the post before starting to apply online.
  • Candidate should have a valid email id and mobile no. which should remain valid & active till the completion of selection process.
  • While applying online Candidates can click on the ‘Apply’ button provided against each position for which he/she wish to apply.
  • The candidate needs to log in with mobile no. and then fill in the OTP received on the said mobile no.
  • On filling the correct OTP, the applicant will be directed to fill in the application form. In case you have filled in an application in our previous advertisement, the applicant will receive a prefilled editable application.
  • Candidates shall check the prefilled application and submit it, after adding additional details by clicking on ‘Submit’ button.
  • Candidates should scan their photograph in .jpg format (not more than 400 KB) and keep it ready before starting to apply online for uploading.
  • Candidate should upload their resume in PDF format (Not more than 500 KB)
  • A unique application number will be generated by the system, please note this application number for future reference and use. Candidates can take a print of the application form and keep it with them for their own records.
  • No hard copy/printed applications should be sent to C-DAC. Incomplete and defectively filled online forms shall be rejected straightway and no subsequent correspondences will be entertained in this regard.
  • Candidates working in Government/PSUs/Govt. Autonomous bodies should also apply online in advance and print of the application form, duly filled and signed should be forwarded through proper channel to HRD Section, C-DAC, Bangalore.
  • Those who are not forwarding their application through proper channel are required to produce 'No objection certificate (NOC)' from their current employer at the time of interview, if called for, failing which they will not be permitted to attend the interview.
  • Any dispute with regard to selection/recruitment process will be subject to Courts/Tribunals having jurisdiction over Bangalore, Karnataka only.

  • The contractual engagement is purely short-term and temporary in nature, which shall NOT create any right or claim or preference, either for regular employment in the organization, or for regularization, or extension of period of contract.
  • NIELIT will create a panel for each position in order of merit. Resource Person will be selected for appointment on contract from the respective panel as and when required. However, the panel will be valid for two years. The selected Resource Person from the panel will be appointed initially for a period of 1 year, which may be further extended based on the performance of the candidate, up to a maximum of 5 years.

UPSC CSE 2026 – Preliminary Examination Pattern

The Civil Services (Preliminary) Examination is the first stage of the UPSC selection process. It is a screening test used to shortlist candidates for the Main Examination. Marks scored in Prelims are not counted in the final merit ranking.

Paper Subject Type Marks Duration
Paper I General Studies (GS) Objective (MCQs) 200 Marks 2 Hours
Paper II CSAT (Aptitude Test) Objective (MCQs) 200 Marks 2 Hours

Prelims Key Rules

  • Both papers are objective type (Multiple Choice Questions).
  • Paper II (CSAT) is qualifying in nature – minimum 33% marks required.
  • Marks of Paper I are considered for cutoff and shortlisting for Mains.
  • Negative marking applies: 1/3rd mark deducted for each wrong answer.
  • Leaving a question blank carries no penalty.

UPSC CSE 2026 – Main Examination Pattern

The Civil Services (Main) Examination is the second stage and consists of a written examination followed by an Interview/Personality Test. Marks obtained in the written papers and interview are counted for the final merit list.

Paper Subject Marks Nature
Paper A Compulsory Indian Language 300 Qualifying
Paper B English 300 Qualifying

Paper III General Studies II 250 Merit
Paper IV General Studies III 250 Merit

Paper VI Optional Subject – Paper 1 250 Merit
Paper VII Optional Subject – Paper 2 250 Merit

  • Mains + Interview marks decide final service allocation.
  • Negative marking applies in Prelims only.
  • Candidates must qualify in both language papers to have their merit papers evaluated.

Post Total Vacancies Posting States

Eligibility Criteria

  • Qualification: 2 Years full time post graduate degree / diploma in HR/Personnel/ IR /PM & IR with not less than 60% marks from a recognized university/ institution approved by UGC/AICTE (In case of Dual Specializations, Certificate to be provided in the field prescribed).
  • Essential Qualification: 2 Years full time post graduate degree / diploma in HR/Personnel/ IR /PM & IR with not less than 60% marks from a recognized university/ institution approved by UGC/AICTE
  • Desirable Qualification: Experience in SAP/ERP is desirable.
  • Experience: Minimum two years of experience in Recruitments, Training & Development and other HR Related activities. Note: Teaching/ training/consultancy/Freelancing experience shall not be treated as relevant experience.

Salary/ Stipend

  • Fixed consolidated Pay: Rs. 40,000/- per month.
  • In addition to above emoluments, the candidates would also be provided annual increment of 5% on Fixed Consolidated Pay after each completed year of service.

Age Limit (as on 01-02-2026)

  • Maximum Age As on 01.02.2026: 35 Years
  • Age Relaxations as per Government of India's guidelines subject to fulfillment of the requisite qualification & experience.

Important Dates

Notification Date 02 February 2026
Last Date for receipt of Application 27 February 2026

Selection Process

  • Selection will be through written Exam and /or interview of shortlisted candidates.

General Information / Instructions

  1. Selection will be through written Exam and /or interview of shortlisted candidates.
  2. The above posts are specifically for IRCON/ IRCON's SPV in States mentioned above, and not for the regular establishment of IRCON. The appointment will be initially for a period of one year subject to satisfactory performance of the selected candidate. The contract may be further extended after one year as per the requirements of the company, if the services of the candidates are found to be satisfactory. However, the appointment is co-terminus with the project for which candidate is selected and will not confer any right to claim absorption in regular establishment of the company or for appointment in other projects of the company.
  3. There are no allowances over and above the fixed pay.
  4. For Medical Coverage, the Medical Health Insurance Policy of Rs Three Lakhs for self with the ceiling of premium of Rs 4000/- per annum shall be taken by the Contract Employees themselves covering Covid-19 and other diseases. The premium amount shall be reimbursed to the contract employees subject to submission of copy of health insurance policy and original receipt of premium paid.
  5. Minimum PF as prescribed under the EPF & MP Act 1952 will be deducted from the salary and a matching contribution will be made by IRCON. The accumulations will be paid at the time of cessation of contract.
  6. One leave for each calendar month of service can be availed during the contract period. Leave can be carried forward and accumulated but no leave encashment for un availed leave is allowed during the contract or on resignation or termination of contract. No other type of leave would be admissible.
  7. One weekly off and other public holidays when the project office remains closed would be available.
  8. Working hours/days and off will be the same as for the Project.
  9. TA/DA would also be admissible if deputed on outstation duty.
  10. No other perks or benefits would be admissible except the above.
  11. All information submitted in the application will be verified with original documents at the time of interview. If any information provided by the candidate is found to be false or incorrect or not in conformity with the eligibility criteria, then his/her candidature is liable to be rejected/cancelled at any stage of the recruitment process.
  12. The ex-contract employees of IRCON, whose services were terminated due to closure of projects, can also apply for the post if they fulfil the required qualifications and experience. A copy of the termination letter should be sent along with the application. Appointment against this advertisement shall be treated as fresh appointment without any linkage to previous employment in IRCON.
  13. Candidates either working or not working as on cutoff date can apply if they possess essential qualification and post qualification experience as mentioned above.
  14. The number of posts indicated above may vary based on further assessment of requirement. The company reserves the right to increase, decrease, cancel, restrict & modify the requirement at any point of time without assigning any reason thereof.

How to Apply

  • Before applying, candidates should ensure that they fulfil all the eligibility criteria mentioned in the advertisement.
  • Eligible candidates have to apply in prescribed format through off line mode only. It is advisable that the candidates have a valid e-mail id in order to facilitate faster communication.
  • Application neatly typed on A-4 size paper in the prescribed format should be sent to Joint General Manager/ HRM, IRCON INTERNATIONAL LIMITED, C-4, District Centre, Saket, New Delhi – 110 017 accompanied with the copy of following documents: i. Experience Certificate in chronological order. In case of Present Employment, offer letter alone will not be considered as proof of experience, the candidate should also submit last Two Months’ salary slip of present employer for proof of experience. ii. Date of Birth/ class X passing certificate as proof of DOB. iii. Caste certificate/EWS Certificate/Age relaxation. Certificate issued should be in prescribed format as per Government of India's guidelines. iv. Qualification Degree/Diploma and All semester/year Mark sheets for calculation of percentage in qualifying degree.
  • If the candidate belongs to OBC category, a caste certificate issued by competent authority as applicable for appointment to the services in Govt. of India in proper format as per Annexure-A will be accepted. Please note, that OBC certificate issued in the current financial year only will be accepted as a current proof of your not belonging to “creamy layer” in the OBC category.

About Agnipath Scheme

The Agnipath Scheme is a visionary and transformative initiative by the Government of India to strengthen the Armed Forces through recruitment of young talent. The scheme provides an opportunity for Indian youth to serve the nation for a defined period, gain professional experience, develop leadership qualities, and acquire valuable skills. Agniveers (personnel recruited under this scheme) will undergo comprehensive training and skill development during their service period. Upon completion of 4 years of service, outstanding performers may be eligible for permanent enrollment in the regular cadre based on merit and organizational requirements.

Eligibility Criteria

Age Limit

  • Date of Birth Range: Candidates born between 02 July 2005 and 02 January 2009 (both days inclusive) are eligible to apply
  • Age at Time of Enrollment: If selected through all stages, the upper age limit at the time of actual enrollment should not exceed 21 years
  • Age Calculation: Age will be calculated as on the date of registration

Marital Status (Very Important)

  • Must be Unmarried: Only unmarried male candidates are eligible for recruitment as Agniveervayu Non-Combatant
  • Marriage Undertaking: Selected candidates must sign a voluntary undertaking that they will NOT marry during the 4-year engagement period
  • Breach of Undertaking: Any Agniveervayu Non-Combatant who marries during the engagement period will be immediately discharged from service without any benefits
  • Regular Cadre Eligibility: Only unmarried Agniveervayu Non-Combatant will be considered for selection in regular cadre as Non-Combatant(E) after 4 years

Educational Qualification

  • Minimum Qualification: Passed Matriculation (10th Standard) or equivalent examination
  • Recognized Board: Must be from education boards recognized by Central, State, or Union Territory as on the date of registration
  • Proof Required: Original matriculation certificate or mark sheet mandatory

Nationality & Residency

  • Must be an Indian citizen
  • Must be a permanent resident of India

Physical & Medical Standards

Physical Requirements

Parameter Requirement
Minimum Height 152 cm (centimeters)
Chest Expansion Minimum 5 cm
Weight Proportionate to height and age

Medical Standards

Vision Standards

  • Refractive Error: Not exceeding ± 3.5 D (diopters) including astigmatism
  • Visual Acuity: 6/36 each eye, correctable to 6/9 each eye
  • Color Vision: CP-III standard
  • Note: Corneal surgery (PRK/LASIK) is NOT acceptable

Hearing Standards

  • Candidate must have normal hearing capability
  • Able to hear forced whisper from a distance of 6 meters with each ear separately

Dental Standards

  • Healthy gums and good set of teeth
  • Minimum 14 dental points required
  • Dental implants and implant-supported prosthesis will NOT be awarded any points
  • Candidates wearing fixed or removable orthodontic appliances will be declared UNFIT

General Health Standards

  • Must be fit for the Indian Air Force according to all medical standards
  • Normal body anatomy without loss of any appendages
  • Free from any active or latent, acute or chronic medical or surgical disability
  • No communicable diseases, infections, or skin ailments
  • Physically and mentally FIT to perform duty in any climate, terrain, and region worldwide

General Disqualifications

Narcotic Drugs & Substance Abuse (ZERO TOLERANCE)

  • Consumption of Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances (NDPS) banned under NDPS Act 1985 is a rejection criterion
  • Agniveers found in possession, storing, distributing, or consuming such drugs after enrollment shall be liable for disciplinary action including dismissal
  • IAF follows ZERO TOLERANCE POLICY to alcoholism and substance abuse

Body Tattoos

  • Permanent body tattoos are generally NOT permitted
  • Exceptions: Tattoos only on inner forearm (inside elbow to wrist), back of hand, and tribal tattoos as per custom may be considered
  • Final decision on acceptability rests with the Selection Centre
  • Candidates with tattoos must submit two photographs (close-up and distant view) with details during selection test

Gender-Related Disqualifications

  • Candidates found to have predominant characteristics of opposite gender will be rejected as UNFIT
  • Any candidate having undergone gender reassignment surgery will be declared UNFIT

Selection Process

  1. Offline Application: Submit application through official portal https://agnipathvayu.cdac.in/AV/
  2. Initial Screening: Applications will be reviewed for eligibility criteria compliance
  3. Phase I - Written Test: Common entrance examination for basic knowledge
  4. Phase II - Physical Fitness Test (PFT): 1.6 km run, push-ups, sit-ups, and other physical tests
  5. Phase III - Medical Examination: Complete medical examination as per IAF medical standards
  6. Phase IV - Medical Review Board: Final medical fitness decision
  7. Documentation & Verification: Document verification and background check
  8. Final Merit List: Selection based on overall performance and merit

How to Apply

  1. Visit the official IAF Agnipath portal: https://agnipathvayu.cdac.in/AV/
  2. Navigate to "Agniveervayu Non-Combatant" section
  3. Click on "Application Form" sub-tab
  4. Download blank application form and detailed instructions
  5. Read the Information Brochure thoroughly
  6. Fill the application form completely with accurate information
  7. Upload required documents as per instructions
  8. Submit the application Offline 
  9. Note the application reference number for future correspondence
  10. Keep checking the official website for updates regarding selection stages

Documents Required for Application

  • Photograph: Recent passport-size color photograph
  • Educational Certificate: Matriculation/10th pass certificate or equivalent
  • Date of Birth Proof: Birth certificate or school leaving certificate
  • Identification Proof: Aadhaar, Voter ID, or PAN card (any one)
  • Address Proof: Utility bills, rental agreement, or official document
  • Character Certificate: From school/college principal or local authorities
  • Medical Fitness Declaration: As per format provided
  • Caste/Category Certificate: If applicable (for SC/ST/OBC candidates)

Service Terms & Conditions

  • Contract Period: 4 years from date of enrollment
  • Employment Status: Contract-based, not permanent
  • Marital Status Condition: Must not marry during service period; discharge if marriage takes place
  • Training Phase: Comprehensive military training and skill development programs
  • Uniform & Discipline: Subject to military rules, regulations, and Standing Orders
  • Post-Service Options: Exceptional performers (approximately 25% annually) eligible for permanent enrollment as Non-Combatant(E) in regular cadre
  • Exit Benefits: Gratuity, terminal benefits, and other benefits as per government norms at the end of 4 years
  • Severance Pay: In case of medical discharge or other authorized reasons during service

Agniveer Benefits & Career Progression

During Service (4 Years)

  • Monthly stipend/salary as per government norms
  • Accommodation and meals provided
  • Medical and dental care (comprehensive)
  • Life insurance coverage
  • Professional training and skill development
  • Leadership and personality development programs
  • Uniform and necessary equipment
  • Leave benefits as per service rules

Post-Service Career

  • Permanent Cadre Option: Top 25% performers annually eligible for permanent selection as Non-Combatant(E) with service of 17 more years (total 21 years)
  • Civilian Skills: Training imparted during service makes Agniveers valuable in civilian job market
  • Preference in Government Jobs: Agniveers may get preference/weightage in some government sector recruitment
  • Entrepreneurship Support: Government schemes may support Agni veer entrepreneurs
  • Higher Education: Opportunity to pursue education in civilian field after service

Important Instructions & Cautions

  • Fair & Transparent Selection: Selection in IAF is strictly on MERIT and FAIR criteria. NO BRIBE or payments required at any stage
  • Beware of Fraud: Do NOT fall prey to unscrupulous agents claiming to be recruiting agents. All recruitment is through official channels only
  • Official Website Only: Use only official website https://agnipathvayu.cdac.in/AV/ for applications
  • No Backdoor Entry: No personal contacts, references, or influence will help in selection
  • Verify Information: Cross-verify all information from official notifications and brochure
  • Truthfulness: All information provided must be accurate; false information will lead to disqualification and possible legal action
