The applicant will be solely responsible for the authenticity of the submitted information. Applicants are required to fill the application form as available on the College website. The details regarding qualifications, experience, screening guidelines and indicative proformas etc. are available on the College website https://www.rlacollege.edu.in/ along with this advertisement. The applicants are required to read these details before filling up the form.
  • Applicants should possess the prescribed qualifications and experience as on the closing date of application, as prescribed by the University for the Colleges from time to time for the respective post. The post advertised carry UGC pay scales plus admissible allowances. The posts are being advertised keeping in view the broad areas of specialization in subjects. However, the Department concerned may have specific requirement of specialization.
  • The applications received shall be screened as per screening guidelines attached with this advertisement for short listing and recommending the applicants to be called for interview. Merely fulfilling the minimum qualifications or the eligibility criteria does not entitle an applicant to be necessarily considered or called for interview. Publications 'under submission' or submitted to referees will not be considered towards calculation of marks for publication criteria. Further, all the items for which marks are claimed should be strictly in accordance with the screening guidelines attached with the advertisement. The minimum Points requirement for shortlisting of applicants for the post of Assistant Professor is indicated in the screening guidelines attached herewith.
  • In order to avoid last minute rush, the applicants are advised to apply early. In case of any persistent technical issue, the applicants can mail their problem at the College E-mail ID [email protected]
  • The reservation for applicants from SC, ST, EWS, OBC (non-creamy layer), and Persons with Benchmark Disability (PwBD) categories will be applicable as per UGC/Central Government norms. Applicants seeking reservation benefits available for SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PwBD categories must upload the necessary documents justifying the claim of respective reservation as per Govt. of India lists/rules/norms. The certificate uploaded should be in the format prescribed by the Union Government and should be digitally verifiable. In case the applicant wants to claim benefits under the PwBD category, the applicant's relevant disability should not be less than 40 per cent. Proof to this effect in the form of a valid Disability Certificate must be uploaded with the application. Applicants applying for the post(s) reserved for OBC must upload certificate of OBC (non-creamy layer) in the prescribed form issued by Competent Authority. The certificate should be of the current financial year, in accordance with instructions issued by the Union Government in this respect from time to time. Applicants should ascertain that they belong to the reserved categories (caste) enlisted in the Central List for the Other Backward Classes. If the relevant certificates for respective reserved categories are not uploaded with the application, the application may be rejected and no appeal against its rejection will be entertained.
  • Consequent upon adoption of self-certification provisions as required by the Govt. of India, the College shall process the applications entirely on the basis of information/documents uploaded with the application. In case the information/documents are found to be false/incorrect by way of omission or commission, the responsibility shall lie solely with the applicant and the applicant shall be liable for action as per law.
  • The Shortlisted candidates called for interview should report along with all the testimonials/certificates in original along with valid photo ID (Aadhaar/Voter Id/Driving License/Passport). A set of self-attested photocopy of certificates/testimonials with respect to the qualifications, experience and category as applicable, indicated in the online application form, duly certified by the applicant should be submitted at the time of interview.
  • Applicants serving in Government/Public Sector Undertakings (including Boards/Autonomous Bodies) are required to submit 'No Objection Certificate' from the employer, at the time of interview, if not uploaded with the online application earlier. The NOC should also indicate the vigilance clearance from the parent department.
  • All correspondence from the College including interview letter, if any, shall be sent only to the e-mail address provided by the applicant in the online application form.
  • Applications which do not meet the eligibility criteria given in this advertisement and / or are incomplete in any respect shall be summarily rejected. Before applying online, applicants are advised to go through detailed notice available on the website of the College.
  • Applicants must NOT furnish any particulars that are false, tampered or fabricated, or suppress any material / information while submitting the online application and uploading self-certified copies/testimonials.

How to Apply

  • Online applications are invited for the post of Assistant Professors at the web link https://rec.uod.ac.in/
  • Application forms have to be filled only in online mode, as available on the website of the College along with this advertisement, within the prescribed time limit indicated in the advertisement. No offline forms would be accepted. Payment should be made online only, through credit/debit card/Net Banking.
  • Applicants applying for more than one post/department must apply separately and pay fees separately.

Balmer Lawrie & Co. Ltd. (A Government of India Enterprise) Junior Officer, Assistant Manager & Other Posts Notification 2026 has been released on the official website www.balmerlawrie.com. A total of 28 vacancies have been announced through the Balmer Lawrie Recruitment 2026 for various Fixed Term Contract (FTC) and Executive positions.

Candidates who possess the required Bachelor’s Degree (10+2+3), MBA/MTM/Graduate Engineer, Full-Time Engineering Graduate, Company Secretary, B.Com, BCA/MCA, or other post-specific qualifications from AICTE/UGC-approved institutions are eligible to apply. The online application process for Balmer Lawrie Junior Officer, Assistant Manager and Other Posts Recruitment 2026 is currently active and will remain open until 13-03-2026. Eligibility Criteria

NCC Service Requirements:

How to Apply

Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the Indian Army Short Service Commission Recruitment 2026.

  • Applications must be submitted online on or before 16 March 2026 (1500 Hours).
  • Visit the official website: www.joinindianarmy.nic.in
  • Click on 'Officer Entry Application/Login' and then click 'Registration' (Registration not required if already registered)
  • Fill the online registration form carefully after reading the instructions
  • After getting registered, log in and click on 'Apply Online' under Dashboard
  • A page 'Officers Selection - Eligibility' will open
  • Click 'Apply' shown against Short Service Commission NCC Special Entry Course
  • Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details
  • Fill details under various segments: Personal information, Communication details, Education details, and details of previous SSB
  • Click 'Save & Continue' each time before moving to the next segment
  • Review all details carefully in 'Summary of your information' page
  • Only after ascertaining the correctness of all your details, click on 'Submit'
  • Take out two copies of the application having Roll Number, 30 minutes after final closure of online application
  • No changes can be made after submission, so verify all information carefully

Important Instructions:

  • Candidates must submit only one online application. Receipt of multiple applications from the same candidate will result in cancellation of candidature
  • The date of birth, candidate's name, and parent's name must match exactly with Matriculation/Secondary School Examination Certificate
  • CGPA/Grades must be converted into Marks as per the formulae adopted by the concerned University
  • Candidates studying in final year must note that aggregate marks after completion should be same or higher than marks in first two/three years
  • There is no need to send any hard copy to Directorate General Recruiting
  • Candidates serving in Indian Armed Forces must inform their Commanding Officer in writing

  • Print out of application duly signed with self-attested photograph
  • Matriculation/Secondary School Examination Certificate and Mark Sheet
  • 12th Class Certificate & Marks Sheet
  • Graduation Degree/Provisional Degree (not more than 6 months old at time of joining Academy)
  • Marks Sheets of all years/semesters
  • NCC 'C' Certificate (Not required for Wards of Battle Casualties)
  • Certificate regarding CGPA conversion to marks (if applicable)
  • Certificate from Principal/Head stating candidate is in final year (for final year students)
  • Declaration for final year candidates
  • Battle Casualty documents (for Wards of Battle Casualties)

IMPORTANT NOTE: DIGILOCKER Certificate will NOT be accepted in lieu of ORIGINAL CERTIFICATES

Eligibility Criteria

Qualifications

  • Professor - Eligibility (A or B):
    • Option A: An eminent scholar having a Ph.D. degree in the concerned/allied/relevant discipline, and published work of high quality, actively engaged in research with evidence of published work with a minimum of 10 research publications in the peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals and a total research score of 120 as per UGC Regulations-2018. A minimum of ten years of teaching experience in university/college as Assistant Professor/Associate Professor/Professor, and/or research experience at equivalent level at the University/National Level Institutions with evidence of having successfully guided doctoral candidate
    • Option B: An outstanding professional, having a Ph.D. degree in the relevant/allied/applied disciplines, from any academic institutions/industry, who has made significant contribution to the knowledge in the concerned/allied/relevant discipline, supported by documentary evidence provided he/she has ten years experience
  • Associate Professor: A good academic record, with a Ph.D. Degree in the concerned/allied/relevant disciplines. A Master's Degree with at least 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point-scale, wherever the grading system is followed). A minimum of eight years of experience of teaching and/or research in an academic/research position equivalent to that of Assistant Professor in a University, College or Accredited Research Institution/industry with a minimum of seven publications in the peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals and a total research score of Seventy five (75) as per UGC Regulations-2018
  • Assistant Professor - Eligibility (A or B):
    • Option A: A Master's degree with 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point-scale wherever the grading system is followed) in a concerned/relevant/allied subject from an Indian University, or an equivalent degree from an accredited foreign university. Besides fulfilling the above qualifications, the candidate must have cleared the National Eligibility Test (NET) conducted by the UGC or the CSIR, or a similar test accredited by the UGC, like SLET/SET or who are or have been awarded a Ph.D. Degree in accordance with the University Grants Commission Regulations, 2009 or 2016 and their amendments from time to time as the case may be exempted from NET/SLET/SET
    • Option B: The Ph.D degree has been obtained from a foreign university/institution with a ranking among top 500 in the World University Ranking (at any time) by any one of the following: (i) Quacquarelli Symonds (QS) (ii) the Times Higher Education (THE) or (iii) the Academic Ranking of World Universities (ARWU) of the Shanghai Jiao Tong University (Shanghai)
  • Deputy Librarian: A Master's Degree in library science/information science/documentation science, with at least 55% marks or an equivalent grade in a point-scale, wherever grading system is followed. Eight years experience as an Assistant University Librarian/College Librarian. Evidence of innovative library services including integration of ICT in library. A Ph.D. Degree in library science/Information science/Documentation Science/Archives and manuscript keeping/computerization of library
  • Assistant Librarian: A Master's Degree in Library Science, Information Science or Documentation Science or an equivalent professional degree, with at least 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point-scale, wherever the grading system is followed). A consistently good academic record, with knowledge of computerization of a library. Besides fulfilling the above qualifications, the candidate must have cleared the National Eligibility Test (NET) conducted by the UGC, CSIR or similar test accredited by the UGC like SLET/SET or who are or have been awarded a Ph.D. Degree in accordance with the University Grants Commission Regulations, 2009 or 2016 and their amendments from time to time

Essential Qualifications

  • Educational qualification, experience, age of retirement on superannuation and pay scales of Professor, Associate Professor, Assistant Professor, Deputy Librarian and Assistant Librarian will be as per the UGC/NCERT, Government of India norms as amended from time to time and in force at the time of closing date of filling-up online application
  • For Assistant Professor and Assistant Librarian positions, NET/SLET/SET shall not be required for such Masters Programmes in disciplines for which NET/SLET/SET is not conducted by the UGC, CSIR or similar test accredited by the UGC
  • Candidates registered for the Ph.D. programme prior to July 11, 2009, shall be governed by the provisions of the then existing Ordinances/Bye-laws/Regulations of the Institution awarding the degree and such Ph.D. candidates shall be exempted from the requirement of NET/SLET/SET subject to fulfillment of specific conditions: Ph.D. degree awarded in regular mode, Ph.D. thesis evaluated by at least two external examiners, Open Ph.D. viva voce conducted, Candidate has published two research papers from Ph.D. work (at least one in refereed journal), Candidate has presented at least two papers based on Ph.D work in conferences/seminars sponsored/funded/supported by the UGC/ICSSR/CSIR or any similar agency
  • The fulfillment of these conditions is to be certified by the Registrar or the Dean (Academic Affairs) of the University concerned
  • The Academic score as specified in Appendix II for Universities and Colleges shall be considered for short-listing of the candidates for interview only, and the selections shall be based only on the performance in the interview as per UGC Regulations-2018 and as amended from time to time

Experience

  • Professor: A minimum of ten years of teaching experience in university/college as Assistant Professor/Associate Professor/Professor, and/or research experience at equivalent level at the University/National Level Institutions with evidence of having successfully guided doctoral candidate OR ten years experience as an outstanding professional from academic institutions/industry with significant contribution to the knowledge in the concerned discipline

Syllabus (Indicative):

  • Mathematics: Number system, BODMAS, Decimals, Fractions, LCM, HCF, Ratio & Proportion, Percentages, Mensuration, Time & Work, Time & Distance, Simple & Compound Interest, Profit & Loss, Algebra, Geometry, Trigonometry, Elementary Statistics, Square root, Age Calculations, Calendar & Clock, Pipes & Cistern
  • General Intelligence & Reasoning: Analogies, Alphabetical & Number Series, Coding & Decoding, Mathematical operations, Relationships, Syllogism, Jumbling, Venn Diagram, Data Interpretation & Sufficiency, Conclusions & Decision making, Similarities & Differences, Analytical Reasoning, Classification, Directions, Statement-Arguments & Assumptions
  • General Science: Physics, Chemistry, Life Sciences of 10th standard level (CBSE)
  • General Awareness & Current Affairs: Science & Technology, Sports, Culture, Personalities, Economics, Politics, and other important subjects

Normalization: Marks will be normalized if CBT conducted in multiple sessions

Stage 2: Physical Efficiency Test (PET)

Shortlisting: 3 times the total vacancies (may vary) based on CBT merit

Nature: Qualifying (Mandatory to pass - marks not counted for final merit)

Candidate Type Test 1: Weight Carrying Test 2: Running
Male Candidates Lift and carry 35 kg weight for 100 meters in 2 minutes (in one chance, without putting down) Run 1000 meters in 4 minutes 15 seconds (in one chance)
Female Candidates Lift and carry 20 kg weight for 100 meters in 2 minutes (in one chance, without putting down) Run 1000 meters in 5 minutes 40 seconds (in one chance)
Transgender Candidates Same relaxed standards as Female candidates

Important PET Notes:

  • Two-stage test: First weight carrying, then running (after recovery gap)
  • Failing in weight carrying means elimination (no running test)
  • Weight carrying involves lifting sandbag (without handle) from waist-height bench and carrying without dropping
  • Candidates' responsibility to ensure medical fitness for PET - Railways not responsible for injuries
  • Exemptions from PET:
    • Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) - must pass medical examination
    • Course Completed Act Apprentices (CCAA)
    • Ex-Servicemen (ExSM)
  • Pregnant Candidates: Must submit self-declaration. If pregnant, PET deferred till 6 weeks post-confinement. Vacancy kept reserved.

Stage 3: Document Verification (DV)

  • Shortlisting: 1:1 ratio of vacancies based on CBT merit + PET qualification
  • Candidates must produce original certificates
  • No additional time given - absence leads to candidature cancellation
  • Scanned copies to be uploaded before DV at https://oirms-ir.gov.in/rrbdv
  • Certificates must be in English/Hindi (translated version required otherwise)
  • Hard copy of signed application form to be brought

Stage 4: Medical Examination (ME)

  • Conducted by Railway Medical Authorities
  • Must pass requisite medical fitness test as per IRMM
  • Visual acuity standards strictly enforced
  • Medical appeal option available (one final opportunity on payment)
  • Candidates found medically unsuitable will NOT be given alternative appointment

Final Merit & Selection

  • Based on CBT marks (after normalization if applicable)
  • Subject to PET qualification, DV clearance, and medical fitness
  • Post/Railway allotment as per candidate's preference, merit, medical fitness, and vacancy
  • In case of tie: Older candidate ranked higher; if age also same, alphabetical order of name (A to Z)
  • No right to appointment - RRB/RRC only recommends; appointment by Railway Administration

  • ST (Scheduled Tribe)
  • OBC-NCL (Other Backward Classes - Non Creamy Layer)
  • EWS (Economically Weaker Sections)

Horizontal Reservation (across all communities):

  • Ex-Servicemen (ExSM)
  • Course Completed Act Apprentices (CCAA) trained in Railway Establishments
  • Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD)

For OBC-NCL Candidates:

  • Must produce OBC-NCL certificate issued on or after 01.04.2025 but not later than 02.03.2026

  • Must submit self-declaration (Annexure IIA) at DV that they don't belong to Creamy Layer
  • Certificate must mention: "Does NOT belong to Creamy Layer as per DOPT OM 36012/22/93-Estt.(SCT) dated 08.09.93, modified vide OM 36033/1/2013-Estt.(Res.) dated 13.09.2017"
  • OBC in state list but not in central list: NOT eligible for reservation

For EWS Candidates:

  • NOT covered under SC/ST/OBC-NCL
  • Gross annual family income < Rs. 8 lakh for F.Y. 2024-25
  • Family should NOT own:
    • 5 acres or more of agricultural land, OR
    • Residential flat of 1000 sq. ft. or more, OR
    • Residential plot of 100 sq. yards or more (notified municipalities), OR
    • Residential plot of 200 sq. yards or more (other areas)
  • Family: Applicant, parents, siblings <18 years, spouse, children <18 years
  • Must possess valid Income & Asset Certificate (Annexure III) based on F.Y. 2024-25 income/assets

For PwBD Candidates:

  • Minimum 40% benchmark disability required for reservation/relaxation
  • Certificate as per Form V/VI of RPwD Rules 2024 (Annexure V-A/V-B)
  • Must submit Unique Disability Identity (UDID)
  • Suitability for posts indicated in Annexure-A
  • Eligible Disabilities:
    • VI (Visually Impaired): Blindness (B), Low Vision (LV)
    • HI (Hearing Impaired): Deaf (D), Hard of Hearing (HH)
    • LD (Locomotor Disability): OA, OL, OAL, BL, LC, DW, AAV, CP, SD (without neurological/limb dysfunction), SI (without neurological/limb dysfunction)
    • MD (Multiple Disabilities)
  • Temporary disability candidates NOT eligible for reservation (as per DePwD OM dated 17.12.2025)

For Ex-Servicemen (ExSM):

  • Must have valid Ex-Serviceman Certificate from Zila Sainik Board
  • Serving defense personnel expected to be released within 1 year can also apply
  • Must submit NOC with probable discharge date (Annexure VI-A) at DV
  • Declaration/Undertaking (Annexure VI) required at DV
  • ExSM who already secured civil employment using ExSM quota: NOT eligible for ExSM reservation (only age relaxation available)
  • Different medical standards applicable (Para 534 of IRMM)

For CCAA (Railway Establishments):

  • Must have completed Act Apprenticeship by 02.03.2026 (appeared in NCVT exam)
  • National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) from NCVT required at DV
  • Weightage: 1/3rd marks from NCVT examination added to CBT marks for merit
  • If NCVT weightage gives lower score, higher of the two will be considered
  • Exempted from PET
  • Can apply to any RRB (not just training Railway)

  • Bengaluru (Karnataka)
  • Jalandhar (Punjab)

Stage 4: SSB Interview

SSB Period: May/June 2026

Duration: Up to 5 days

Call-up Letter: Sent on registered email ID and SMS by Selection Centre

SSB Process:

Day 1 - Stage I (Screening):

  • Officer Intelligence Rating (OIR) Test
  • Picture Perception & Description Test (PP&DT)
  • Result: Same day
  • Qualified: Proceed to Stage II
  • Not Qualified: Return same day

Days 2-5 - Stage II (for Stage I qualified candidates):

  • Psychological Tests
  • Group Testing Officer (GTO) Tasks
  • Personal Interview
  • Conference
  • Result: Recommended or Not Recommended

Documents Required at SSB:

  • Application printout (signed, with self-attested photo)
  • Matriculation/SSC certificate & mark sheet (DOB proof)
  • 12th Class certificate & mark sheet
  • Graduation Degree/Provisional Degree
  • LLB Degree/Provisional Degree
  • All semester/year mark sheets
  • Bar Council registration/College certificate
  • CGPA conversion certificate
  • CLAT PG 2025 Score Card (MANDATORY)
  • All originals for verification

Note: DIGILOCKER certificates NOT accepted. Only original certificates or authenticated color printouts with school/college certificate.

Stage 5: Medical Examination

Conducted for: Only SSB recommended candidates

Validity: 270 days (SSB to PCTA joining)

Medical Standards: As per www.joinindianarmy.nic.in

Re-examination:

  • Not required if already declared 'Med FIT' for any SSB of any service within 270 days
  • Valid till 01 Oct 2026 (joining date of this course)

Medical Board: Proceedings confidential, not divulged to anyone

Stage 6: Merit List Preparation

Criteria:

  1. Primary: SSB interview marks
  2. Tie-breaker 1: Older candidate ranked higher
  3. Tie-breaker 2: Higher percentage in qualifying exam (if age also same)

Note: Higher educational qualifications, previous performance have NO role

Stage 7: Joining Letter

Issued to:

  • Candidates in merit list
  • Within stipulated vacancies
  • Medically fit
  • Meeting all eligibility criteria

Reporting: Within 7 days of reporting date Late Reporting: Candidature cancelled, next candidate called

How to Apply for Indian Army JAG Entry 2026?

Follow these steps to complete Indian Army JAG online application 2026:

Step-by-Step Application Guide

Step 1: Registration (if not already registered)

  • Visit www.joinindianarmy.nic.in
  • Click 'Officer Entry Appln/Login'
  • Click 'Registration'
  • Fill registration form carefully
  • Submit and note credentials

Step 2: Login

  • Use registration credentials
  • Click 'Apply Online' under Dashboard

Step 3: Select Course

  • Page 'Officers Selection - Eligibility' opens
  • Click 'Apply' against 'Short Service Commission JAG Entry Course'

Step 4: Fill Application Form

  • Read instructions carefully
  • Click 'Continue'
  • Fill following segments:
    • Personal Information
    • Communication Details
    • Education Details
    • Previous SSB Details (if any)

Step 5: Save & Continue

  • Click 'Save & Continue' after each segment
  • Don't skip any segment

Step 6: Review & Submit

  • Review 'Summary of your information'
  • Check all entries
  • Edit if required
  • Click 'Submit' only after ascertaining correctness
  • Must click 'Submit' each time for any editing

Step 7: Take Printouts

  • Wait 30 minutes after final closure on last day
  • Download 2 copies with Roll Number
  • One for SSB, one for reference

Important Application Notes

CRITICAL - Read Carefully:

  1. Name/DOB/Parents Name:

    • Must match Matriculation/SSC certificate EXACTLY
    • No variation accepted
    • Mismatch = Candidature cancelled

  2. CGPA Conversion:

    • Convert CGPA/Grades to percentage as per university formula
    • Use for filling 'Marks in Graduation'
    • Discrepancy at any stage = Cancellation

  3. No Changes After Submission:

    • Cannot edit after application closure
    • No representation entertained
    • Fill carefully

  4. Only One Application:

    • Multiple applications = Cancellation
    • No representation entertained

  5. CLAT PG 2025 Mandatory:

    • Must appear for CLAT PG 2025
    • Must verify at Selection Centre
    • Non-verification = Not eligible for SSB

  6. Armed Forces Candidates:

    • Must inform Commanding Officer in writing
    • Application countersigned by CO
    • Carry to SSB with all documents

Documents to Upload/Carry

For Online Application:

  • Recent passport size photograph
  • Signature
  • All educational certificates (scanned copies)

For SSB Interview (Originals + Self-attested Copies):

  1. Application printout (signed, with photo)
  2. Matriculation/SSC certificate & mark sheet
  3. 12th certificate & mark sheet
  4. Graduation degree/provisional degree
  5. LLB degree/provisional degree
  6. All semester/year mark sheets
  7. Bar Council registration OR BCI recognition certificate
  8. CGPA conversion certificate
  9. CLAT PG 2025 Score Card
  10. PAN card/Aadhaar/Passport (if parent name not on SSC certificate)

Provisional Degree Validity: Not more than 6 months old at Academy joining

Travelling Allowance & Entitlements

Entitlement for SSB Interview:

Category Entitlement
First Time Appearing (for this type of commission) AC 3-Tier to-and-fro railway fare OR bus fare (including reservation-cum-sleeper charges) within Indian Geographical Limits
Appearing Again (for same type of commission) NOT entitled to travelling allowance

For Queries: Contact concerned Selection Centre directly

Army Group Insurance Fund (AGIF):

  • Coverage: ₹1.25 Crore
  • Monthly subscription: ₹12,500/- (during training)
  • Disability benefits as applicable
  • Ex-gratia for disabilities below 20%

Important Instructions - Indian Army JAG Entry 2026

Eligibility Restrictions

NOT Eligible to Apply:

  1. Candidates debarred from UPSC examination
  2. Withdrawn from NDA/IMA/OTA/Naval/Air Force Academy on disciplinary grounds
  3. Arrested or convicted by criminal court
  4. Involved in any criminal case
  5. Married after application date

Critical Points

1. Marriage Restriction:

  • Unmarried status mandatory
  • Cannot marry during training
  • Marriage after application = Cancellation (even if SSB cleared)
  • Marriage during training = Discharge + refund of expenses

2. Document Verification:

  • Thorough verification at SSB
  • False information = Cancellation at any stage
  • Concealment = Cancellation even after selection

3. SSB Interview:

  • Date/Centre once selected cannot be changed
  • No request for change entertained
  • No representation replied

4. Last Hour Rush:

  • Queries received up to 3 days before closing date only entertained
  • Submit application early
  • Don't wait for last day

5. No Hard Copy:

  • No need to send hard copy to DG Recruiting
  • Keep second printout for reference

6. Information Source:

  • All updates on www.joinindianarmy.nic.in
  • Check regularly for:
    • Selection Centre allotment
    • Interview dates
    • Merit list
    • Joining instructions
  • Queries only through 'Feedback/Queries' option on website

7. Constitutional Restrictions:

  • Article 33 of Constitution of India applies
  • Personal restrictions as per Army Act & Rules
  • Applicable from date of joining

8. Language Version:

  • English version prevails in case of discrepancy with Hindi

Disclaimer: Information based on official notification for JAG Entry Scheme 124th Course (Oct 2026). Candidates are advised to refer to the official website for complete and latest information. CLAT PG 2025 mandatory for all applicants.

SAI Performance Analyst 2026 Vacancy Details

The total number of vacancies for SAI Performance Analyst Recruitment 2026 is 48 posts, distributed discipline-wise as follows:

  • Anthropometry: 1 post (UR: 1)
  • Biomechanics: 1 post (UR: 1)
  • Nutrition: 4 posts (UR: 3, OBC: 1)
  • Physiotherapy: 24 posts (UR: 12, OBC: 6, SC: 3, ST: 1, EWS: 2)
  • Physiology: 4 posts (UR: 3, OBC: 1)
  • Psychology: 4 posts (UR: 3, OBC: 1)
  • Strength & Conditioning: 10 posts (UR: 6, OBC: 2, SC: 1, EWS: 1)

Note: Initial place of posting or any subsequent posting does not confer any right against transfer; SAI reserves the final decision on postings.

Eligibility Criteria for SAI Performance Analyst 2026

1. Educational Qualification

  • Performance Analyst (Physiotherapy): Bachelors’ or Masters’ Degree in Physiotherapy from any recognized University/Institution; desirable 1 year experience in Sports Physiotherapy.
  • Performance Analyst (Physiology): Bachelors’ or Masters’ Degree in Medical Physiology / Human Physiology / Sports and Exercise Physiology / Biological Sciences; with specified equivalence for B.Sc. (CBZ) and Physiology; desirable 1 year experience in Sports Physiology.
  • Performance Analyst (Anthropometry): Bachelors’ or Masters’ Degree in Anthropology or Human Biology; desirable 1 year experience in Anthropometry in sports science.
  • Performance Analyst (Psychology): Bachelors’ or Masters’ Degree in Psychology / Clinical Psychology / Applied Psychology / Sports Psychology; desirable 1 year experience in Sports Psychology.
  • Performance Analyst (Strength & Conditioning): Bachelors’ or Masters’ Degree in Strength and Conditioning / Sports and Exercise Science / Sports Science; OR Bachelors’ or Masters’ Degree in Sports Coaching / Physical Education / Performance Coaching with specified Strength & Conditioning certifications (ACSM, NSCA-CSCS, ASCA, UKSCA, NCCA USCCA, NSNIS PG Diploma, NSDC Level 4/6/7, government-recognized gym/fitness certifications, EXOS with ACSM credits); desirable 1 year experience in Strength & Conditioning.
  • Performance Analyst (Nutrition): Bachelors’ or Masters’ Degree in Nutrition & Dietetics / Food Science & Nutrition / Sports Nutrition / Nutrition / Food & Nutrition / Food Nutrition & Dietetics / Clinical Nutrition & Dietetics / Home Science with specified Nutrition specializations; desirable 1 year experience in Sports Nutrition.
  • Performance Analyst (Biomechanics): Bachelors’ or Masters’ Degree in Biomechanics / Sports Biomechanics / Sports Biomechanics & Kinesiology / Kinesiology (with Biomechanics) / Exercise & Sports Sciences (with Biomechanics) / Human Movement Sciences / Sports Sciences (with Biomechanics) / Biophysics / Physiotherapy (MPT Sports Biomechanics) with Biomechanics as major subject; with specified equivalent Bachelor’s degrees; desirable 1 year experience in Biomechanics.

2. Age Limit

  • Maximum Age: Up to 30 years as on the opening date for submission of online application forms.
  • SC/ST: Relaxation up to 5 years.
  • OBC (Non-Creamy Layer): Relaxation up to 3 years.
  • Ex-servicemen: Relaxation as per Ex-servicemen (Re-employment in Civil Services and Posts) Rules, 1979.
  • Departmental/SAI contractual employees: Relaxation as per detailed SAI guidelines, including service-based cumulative relaxation.
  • Date of Birth Proof: As recorded in Matriculation/Secondary or equivalent certificates; no other documents accepted for age proof.

3. Nationality

Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply for SAI Performance Analyst posts.

Selection Process for SAI Performance Analyst 2026

The selection process will be based on a Computer-Based Test (CBT) with the following structure:

  • Mode: Computer-Based Test (CBT) in fully proctored environment with biometric authentication.
  • Duration: 2 hours.
  • Total Questions: 100 Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs).
  • Negative Marking: 1/4 of the marks assigned to a question for each incorrect answer.

Sections of CBT:

  • Section A (Common for all disciplines):
    • Basic Sports Science Knowledge (Section A1) – 32 marks.
    • General Sports Awareness (Section A2) – 8 marks.
    • Total: 40 marks.
  • Section B (Discipline-specific): Applied Sports Science Knowledge – 40 marks.
  • Section C (Discipline-specific): Sports-related Case Studies (passage/analytical) – 20 marks.

Final Merit List: Prepared solely on total CBT marks (out of 100). No additional weightage or supplementary evaluation is applied. Tie-breaking will follow sequential criteria based on marks in Sections C, B, A, A1, A2, then age (older candidate) and alphabetical order of name.

Application Fee for SAI Performance Analyst 2026

  • UR/EWS/OBC: Rs. 2000/- (including bank charges and service tax).
  • SC/ST/Ex-servicemen/Women: Rs. 1500/- (including bank charges and service tax).
  • Payment Mode: Online only via NEFT/RTGS/Net Banking/UPI etc., as per fee structure.
  • Refund Policy: Application fee once paid will not be refunded under any circumstances.

How to Apply for SAI Performance Analyst Recruitment 2026?

Eligible candidates can apply online for SAI Performance Analyst 2026 by following these steps:

  1. Visit the SAI official website: https://sportsauthorityofindia.nic.in/
  2. Open the online application format available through the specified link.
  3. Ensure you have a valid email ID which remains active till completion of the recruitment process.
  4. Keep scanned copies ready:
    • Recent passport-size colour photograph (JPG/JPEG, max 80 KB).
    • Signature (JPG/JPEG, max 30 KB).
  5. Fill in all details in the online application form carefully.
  6. Upload mandatory documents:
    • Proof of age certificate.
    • Valid Government of India ID proof.
    • Certificates in support of essential educational qualifications.
    • Caste/Category certificates (SC/ST/OBC/EWS/Ex-servicemen etc.) in prescribed format, if applicable.
    • Certificate showing contractual period with SAI (for relaxation), issued by competent authority, if applicable.
  7. Pay the application fee online using NEFT/RTGS/Net Banking/UPI as per category.
  8. Submit the online application form on or before 09.03.2026 (5 P.M.).
  9. Download and safely preserve the registration slip generated by the system containing the unique registration number and password for future reference.

Vacancy Details

Container Corporation of India (CONCOR) is recruiting for 5 posts in the Finance & Accounts department on an immediate absorption basis. This is a special recruitment drive for experienced professionals already working in Government/PSU/State Government organizations. All posts are on a permanent/regular basis.

Post Name Grade No. of Vacancies Pay Scale (IDA)

Eligibility Criteria

Immediate Absorption Basis: This recruitment is only for candidates currently working in Central Government / State Government / PSU / Other Government organizations on regular basis.

1. Senior Manager (Finance & Accounts) - E-4 Grade

Essential Qualification: Graduate with CA (Chartered Accountant) from ICAI or CMA (Cost Management Accountant) from ICMAI with valid membership.

Experience: Minimum 8 years post-qualification experience AND currently working in IDA pay scale ₹70,000-2,00,000 / Pay Matrix Level 11 (7th CPC) or above, OR minimum 2 years experience in lower IDA pay scale ₹60,000-1,80,000 / Pay Matrix Level 10 (7th CPC).

2. Manager (Finance & Accounts) - E-3 Grade (2 Posts)

Essential Qualification: Graduate with CA (Chartered Accountant) from ICAI or CMA (Cost Management Accountant) from ICMAI with valid membership.

Experience: Minimum 5 years post-qualification experience AND currently working in IDA pay scale ₹60,000-1,80,000 / Pay Matrix Level 10 (7th CPC) or above, OR minimum 2 years experience in lower IDA pay scale ₹50,000-1,60,000 / Pay Matrix Level 9 (7th CPC).

Age Limit: Maximum 37 years as on 12-03-2026

3. Manager (Finance & Accounts/Compliance) - E-3 Grade (1 Post)

Essential Qualification: Graduate with CS (Company Secretary) from ICSI (Institute of Company Secretaries of India) with valid membership.

Experience: Minimum 5 years post-qualification experience AND currently working in IDA pay scale ₹60,000-1,80,000 / Pay Matrix Level 10 (7th CPC) or above, OR minimum 2 years experience in lower IDA pay scale ₹50,000-1,60,000 / Pay Matrix Level 9 (7th CPC).

Age Limit: Maximum 37 years as on 12-03-2026

4. Junior Officer (Finance & Accounts) - S-2 Grade (1 Post)

Essential Qualification: Graduate with CA Intermediate from ICAI or CMA Intermediate from ICMAI.

Experience: Minimum 5 years post-qualification experience AND currently working in IDA pay scale ₹44,000-1,53,000 / Pay Matrix Level 7 (7th CPC) or above, OR minimum 2 years experience in lower IDA pay scale ₹40,000-1,36,000 / Pay Matrix Level 6 (7th CPC).

Age Limit: Maximum 37 years as on 12-03-2026

Important Notes:

  • Post/pay-scale held on temporary, contract, adhoc, deputation, non-functional upgradation, or MACP financial upgradation basis shall not be considered for eligibility.
  • All qualifications must be recognized by Government of India.
  • All qualifications must be from Universities/Institutions recognized by AICTE/UGC/appropriate statutory authority of Government of India.
  • Candidates on deputation to other organizations must satisfy eligibility conditions based on parent organization.
  • The cutoff date for age, experience, and qualification is 12-03-2026.

Selection Process

The selection process for CONCOR Recruitment 2026 will be based on the following:

  1. Shortlisting: Only candidates fulfilling all eligibility criteria will be shortlisted. In case of large number of eligible applicants, CONCOR reserves the right to shortlist limited candidates based on relevant qualifications, additional professional qualifications, experience, and achievements.
  2. Interview/Power Point Presentation (PPT): Shortlisted candidates will be called for interview and/or power point presentation.
  3. Performance Assessment: Assessment based on APARs (Annual Performance Appraisal Reports) for the preceding three years.
  4. Weightage Criteria: Weightage will be given to APAR ratings, experience profile, additional professional qualifications, and personality traits as per extant policy.
  5. Reservation: Reservation rules are NOT applicable for immediate absorption recruitment.
  6. Communication: Names of shortlisted candidates will be displayed on www.concorindia.co.in. Email notifications will be sent to shortlisted candidates.

Important: CONCOR reserves the right to modify or amend any part of the selection process at any stage before the interview.

Salary/Stipend

The selected candidates will be offered competitive compensation packages as per the following pay scales:

Post Grade Pay Scale (IDA) Basic + DA

  • Leased accommodation or HRA

  • Performance-related pay
  • Medical facilities and group insurance
  • Pension and CPF benefits
  • Post-retirement medical benefits
  • Gratuity as per extant policies

How to Apply

Application Process: This is an offline recruitment on immediate absorption basis. Applications must be submitted through the proper channel of the candidate's parent organization.

IIT Delhi Project Scientist 2026 Vacancy Details

Eligibility Criteria for IIT Delhi Project Scientist 2026

1. Educational Qualification

Candidates must have the following qualifications to be eligible for the Project Scientist position:

  • M.Sc. degree in Biochemistry, Microbiology, Biotechnology, or Genetics with a first-class academic record.
  • Applicants must have qualified NET or GATE.
  • Candidates with a minimum of two years of research experience in Tuberculosis (TB) will be preferred.

2. Experience

Candidates having at least two years of research experience in the area of Tuberculosis (TB) will be given preference for this project post.

3. Nationality

Applications are invited from Indian nationals only.

  • Candidates must bring duly filled Form No. IRD/REC-4 and all original certificates (academic and professional) for verification.

Salary/Stipend for IIT Delhi Project Scientist 2026

  • Post: Project Scientist

Eligibility Criteria

Essential Qualifications & Experience (for Both Promotion and Deputation)

  • Educational Qualification: Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering from a recognized University or Institute
  • Service Experience: 17 years regular service in the post carrying substantive pay scale of Level 10 of Pay Matrix (Rs. 56,100 - 177,500) or equivalent level or higher
  • Infrastructure Experience: Out of the 17 years service, at least 10 years experience in implementation of Infrastructure Sector Projects related to Highways, Roads, or Bridges

Desirable Qualifications

  • Experience in handling Public Private Partnership (PPP) Projects
  • Experience in mega highway/infrastructure development projects
  • Experience in project management and execution

Recruitment Routes

Route 1: By Promotion (Internal NHAI Candidates)

Eligibility Criteria:

  • Holding the post of General Manager (Technical) at NHAI on regular basis
  • Regular service for a period of 3 (three) years in the post of General Manager (Technical)
  • 17 years regular service in the post carrying substantive pay scale of Level 10 of Pay Matrix (Rs. 56,100 - 177,500) or equivalent level or higher
  • Out of 17 years, at least 10 years experience in implementation of Infrastructure Sector Projects related to Highways/Roads/Bridges

Special Relaxation: One-time relaxation is given for counting deputation service as regular service while calculating 17 years service requirement as per NHAI (Recruitment, Seniority and Promotion) Regulations, 2024.

Route 2: By Deputation (Central Government / State Government / PSUs / Institutions)

2A. From Central Government or State Governments or Union Territories or Universities or Recognized Research Institutions or Public Sector Undertakings or Semi Government or Statutory or Autonomous Organizations:

Eligibility - Option 1:

  • Holding analogous post on regular basis in parent cadre at Level 14 of Pay Matrix (Rs. 144,200 to 218,200) or equivalent
  • Possessing essential educational qualification and essential experience as stipulated

OR Eligibility - Option 2:

  • With 3 years regular service in the grade rendered after appointment on regular basis in Level 13 of Pay Matrix (Rs. 123,100 to 215,900) or equivalent
  • Possessing essential educational qualification and essential experience as stipulated

2B. From State Public Works Departments (PWD):

Eligibility Criteria:

  • Holding Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering from a recognized University or Institute
  • Holding the post of Chief Engineer on regular basis, OR should have worked as Superintending Engineer on regular basis for at least 3 (three) years
  • 17 years regular service in the post carrying substantive pay scale of Level 10 of Pay Matrix (Rs. 56,100 - 177,500) or equivalent level or higher
  • Out of the 17 years service, at least 10 years experience in implementation of Infrastructure Sector Projects related to Highways/Roads/Bridges

Age Limit

  • For Deputation: Not exceeding 58 years as on the last date for receipt of applications (06-03-2026)
  • Remaining Service: Candidates must have more than 02 years of remaining service before superannuation in parent department as on closing date of applications

Salary & Pay Structure

Component Amount

Basic Pay Range Rs. 144,200/- to Rs. 218,200/- per month
Dearness Allowance (DA) As per Government of India norms
Other Allowances As applicable to Group-A central government posts
Pension & Benefits As per Government of India rules

Deputation Terms & Conditions

  • Initial Deputation Period: 1 to 5 years (can be decided with approval of NHAI Chairman)
  • Extension (6th Year): May be extended with approval of Secretary, Ministry of Road Transport & Highways
  • Extension (7th Year): May be extended with approval of Hon'ble Minister for Road Transport & Highways, subject to satisfactory performance
  • Special Provision: Officers of Central Engineering Service (Roads), Ministry of RMH can have maximum deputation of 10 years up to 31.12.2026, thereafter maximum 7 years
  • Service Credit: Period of deputation already served in NHAI on deputation shall be counted for remaining approved deputation tenure only

Detailed Eligibility Checklist

For Promotion Route:

  • Currently holding post of General Manager (Technical) at NHAI
  • 3 years regular service as GM(Technical) in NHAI
  • 17 years regular service in Level 10 or higher post
  • 10 years of those 17 years in highway/road/bridge infrastructure projects
  • B.Tech in Civil Engineering from recognized institute

For Deputation Route (Central/State Government/PSU/Institute):

  • Holding Level 14 equivalent post, OR 3+ years in Level 13 equivalent post
  • B.Tech in Civil Engineering from recognized institute
  • 17 years regular service in Level 10 or higher post
  • 10 years of those 17 years in highway/road/bridge infrastructure projects
  • Not exceeding 58 years age as on 06-03-2026
  • More than 2 years remaining service before retirement

For Deputation Route (State PWD):

  • B.Tech in Civil Engineering from recognized institute
  • Chief Engineer on regular basis, OR Superintending Engineer for 3+ years on regular basis
  • 17 years regular service in Level 10 or higher post
  • 10 years of those 17 years in highway/road/bridge infrastructure projects
  • Not exceeding 58 years age as on 06-03-2026
  • More than 2 years remaining service before retirement

Important Dates

Event Date & Time
Opening Date for Online Registration of Application 07-02-2026 (10:00 AM) [Saturday]
Last Date for submission of Online Application 06-03-2026 (6:00 PM) [Friday]
Last Date for submission of Printout of Online application along with requisite documents from Parent Department 21-03-2026 [Saturday]
Meeting of Search-cum-Selection Committee (SCSC) To be announced later

Important Note on Dates:

NHAI at its discretion may extend the date of accepting the printout copy of application along with requisite documents from Parent Departments by 7 days prior to the Meeting of Search-cum-Selection Committee.

Selection Process

  • Search-cum-Selection Committee (SCSC): Selection will be done through SCSC consisting of senior government officials and NHAI representatives
  • Evaluation Criteria: Academic qualifications, professional experience, project management capabilities, track record in highway/infrastructure projects, and suitability for the position
  • Interview: Selected candidates may be called for interview/interaction with SCSC
  • Merit-Based Selection: Selection will be purely on merit basis based on experience, qualifications, and suitability
  • Vigilance Clearance: In case of selection, applicants must furnish fresh vigilance clearance before joining (especially for those who had applied in previous advertisement)

How to Apply

Application Method:

Candidates must apply ONLINE through the official NHAI portal. No offline applications will be accepted.

Step-by-Step Application Process:

  1. Visit the official NHAI website: www.nhai.gov.in
  2. Look for the recruitment notification or careers section
  3. Register for online application (if not already registered)
  4. Fill in all required details accurately including:
    • Personal information
    • Educational qualifications
    • Employment history and service details
    • Years of experience in highway/infrastructure projects
    • Current pay level and designation
  5. Upload scanned documents (PDF format, as required):
    • Recent passport-sized photograph
    • Copies of degree certificates
    • Service certificates and experience details
    • Proof of years of service in infrastructure projects
  6. Submit the online application before 06-03-2026 at 6:00 PM
  7. Take printout of the submitted application
  8. Send the printed application along with documents through proper channel from parent department by 21-03-2026

Required Documents to Submit (Through Proper Channel):

  • Printout of online submitted application
  • Service certificates showing:
    • Total years of service
    • Designation history
    • Pay scale at different levels
    • Details of 10 years infrastructure/highway project experience
  • Educational certificates (B.Tech in Civil Engineering)
  • Proof of current pay level
  • Character certificate from employer
  • Vigilance report from parent organization
  • Medical fitness certificate (if required)
  • Any other relevant documents supporting credentials

Important Instructions for Applicants

  1. All India Service Liability: This post carries all India service liability. Only those willing to serve anywhere in India should apply
  2. No Withdrawal: Applicants cannot withdraw candidature after submission. Selected candidates must accept the appointment. Declining the offer will make them ineligible for NHAI appointments for 2 years
  3. Age & Service Verification: Crucial date for eligibility determination is 06-03-2026. Candidates must verify they meet all age and service criteria on this date
  4. Deputation Requirements: For deputation, candidates must have more than 2 years remaining service before superannuation
  5. Previous Applicants: Candidates who applied under the previous advertisement dated 03.07.2025 need not apply again; their candidature will be carried forward
  6. Pay Equivalency: Officers from PSUs/Public Sector Banks should refer to NHAI circulars regarding pay structure equivalency (CDA vs IDA vs Public Sector Banks)
  7. SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PwBD: Candidates from SC, ST, OBC (NCL), EWS, Minority Community, Women, and Persons with Benchmark Disabilities are encouraged to apply
  8. Persons with Disabilities: PwBD candidates can apply even if post is not reserved, but will be considered on general merit. Must have ≥40% relevant disability for reservation benefits

  • CISM (Certified Information Security Manager)

  • Minimum 5 years of relevant cyber security experience in reputed companies/organizations.

Preference

  • Multiple certifications from the above list will be considered an added advantage.

SPMCIL Young Professional Age Limit

  • Maximum age: 35 years as on 07-02-2026.
  • Candidates born on or after 07-02-1991 are eligible.
  • Age relaxation applicable as per Government of India guidelines for SC/ST/OBC/PwBD categories.

SPMCIL Young Professional Salary & Benefits

Monthly Remuneration Rs. 50,000/- (all inclusive)
Annual Increment 8% annual increase in remuneration
Leave Entitlement 1 day paid leave for every 20 days of work
Mediclaim Reimbursement Up to Rs. 2,00,000/- premium reimbursement for group mediclaim policy (self, spouse, dependent children) for engagement exceeding 6 months
TA/DA for Official Duty As per E-1 level officer standards for out-station deputation (no TA/DA for joining/completion)
Other Benefits No DA, accommodation, telephone, conveyance, transport, personal staff, or other medical reimbursement.

Service Conditions

  • Leave can be availed only after it becomes due and with approval of the controlling officer.
  • No TA/DA for joining or completion of assignment; admissible only for official duty tours.
  • Mediclaim premium reimbursement up to Rs. 2 lakh for self, spouse and dependent children for engagements longer than 6 months.
  • No other allowances or benefits apart from what is mentioned in the notification.

Key Responsibilities & Duties

A. Security Architecture and Design

  • Develop and maintain robust cyber security architecture aligned with NIST, ISO 27001 and other industry best practices.
  • Design and implement secure solutions for network segmentation, threat detection and incident response across IT and OT environments.
  • Collaborate with IT and OT teams to integrate cyber security controls into existing and upcoming systems.
  • Stay updated on emerging threats, vulnerabilities and technologies and recommend necessary infrastructure enhancements.

B. Vulnerability Management

  • Conduct regular vulnerability assessments and penetration testing of IT and OT systems and networks.
  • Develop and monitor remediation plans for identified vulnerabilities.
  • Coordinate with internal teams and vendors for timely patching and system updates.

C. Threat Detection and Incident Response

  • Implement and continuously monitor security tools (IDS/IPS, SIEM) to detect anomalies and potential threats.
  • Lead cyber security incident response activities ensuring prompt containment, mitigation and post-incident analysis.
  • Develop and maintain incident response playbooks and conduct forensic investigations when required.

D. Risk Management and Compliance

  • Perform cyber risk assessments to identify threats and evaluate operational impact.
  • Ensure adherence to national/international standards, guidelines and data protection laws including CERT-In guidelines.
  • Develop, update and enforce cyber security policies, procedures and standards.
  • Lead internal audits and report findings to senior management.

E. Awareness and Training

  • Design and deliver cyber security awareness programs for staff, contractors and third-party vendors.
  • Create security campaigns and materials to promote a security-aware culture across the organization.

F. Collaboration and Reporting

  • Coordinate with IT, OT and functional departments to ensure a secure operational environment.
  • Prepare and present risk posture reports, threat intelligence and mitigation strategies to senior management.

Required Skill Set

  • Strong knowledge of cyber security concepts, principles and frameworks (NIST, ISO 27001, CIS Controls).
  • Hands-on experience with:
    • Firewalls, IDS/IPS, Endpoint Protection Platforms
    • SIEM tools (e.g. Forti SIEM, Splunk)
    • Vulnerability scanners (e.g. Nessus, Qualys)
    • Incident response and digital forensics tools
  • Proficiency in risk assessment methodologies and compliance frameworks.
  • Strong problem-solving, analytical and incident handling capabilities.
  • Excellent communication skills to convey complex technical details to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Knowledge of IT and OT environment security.
  • Understanding of CERT-In guidelines and national cyber security frameworks.

Important General Conditions

  • Engagement is purely on fixed-term contract (temporary basis) and does not confer any right to permanent employment.
  • Appointment is on full-time basis; candidates are not permitted to take up any other assignment during the contract period.
  • SPMCIL reserves the right to terminate the contract at any time without assigning any reason.
  • Completion of tenure will not give any claim for future regular appointment in SPMCIL.
  • Tenure is 3 years, extendable based on performance or liable to be terminated earlier.
  • If engagement falls during election period, it will be regulated as per Election Commission of India guidelines.

SPMCIL Young Professional Selection Process

  • Scrutiny of applications for eligibility based on educational qualification, experience and professional certifications.
  • Merit-based shortlisting as per qualification and experience profile.
  • Screening process may consist of written test followed by interview or only interview as decided by the Management.
  • Document verification of all original certificates at the time of screening/interview.
  • Final selection based on interview performance and overall suitability for the role.

How to Apply for SPMCIL Young Professional Recruitment 2026

Application Mode: Online only through SPMCIL website.

Application Period: 07-02-2026 (10:00 AM) to 06-03-2026 (5:00 PM)

Steps to Apply Online

  1. Visit the official website: www.spmcil.com.
  2. Click on the “Career” link available on the home page.
  3. Click on the “ONLINE APPLICATION” button for Young Professional – Cyber Security Expert.
  4. Fill in all required details in the online application form carefully.
  5. Upload all required documents (educational certificates, experience certificates, professional certifications, photograph, signature, etc.).
  6. Submit the application form and wait for server confirmation (do not press back or refresh after submission).
  7. Take a printout of the submitted application form for future reference.

Offline/any other mode of application will not be accepted. Candidates are advised to regularly visit the official website for updates on screening, interview schedule and selection list.

Documents Required

  • B.E./B.Tech degree certificate and all semester mark sheets.
  • Proof of 60% marks or equivalent CGPA (conversion to percentage if only CGPA/grades are awarded).
  • Professional certification(s) – CEH/CCSP/CISSP/CompTIA CySA+/GSEC/OSCP/CISM (scanned copies).
  • Experience certificates from all previous and current employers proving minimum 5 years cyber security experience.
  • Updated detailed resume/CV highlighting cyber security expertise and achievements.
  • 10th/12th certificate as proof of date of birth.
  • Valid photo ID proof (Aadhar/PAN/Voter ID/Passport/Driving License).
  • Caste certificate (SC/ST/OBC) or PwBD certificate, if applicable, in prescribed format.
  • Disability certificate issued by competent medical board (for PwBD).
  • Recent passport-size photographs as per specifications in notification.

Selection Process for CSIR-NPL Recruitment 2026

The selection for CSIR-NPL vacancy 2026 will be conducted through following stages:

Stage 1 - Screening by Committee

  • Applications will be scrutinized by duly constituted Screening Committee
  • Committee will adopt its own criteria for shortlisting candidates
  • Only shortlisted candidates called for Trade Test

Stage 2 - Trade Test (Qualifying Nature)

  • Trade test in relevant trade/discipline
  • Schedule: May/June 2026
  • Nature: Qualifying test
  • Minimum threshold marks to be determined by Selection Committee
  • Only candidates qualifying in Trade Test will be called for Written Examination

Stage 3 - Competitive Written Examination

Mode: OMR Based or Computer Based Objective Type Multiple Choice Examination

Medium: Questions in both English and Hindi (except English Language questions)

Standard: Diploma/Graduation Level

Total Questions: 200

Total Time: 3 hours

Examination Pattern:

Paper-I (Mental Ability Test) - 1 Hour, Qualifying

  • Questions: 50
  • Maximum Marks: 100 (2 marks per correct answer)
  • Negative Marking: None
  • Topics: General Intelligence, Quantitative Aptitude, Reasoning, Problem Solving, Situational Judgement

Paper-II - 30 Minutes

  • General Awareness: 25 questions, 75 marks (3 marks each), 1 negative mark per wrong answer
  • English Language: 25 questions, 75 marks (3 marks each), 1 negative mark per wrong answer
  • Total: 50 questions, 150 marks

Paper-III (Concerned Subject) - 90 Minutes

  • Questions: 100
  • Maximum Marks: 300 (3 marks per correct answer)
  • Negative Marking: 1 mark per wrong answer
  • Topics: Concerned subject as per post code applied

Merit List Preparation:

  • Paper-I is qualifying in nature
  • Paper-II and Paper-III evaluated only for candidates securing minimum threshold marks in Paper-I
  • Final merit based on performance in Paper-II and Paper-III combined
  • Minimum threshold marks (Cut-off) will be notified before written exam

Tie Resolution (in order of precedence):

  1. Higher marks in concerned subject/trade papers
  2. Lesser negative marks in concerned subject/trade
  3. Lesser negative marks in all evaluated papers
  4. Older candidate (Date of Birth)
  5. Earlier acquisition of Essential Degree
  6. Alphabetical order of first names

NeGD SIDH Recruitment 2026 – Eligibility & Roles

1. Data & Analytics Lead

Job Title Data & Analytics Lead
Location New Delhi
Project SIDH
Experience 8+ years (with minimum 3 years leading analytics initiatives)
Budget As per market standards

Educational Qualifications

  • B.Tech./M.Tech/M.S./PhD in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, or related quantitative field (advanced degree preferred).
  • Minimum 8+ years in data analytics, business intelligence, or quantitative research with at least 3 years leading analytics initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and implement analytics frameworks for platform performance and user behaviour monitoring aligned with SIDH Digital Public Infrastructure objectives.
  • Oversee real-time dashboards on skill acquisition, certification, employment outcomes, and scheme effectiveness across government programmes.
  • Establish data governance protocols ensuring compliance with data privacy regulations, including the Digital Personal Data Protection Act.
  • Drive predictive analytics to forecast skilling demand, optimise resource allocation, and identify emerging skill gaps.
  • Translate complex data insights into policy recommendations for MSDE and stakeholders.
  • Manage data quality assurance across integrated platforms.
  • Develop advanced analytics models for personalised learning pathways and career guidance.
  • Coordinate integration of external systems (Aadhaar eKYC, DigiLocker, PFMS, etc.) into SIDH data lake/warehouse.

Essential Skills

  • Data engineering & orchestration on AWS: Informatica 10.5.4, Airflow, Jenkins, Kafka, PySpark/Spark.
  • Data lakes/warehouses: S3, Redshift/Snowflake, SQL/NoSQL (Postgres, Mongo, Cassandra).
  • BI & Reporting: Power BI.
  • Advanced analytics: Python/R for ML, NLP, forecasting, experimentation.

Desirable Skills

  • Tableau/QuickSight, Elasticsearch; Delta/Iceberg lakehouse, Glue Catalog.
  • MLOps (SageMaker/MLflow), unstructured/NLP analytics.
  • Certifications like AWS Data Analytics, Azure Data Engineer, Power BI, and prior public sector analytics experience.

2. UI/UX Lead

Job Title UI/UX Lead
Location New Delhi
Project SIDH
Experience 8+ years in UI/UX with at least 5 years in a senior designer role
Budget As per market standards

Experience & Role

  • 8+ years in UI/UX design with 5+ years in senior role; experience in large corporations or government IT organisations.
  • Lead design strategy, user research, wireframing, prototyping, and visual design for web and mobile platforms.
  • Work closely with product, development, BA, and stakeholder teams to deliver user-centric solutions.
  • Drive user research, usability testing, heuristic evaluations, and adoption of responsive design frameworks.

Key Responsibilities

  • Ensure adherence to accessibility (WCAG), GIGW 3.0, and design system standards.
  • Translate user and business needs into intuitive, consistent interfaces.
  • Mentor junior UI/UX designers and ensure quality control in all deliverables.
  • Create social media posts, newsletters, banners, and digital creatives.
  • Identify and troubleshoot UX problems; create wireframes, prototypes, storyboards, and user flows.

Tools & Skills

  • Proficiency in Figma, Adobe XD, Sketch, or similar tools.
  • Knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript for better developer collaboration.
  • Familiarity with testing/analytics tools like Hotjar, Maze.
  • Strong grasp of mobile-first, responsive design and visual style standards.

Educational Qualification & Desirables

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s in Design, HCI, Fine Arts, Visual Design/Communication, Design Computing, or related field.
  • Desirable: Experience in government/large-scale/citizen-facing platforms; agile environment exposure; tools like ClickUp, JIRA, Confluence, Trello; UI/UX/Interaction Design certifications.

NeGD SIDH Contract Jobs 2026 – General Conditions

  • Candidates already in Central/State Govt., PSUs, or Autonomous Bodies should apply through proper channel or submit a No Objection Certificate (NOC) at application or interview stage.
  • Posts are purely temporary for NeGD/DIC projects; no claim for permanent appointment in NeGD/DIC.
  • NeGD may fill all/some/none of the positions and may terminate appointments with one month’s notice or salary in lieu.
  • Designation mapping will be as per NeGD’s existing designation policy.

How to Apply Online for NeGD SIDH Recruitment 2026

  1. Check eligibility: Confirm that you meet the required qualifications, experience, and age criteria (not more than 55 years on the closing date).
  2. Visit the online application portal: Go to https://ora.digitalindiacorporation.in/ from a desktop or mobile browser.
  3. Register / Login: Create a new user account (if required) with a valid email ID and mobile number, or log in with existing credentials.
  4. Select the post: Choose the relevant position (Data & Analytics Lead or UI/UX Lead) under NeGD SIDH recruitment and open the online form.
  5. Fill the application form: Enter personal details, academic qualifications, total and relevant experience, and project-specific skills accurately; upload your latest CV/resume if required.
  6. Upload documents: Attach necessary documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, and NOC (if employed in Govt./PSU/Autonomous Body), as per portal instructions.
  7. Submit the form: Review all details carefully and submit the online application before the last date; keep a copy/print of the final submitted form or acknowledgment for future reference.

Important: Screening will be based on qualifications, age, and relevant experience, and NeGD may fix higher cut-offs; only shortlisted candidates will be called for interview, and NeGD reserves the right not to select any candidate.

Vacancy Details

Post Name No. of Posts
Consultant in CCCS Division 02

Eligibility Criteria

  • Qualification: Graduate or higher degree in any field.
  • Essential Qualification: The applicant should only be an Indian national. The applicant must have a graduate or higher degree in any field.
  • Desirable Qualification: Knowledge of Chinese language (HSK level 4 to 6) is desirable. Relevant publications/writings in reputed journals /periodicals.
  • Experience: Previous work experience of handling issues relating to foreign policy/international relations, especially related to China and the party politics in China. Extra credit may be given for experience of work in reputed university, think-tank or research organization in the area of foreign policy, international affairs or China related issues.

Salary/ Stipend

  • The remuneration package will be commensurate with the experience and profile of the selected candidate, subject to a maximum of Rs. 12,00,000/- (Rupees Twelve lakh only) per annum each and deduction of applicable taxes. The amount of consultancy fee so fixed shall remain unchanged during the term of engagement.

Age Limit (as on 03-03-2026)

  • The applicant should not be more than 50 years of age as on the last date of submission of application.

Important Dates

Event Date
Notification Date 9 February 2026
Last Date for Receiving Applications 3 March 2026

Selection Process

  • Ministry of External Affairs will review the applications and shortlist the candidates for interview / written test. The shortlisted candidates will be intimated by email.
  • The date, time and venue of the interview will be conveyed through email at the email address provided by the applicants.
  • The decision of the Government regarding selection of candidate will be final.

General Information/ Instructions

  • The engagement will be strictly contractual and will not confer any other benefits to the selected candidate.
  • The Consultant shall not be entitled to any benefit like Provident Fund, Pension, Gratuity, Medical Attendance Treatment, Seniority, Promotion etc. or any other benefits available to the regular employees of the Ministry.
  • No HRA shall be admissible.
  • The engagement of the Consultant is on full time basis. Normal working hours will be from 0900 to 1730 hrs. Working hours is subject to change from time to time. Saturdays/Sundays will remain closed as weekend off. In exigencies, he/she may be required to work beyond office hours and/or on closed holidays. No extra allowance or remuneration for such work is admissible. He/She shall not accept any other professional appointment, paid or otherwise during the term of engagement with this Ministry.
  • Paid leave of absence may be allowed to the rate of 1.5 days for each completed month of service. Accumulation of leave beyond a calendar year may not be allowed. Leave cannot be claimed as a matter of right. Leave will not be allowed for more than 10 days at a time. Discretion is reserved to the Head of Division to refuse or revoke leave in the public interest. Leave encashment will not be permissible on unspent leave. Unspent leave will lapse on commencement of notice period. No other leave of any kind shall be admissible to him/her. In case he/she remains absent from duty beyond entitled leave, a proportionate deduction from the consolidated fee as applicable will be made.
  • In case the Consultant is required to travel as part of his/her duties, the Ministry will take care of his/her travel, accommodation and per-diem costs, as per Ministry’s guidelines.
  • The selected person will be required to enter into a contract with the Ministry in a prescribed format w.e.f. the actual date of engagement as Consultant.
  • Period of Consultancy: 01 (One) year. The contract can be extended further depending on assessment of performance, mutual willingness and the requirement. The contract may be terminated on one month’s notice from either side or on payment of one month’s pay in lieu thereof. Unauthorized absence may lead to termination of the engagement.
  • Job Location: Ministry of External Affairs (South Block, Patiala House, JNB, ISIL Building, SSB, CCS Building), New Delhi.
  • Nature of duties: The Selected Consultant will be required to work in the Centre of Contemporary China Studies (CCCS) in the Ministry. His/Her duties will entail regular monitoring of information relevant to foreign Policy formulation, and providing knowledge-based inputs for the same. He/She will be required to summarize and analyze published material in the areas assigned to them, as it appears in media or academic journals. He/She will be required to undertake translation projects of news reports and other material. He/She will also be required to attend important seminars, meeting and conferences relevant to the work of Ministry, and submit reports on them. He/She time to time, may also be asked to undertake research on specific foreign policy related issues.

How to Apply

  • The applicants who fulfill the eligibility criteria may submit application indicating their interest in working for the Ministry of External Affairs as per proforma at Annexure I.
  • Documents / certificates in support of educational qualifications, experience in Govt. service should be attached with the application.
  • Applications along with supporting documents can be submitted to the Ministry through either of the following modes:
  • OFFLINE MODE:- By registered post in an envelope labelled as “Application for the position of Consultant in CCCS Division of Ministry of External Affairs”. This is to be sent to the following address: Under Secretary (PF&PG) Ministry of External Affairs, Room No. 4071, Jawaharlal Nehru Bhawan, 23-D, Janpath, New Delhi-110011
  • ONLINE MODE:- Through email with the subject clearly mentioning the name of the candidate and the name of position against which the application is being submitted. The email is to be sent to the following email address: [email protected]
  • Incomplete application and those received without supporting documents will be summarily rejected.
  • Applicants will have to make their own arrangements to reach the place of interview.
  • No TA/DA will be payable by the Ministry to Applicants for attending interview.

  • Phase I - Online Common Entrance Exam (CEE): Conducted at Computer based test centres. This will be conducted for provisionally shortlisted candidates.   • Phase II - Recruitment Rally: Proportionate to the vacancies available candidates would be shortlisted based on the aggregate marks scored in the CEE.   • 1.6 Km Run
