Eligibility Criteria

Team Leader (Safety) - CP/01/26

  • Qualification: Full time Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering
  • Experience: Minimum 15 years' experience in high rise buildings/KWA projects/Irrigation/shore protection/Harbour projects with experience of managing and working in the field of health and safety
  • Essential: Candidates should hold OSHA or NEBOSH certification

Team Leader (Civil) - CP/02/26

  • Qualification: Full time Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering
  • Experience: Minimum 15 years' experience in high rise buildings/KWA Projects with experience in handling engineering aspects including interface coordination

Team Leader (MEP) - CP/03/26

  • Qualification: Full time Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent OR Full time Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent
  • Experience: Minimum 15 years' experience in high rise building projects/KWA projects with experience in handling engineering and overall coordination
  • Essential: Should have a good knowledge in Electrical/HVAC/Fire fighting ELV & Plumbing system including interface coordination

Team Leader (QC) - CP/04/26

  • Qualification: Full time Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering
  • Experience: Minimum 15 years' experience in high rise building projects/KWA projects with experience in the field of quality control
  • Essential: Shall possess experience in quality assurance/control, auditing design projects, developing QMS, and inspection/testing/product conformity. The concerned should be a Certified Quality Auditor (CQA)

Project Engineer (Civil) - CP/05/26

  • Qualification: Full time Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering
  • Experience: Minimum 7 years' experience in Building/water supply/shore protection works/waterways/irrigation/Harbour, etc.

Project Engineer (MEP) - CP/06/26

  • Qualification: Full time Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent OR Full time Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent
  • Experience: Minimum 7 years' experience in Electrical/HVAC/Fire fighting ELV & Plumbing system including interface coordination

Junior Engineer (Civil) - CL/01/26

  • Qualification: Full time Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering OR Full Time Diploma in Civil Engineering
  • Experience: Minimum 7 years' experience for diploma holders and 05 years for degree holders, with specific experience in relevant project category (Building/water supply/shore protection works/waterways/irrigation/Harbour)

Junior Engineer (MEP) - CL/02/26

  • Qualification: Full time Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent OR Full Time Diploma in Engineering in Electrical/Electrical & Electronics
  • Experience: Minimum 7 years' experience for diploma holders and 05 years for degree holders, in electrical Engineering with specific experience in relevant project category (Building/water supply/shore protection works/waterways/irrigation/Harbour Electrical/HVAC/Fire Fighting, ELV & Plumbing systems)

Important Notes on Qualification

  • The period of training/internship/teaching/academic/fellowship/PhD research experience shall not be counted towards post qualification experience
  • The candidate should possess Degree recognized by AICTE; from a University incorporated by an Act of Central or State legislature in India or other Educational Institutions established by an Act of Parliament or declared to be Deemed as University under Section 3 of the University Grants Commission Act, 1956
  • Sections A & B examinations of the Institution of Engineers (India), with enrolment on or before 31.05.2013, which is treated as equivalent to Degree by the Government of India and recognized by AICTE shall be accepted
  • Experience shall be calculated as on 26.02.2026

Salary/Stipend

For Team Leaders (CP/01/26 to CP/04/26)

  • Pay Scale: Rs. 70,000 - Rs. 2,00,000
  • Approximate CTC: Rs. 19.85 Lakhs Per Annum
  • Components: Basic pay and DA, fixed/variable allowances 23% of Basic Pay, HRA/Lease, Contribution to PF, Gratuity as per Payment of Gratuity Act

For Project Engineers (CP/05/26 to CP/06/26)

  • Pay Scale: Rs. 50,000 – Rs. 1,60,000
  • Approximate CTC: Rs. 14.22 Lakhs Per Annum
  • Components: Basic pay and DA, fixed/variable allowances 23% of Basic Pay, HRA/Lease, Contribution to PF, Gratuity as per Payment of Gratuity Act

For Junior Engineers - Degree Holders (CL/01/26 & CL/02/26)

  • For 5 years minimum experience:
    • Monthly Basic Pay: Rs. 25,504
    • Gross Monthly Pay: Rs. 46,417
    • Yearly CTC: Rs. 5,57,008

For Junior Engineers - Diploma Holders (CL/01/26 & CL/02/26)

  • For 7 years minimum experience:
    • Monthly Basic Pay: Rs. 18,940
    • Gross Monthly Pay: Rs. 34,471
    • Yearly CTC: Rs. 4,13,651

Other Benefits (As per company rules applicable to contract employees)

  • Leaves
  • Maternity Leave
  • Medical facility
  • Accident/Death Insurance
  • Leave Encashment

Note: Remuneration mentioned above is only indicative. Actual remuneration shall depend upon place of posting and other terms & conditions of appointment.

Age Limit (as on 26.02.2026)

  • Maximum Age Limit: 55 years as on the last date of application i.e. 26.02.2026
  • Age Relaxation for SC/ST: 5 years
  • Age Relaxation for OBC-NCL: 3 years
  • Age Relaxation for PwBD: 10 years; in addition to the age relaxation permissible for SC/ST/OBC-NCL category candidates, subject to the post being identified suitable for PWD
  • Note: Relaxation in upper age limit shall be applicable for PwBD candidates irrespective of the fact whether the post is reserved or not, provided the post is identified suitable for PwBDs
  • PWD candidates suffering from not less than 40% of the relevant disability shall only be eligible for the benefit of PWD

Application Fee

Category Fee Amount
General/OBC Candidates NIL
EWS/SC/ST/PWD Candidates NIL

No application fee is required for any category.

Event Date
Commencement of submission of online application 22.01.2026

Walk-in Interview for CL/01/26 & CL/02/26 25.02.2026 to 27.02.2026
Reporting Time for Walk-in Interview 09:30 AM to 12:30 PM

Selection Process

  • All candidates who successfully submitted their online application form shall be provisionally allowed to appear for Document Scrutiny/verification process
  • The eligibility of the candidates with respect to the post applied will be verified during document scrutiny
  • Thereafter, the shortlisted/eligible candidates shall be allowed to appear for Interview
  • RITES Ltd. reserves the right to shortlist the number of candidates for selection out of eligible candidates
  • Weightage Distribution: Interview - 100%
    • Technical & Professional proficiency - 65%
    • Personality, Communication & Competency - 35%
  • Minimum Qualifying Marks:
    • 60% marks for UR/EWS in interview
    • 50% marks for SC/ST/OBC (NCL)/PWD against reserved posts in interview
  • There will be no minimum qualifying marks required in the aggregate
  • Interviews will be conducted on first come first served basis
  • Candidates can appear for Walk-in Interview at any one of the mentioned venues
  • Candidates have the option to appear for interview either in Hindi or English
  • Based on the requirement and discretion of RITES, the selection process may be conducted from RITES' Regional Offices

General Information/Instructions

  • The appointment shall be purely on contract basis initially for a period of one year, extendable until completion of the assignment subject to mutual consent and satisfactory performance
  • Selected candidates shall be liable for posting anywhere in India as per Company requirements
  • Instant recruitment is being done for deployment of personnel at client's site in the state of Kerala
  • Issuance of offer letter of engagement to the selected candidates shall be subject to approval of CV by the client
  • Appointment of selected candidates will be subject to their being found medically fit in the Medical Examination to be conducted as per RITES Rules and Standards of Medical Fitness for the relevant post
  • Reservation/relaxation/concessions to EWS/SC/ST/OBC (NCL)/PWD/Ex-SM/J&K Domicile would be provided against reserved posts (where applicable) as per extant Govt. orders
  • Before applying, candidates should ensure that they satisfy the necessary conditions and requirements of the position
  • Community certificate (SC/ST/OBC) should be in the format prescribed by Government of India only
  • OBC candidates included in the Central List with certificate not more than 12 months old (with clear mention of candidate not belonging to "Creamy Layer") in the GOI prescribed format only will be considered
  • EWS certificate should also be as per Gov. of India format and must be for 2024-25 i.e. issued on or after 01.04.2024
  • Departmental candidates of RITES and candidates working in Government Departments/PSU shall be allowed to join RITES only after being properly relieved from their parent organization
  • If it is detected at any stage of recruitment that a candidate does not fulfill the eligibility norms and/or that he/she has furnished any incorrect/false information or has suppressed any material fact(s), his/her candidature is liable for cancellation
  • Management reserves the right to cancel/restrict/enlarge/modify/alter the selection/recruitment process at any stage, without issuing any further notice or assigning any reason thereafter
  • The number of vacancies may vary
  • No train/bus fare/TA/DA shall be payable
  • Legal jurisdiction will be Delhi in case of any dispute
  • Any corrigendum/addendum to this advertisement will be displayed only on the Company's website www.rites.com

How to Apply

  • Interested candidates fulfilling the eligibility criteria are required to apply online in the registration format available in the Career Section of RITES website, http://www.rites.com
  • While submitting the online application, the system would generate 'Registration No.' on top of online form. Note down this "Registration No." and quote it for all further communication with RITES Ltd.
  • While filling up the required details, candidates are advised to carefully and correctly fill the details of "Identity Proof"
  • After filling up the required details under the "Fill/Modify Application Form", candidate should submit the application
  • Keep a copy of Application Form submitted and carry the same at the time of the selection
  • A copy of online APPLICATION FORM containing the registration number is to be printed, signed, and retained
  • The same is to be submitted at the time of Scrutiny of Documents/Interview along with SELF-ATTESTED PHOTO COPIES of the following documents strictly in the following order:
    • 1 recent passport size colour photograph
    • A copy of updated CV/Resume
    • High School certificate for proof of Date of Birth
    • Certificates of Academic & Professional qualifications and statements of marks of all the qualifications for all semesters/years
    • EWS/SC/ST/OBC Certificate in the prescribed format by Govt. of India (if applicable)
    • Proof of Identity & Address (Passport, Voter ID, Driving license, Aadhaar Card etc)
    • PAN Card
    • Proof of different periods of experience as claimed in the Application Form
    • Any other document in support of your candidature
    • PWD Certificate as per latest format (if applicable)
  • No documents are to be submitted while submitting online application
  • Hard copies of documents are not to be sent to this office through post/courier
  • The original testimonials/documents along with one self-attested copy will have to be produced at the time of selection
  • Candidates should submit only one application for one vacancy and application once submitted cannot be altered
  • A valid e-mail ID is essential for submission of the online application
  • Candidate has to bring duly filled two copies of Annexure A, documents in chronological order and submit at the time of Document verification/Selection process
  • Queries should be sent to [email protected] with VC No., Registration/Roll No., Name of Candidate, and valid email address

Walk-in Interview Venues

  • Venue 1: RITES Ltd., Shikhar, Plot No. 1, Sector – 29, Near IFFCO Chowk Metro Station, Gurugram – 122001, Haryana
  • Venue 2: RITES LTD, Ground floor, Calsar Heather Punnen Road, Opposite Hilton Hotel, Statue, Thiruvananthapuram- 695001, Kerala

Age, experience and all other eligibility criteria shall be reckoned as on the last date of submission of the application (cut-off date) i.e. 08.03.2026.

Eligibility Criteria

1. Educational Qualification

Candidates must possess the following minimum educational qualification for the post of Deputy General Manager (Mech.) – Bulk Material Handling Expert (VC No. CP/07/26):

  • Full-time Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical Engineering or
  • Full-time Bachelor’s Degree in Technology in Mechanical / Production / Production & Industrial / Manufacturing / Mechanical / Railways / Mechatronics & Automobile or any of the above combinations in part or whole.
  • Degree must be recognized by AICTE and obtained from a University incorporated by an Act of Central or State Legislature in India or other Educational Institutions established by an Act of Parliament or declared to be Deemed University under Section 3 of the UGC Act, 1956.
  • Sections A & B examination of the Institution of Engineers (India), treated as equivalent to Degree by Govt. of India and recognized by AICTE, shall also be accepted.
  • UR/EWS candidates (and SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/PwBD applying against unreserved posts) must have first class degree / minimum 60% marks in the minimum qualification.
  • Reserved category candidates (SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/PwBD as applicable) should have at least 50% marks in the minimum qualification for consideration against reserved posts.

If the certificate/mark sheet does not indicate first class/division or percentage, candidates must provide the conversion formula issued by the concerned university/institution. Where no formula exists, an undertaking from the university/institution is required, and minimum 6 on 10-point scale will be considered as 60%.

2. Minimum Post-Qualification Experience

Candidates should have the following minimum post-qualification experience (post degree) for CP/07/26:

  • Minimum 09 years’ experience in designing and optimizing bulk material handling systems.
  • Ability to develop process flow diagrams, capacity calculations, and optimization studies.
  • Experience and proficiency in material handling systems such as conveyors, stackers, reclaimers, ship loaders/unloaders, silos, wagon tipplers, and rapid loading systems.
  • Proven capability in project lifecycle management from feasibility to commissioning.
  • Experience in cost estimation, budgeting and lifecycle analysis of CAPEX and OPEX.

The period of training (except on-the-job training), internship, teaching, academic, fellowship, and PhD research experience shall not be counted as part of experience.

3. Age Limit & Relaxations

  • Maximum age for UR: 50 years as on 08.03.2026.
  • SC/ST: Relaxation of 5 years in upper age limit.
  • OBC–NCL: Relaxation of 3 years in upper age limit.
  • Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD): Relaxation of 10 years in addition to category relaxation, subject to post being identified suitable.

PwBD candidates will have to meet the physical requirements and functional classifications identified for Mechanical posts (Locomotor disability – OA/OL with specified physical requirements).

4. Nationality

Candidates must be eligible to work in India as per applicable laws and guidelines as implied in the notification.

Selection Process for RITES Deputy General Manager (Mech.) – Bulk Material Handling Expert 2026

Candidates will be selected based on the following process:

  • Document Scrutiny/Verification: All candidates who have successfully submitted their online application will be provisionally allowed for document scrutiny/verification to determine eligibility with respect to the post applied.
  • Interview: Shortlisted and eligible candidates after document scrutiny shall be allowed to appear for Interview. RITES Ltd. reserves the right to shortlist candidates for selection out of eligible applicants.
  • Interview Weightage: 100% weightage to Interview (Technical & Professional proficiency – 65%; Personality, Communication & Competency – 35%).
  • Qualifying Marks in Interview: Minimum 60% marks for UR/EWS candidates and 50% for SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/PwBD against reserved posts are required for being considered for placement on panel. There is no minimum qualifying marks requirement in aggregate.
  • Medical Examination: Appointment will be subject to candidates being found medically fit as per RITES Rules and Standards of Medical Fitness for the relevant post.

Reservation/relaxation/concessions for EWS/SC/ST/OBC–NCL/PwBD/Ex-SM/J&K Domicile will be provided against reserved posts, wherever applicable, as per Government orders.

How To Apply

Eligible candidates can apply online for RITES Ltd. Deputy General Manager (Mech.) – Bulk Material Handling Expert 2026 by following these steps:

  1. Visit the official website: www.rites.com and go to the Career section.
  2. Open the online registration format under the relevant advertisement for VC No. CP/07/26.
  3. Fill the online application form carefully with correct personal, educational, experience and category details.
  4. Note down the system-generated Registration No. which appears on top of the online form and use it for all future communication with RITES Ltd.
  5. Enter details of “Identity Proof” correctly and ensure availability of the same document in original for later verification.
  6. Under the “Fill/Modify Application Form” section, complete all required fields and then upload all supporting documents in the “Upload Document” section.
  7. Upload mandatory documents including proof of date of birth, educational and professional qualifications with mark sheets, percentage conversion document (if applicable), category certificates, proof of identity and address, PAN card, and experience documents (offer letters, joining orders, relieving letters, service certificates, pay slips, etc.) in a single PDF in chronological order wherever required.
  8. After uploading documents, proceed to the “Make Payment” section and pay the applicable application fee online.
  9. On successful fee payment, download and save the final application form. Retain a printed copy of the application form for future reference and carry it along with self-attested copies of documents, if called for document verification/selection process.

Applications without successful fee payment will be treated as incomplete and will be summarily rejected. Hard copies of documents are not required to be sent by post/courier.

Documents to be uploaded/produced

  • High School certificate for proof of Date of Birth.
  • Certificates and mark sheets of all semesters/years for 10th, 12th, Diploma/Graduation/Post-Graduation (as applicable).
  • Percentage conversion document issued by the University/Institute (if applicable).
  • EWS/SC/ST/OBC–NCL/PwBD certificate in prescribed Government of India format (if applicable).

Candidates must ensure invoice generation upon successful fee payment and contact the helpdesk ([email protected], Helpdesk No. 011–33557000, Ext. 13221) in case of issues.

Salary/Stipend

GSSC Primary School Teacher Recruitment 2026 Overview

Eligibility Criteria for GSSC Primary School Teacher 2026

Educational Qualification (as on 20.02.2026):

Essential Qualifications (Any One of the following):

Option 1:

  • Higher Secondary School Certificate or its equivalent with at least 50% marks, AND
  • Two years Diploma in Elementary Education (D.El.Ed) / Diploma in Education (D.Ed) or its equivalent

Option 2:

  • Higher Secondary School Certificate (or its equivalent) with at least 45% marks, AND
  • Two years Diploma in Elementary Education (D.El.Ed) / Diploma in Education (D.Ed) or its equivalent, in accordance with the National Council for Teacher Education (Recognition Norms and Procedure) Regulations, 2002

Option 3:

  • Higher Secondary School Certificate (or its equivalent) with at least 50% marks, AND
  • Four years Bachelor of Elementary Education (B.El.Ed.)

Option 4:

  • Higher Secondary School Certificate (or its equivalent) with at least 50% marks, AND
  • Two years Diploma in Education (Special Education)

OR

Option 5:

  • Bachelor in Education (B.Ed.), AND
  • Six months Bridge course in Elementary Education (Professional Development Programme for Elementary Teachers - PDPET)

Additional Essential Requirements:

  1. Teacher Eligibility Test (TET) Certificate: Passing certificate in TET as recognized by the Government of Goa in accordance with NCTE Guidelines
  2. Teaching Experience: Minimum two years of teaching experience in Primary Schools recognized by Directorate of Education
  3. Language Requirement:
    • For Marathi Medium: Knowledge of Marathi
    • For Konkani Medium: Knowledge of Konkani

Desirable Qualifications:

  • Knowledge of Konkani (mandatory - passing in Konkani language test required for merit)

Other Requirements:

  • Valid 15 years residence certificate issued by Competent Authority in Goa
  • Registration with Employment Exchange, Goa / Valid Employment Registration Card
  • Birth Certificate
  • Caste/Social Status Certificate (if applicable)
  • Disability Certificate (if applicable)
  • Ex-Servicemen Certificate (if applicable)
  • EWS Certificate (if applicable)
  • Experience Certificate
  • Teacher Eligibility Test (TET) Certificate

Category Age Relaxation

PwD from OBC category 13 years (10+3)
Ex-Servicemen As per Rules in force
Government Servants Up to 5 years (as per Govt. instructions)

Event Date

Online Application Last Date 20.02.2026
Last Date for Fee Payment 20.02.2026
CBT-I Exam Date Will be intimated through GSSC website and local daily
CBT-II Exam Date Will be intimated through GSSC website
Class Demonstration Date Will be intimated through GSSC website

Selection Process for GSSC Primary School Teacher 2026

The selection process consists of THREE stages:

Stage 1: Computer Based Test - I (CBT-I) - Screening/Shortlisting

For Marathi Medium Teacher:

Subject Marks
Test of English & Comprehension 20
Test of Numerical Ability 10
Test of Reasoning 10
Test of Konkani Language 10
Test of Marathi Language 10
TOTAL 60 Marks

Duration: 75 minutes (100 minutes for PwD candidates with compensatory time)

For Konkani Medium Teacher:

Subject Marks
Test of English & Comprehension 20
Test of Numerical Ability 10
Test of Reasoning 10
Test of Konkani Language 20
TOTAL 60 Marks

Duration: 75 minutes (100 minutes for PwD candidates with compensatory time)

Minimum Passing Marks (CBT-I):

  • Unreserved (UR) candidates: 45%
  • OBC/PwD candidates: 40%
  • SC/ST candidates: 35%

Konkani Language Test (Mandatory):

  • Marathi Medium: Minimum 4 marks out of 10 required in Konkani test (mandatory for merit consideration)
  • Konkani Medium: Minimum 8 marks out of 20 required in Konkani test (mandatory for merit consideration)
  • Konkani language questions will appear in the first 10/20 questions
  • Only candidates securing minimum qualifying marks in Konkani will be evaluated for merit list

Shortlisting for CBT-II: 3.5 times the number of posts in each category/sub-category based on CBT-I merit

Stage 2: Computer Based Test - II (CBT-II)

For Marathi Medium Teacher:

Subject Marks
Test of English & Comprehension 10
Test of Numerical Ability 10
Test of Reasoning 10
Test of Marathi Language (including basic grammar) 40
Test of Methodology/Education Pedagogy 10
TOTAL 80 Marks

Duration: 100 minutes (135 minutes for PwD candidates with compensatory time of 35 minutes)

For Konkani Medium Teacher:

Subject Marks
Test of English & Comprehension 10
Test of Numerical Ability 10
Test of Reasoning 10
Test of Konkani Language (including basic grammar) 40
Test of Methodology/Education Pedagogy 10
TOTAL 80 Marks

Duration: 100 minutes (135 minutes for PwD candidates with compensatory time of 35 minutes)

Shortlisting for Class Demonstration: Twice the number of candidates in each category/sub-category based on CBT-II merit

Stage 3: Class Demonstration - 10 Marks

  • Candidates will be asked to demonstrate on a particular concept of the post for which they have been shortlisted
  • Shortlisted based on CBT-II performance
  • Carries 10 marks

Final Merit & Selection

  • Combined Score: CBT-II marks + Class Demonstration marks
  • Common merit list prepared in descending order of Combined Score
  • Selection process as per Government of Goa O.M. No.1/6/83-PER(Vol.II)Pt.(a)/143 dated 14.01.2019
  • In case of tie (equal marks): Candidate born earlier gets precedence
  • Wait list will also be prepared for each post in descending order of merit

Selection Process (Category-wise):

  1. First: PwD/Ex-Servicemen/Meritorious Sportspersons candidates shortlisted on merit and adjusted against their vertical category (UR/ST/SC/OBC/EWS)
  2. Second: Unreserved (UR) category candidates shortlisted in descending order
  3. Third: Reserved category candidates (who didn't avail age relaxation/concessions except fee) adjusted against UR if eligible on merit
  4. Fourth: Reserved category candidates (OBC/SC/ST/EWS) shortlisted separately in descending order

Important Selection Notes:

  • No Negative Marking in CBT examinations
  • CBT-I is only for screening/shortlisting (marks not counted for final merit)
  • Question type: Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs)
  • Compensatory time for PwD: 25 minutes for CBT-I (60 marks), 35 minutes for CBT-II (80 marks)
  • If PwD/Meritorious Sportspersons not available in their reserved category, vacancies deducted from unreserved
  • If Ex-Servicemen not available, vacancies filled by meritorious candidates
  • If reserved category candidates not available, vacancies remain unfilled

  • Read all instructions carefully on the Commission's website
  • Go through syllabus and scheme of examination

    • Teaching Experience details
    • Category (UR/SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PwD/Ex-Servicemen/Sportsperson)
    • 15 years residence certificate details

  • Upload required documents (scanned copies)

Step 4: Pay Application Fee

Step 5: Final Submission

  • Read General Instructions on GSSC website carefully

Important Guidelines:

  • Application form to be filled through online mode only
  • Apply within the prescribed time limit (up to 20.02.2026)
  • Read all instructions on Commission's website carefully before applying
  • Go through syllabus and scheme of examination published on GSSC website

Project Title

"HyWats" - Hybrid Non-Sewered Wastewater Treatment System for Safe Discharge and Reuse (BRICS STI Framework Programme)

This project aims to design, develop, and demonstrate wastewater treatment and recovery systems at pilot scale with an objective to deliver recycled water without micropollutants and emerging contaminants.

Position 2: Research Assistant

Project Title

Global Sanitation Graduate School (GSGS) - Regional Hub India

Hosting the GSGS Regional Hub India Annual Conclave/Workshop and managing GSGS Hub-to-hub exchange and alumni engagement activities. This position involves collaboration with international sanitation research networks.

Position 3: Project Fellow

Project Title

"Characterization and Sustainable Recovery of Metals from Low-Grade Ores via Leaching and Bioleaching within a Circular Economy Framework"

Project Overview

This project aims to develop a sustainable, closed-loop process for recovering manganese and other valuable metals from low-grade ferruginous ores and mine waste through a combination of chemical leaching, bioleaching using native microorganisms, and hybrid chemical-biological approaches.

  • The selection is by merit for which overall grading in the ACRs/APARs should not be below "Very Good".
  • The selection is by merit for which the bench mark in overall grading in the Annual Confidential Reports will not be below "very good".

General Information / Instructions

  • The post of Secretary (HOD) in Mormugao Port Authority in the pay scale of Rs.100000-260000 (Revised) (Pre-revised Rs.43200-66000) will fall vacant w.e.f. 13.02.2026, which is required to be filled by absorption through composite method from Officers of Major Port Authorities, fulfilling the eligibility criteria as per the RRs as indicated in the Annexure – I. attached herewith.
  • As directed by the Ministry vide letter dated 19.11.2019, the incumbent will be initially appointed to the HOD post in the scale of pay of Rs.100000-260000 (Revised) (pre-revised Rs.43200-66000) and after completion of three years' regular service in the post, he/she will be elevated to the scale of pay of Rs.120000-280000 (Revised) (pre-revised Rs.51300-73000) subject to fulfilling the relevant conditions as per the Ministry's guidelines vide letter No. A-12023/15/2018-PE-I dated 19.11.2019.
  • It may be noted that any changes as directed by the Ministry from time to time, will be made applicable.
  • As per the Ministry's guidelines dated 26.09.2019, in case of receipt of advance copy of application in respect of any applicant by the Port, candidature of the candidate will not be considered by the Ministry if his/her application is not received through proper channel by the Port within 15 days of the last date of receipt of applications, i.e. on or before 30.03.2026. Further, the Ministry vide letter dated 20.09.2022 has issued the advisory in continuation to its earlier guidelines dated 26.09.2019 regarding filling up the HOD level posts in Major Port Authorities wherein it is inter-alia stated that, "In this connection, it is to clarified that certain documents viz.
  • obtaining vigilance clearance, APARs of the candidate may take some time due to administrative formalities. In such scenario, the ports need to forward the application of the officer with the approval of the competent authority (i.e through proper channel) to the port which has issued advertisement before due date of submission of application.
  • Such applications through proper channel (even through without APARs, Vigilance, etc.) will be taken into consideration by the Ministry for appointment to HOD level posts.
  • However, for consideration of candidature of the candidate by the Selection Committee, the Ports are required to forward the remaining documents without necessary delay.
  • At various instances, the Ports forward the applications of the candidates in the last hours.
  • Thus, it becomes impossible for the applications to reach the Port that issued advertisement before due date of submission. In such cases, the ports are required to forward his/her application (through proper channel i.e. forwarding of the Port alongwith printout of OAP application) via email so that the candidature of the candidate could be considered for the post. Subsequently, the complete application of the candidate alongwith other documents may be forwarded by the Port by registered Post to the Port that issued advertisement".
  • The crucial date of eligibility criteria will be the last date of closing of application i.e. 14.03.2026, in terms of Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways circular No. I-26/25/2013-PE-I dated 26.09.2019. If any major or minor penalty has been imposed on the applicant during the last 10 years, the disciplinary case leading to such penalty along with necessary documents may be sent by the forwarding authority along with the application.
  • Vigilance report is to be furnished in the format prescribed, vide Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterway's letter No.A-12023/2/2021-PE-1 dated 20.1.2021, copy of which is attached as Annexure-III.
  • As per the Ministry's guidelines dated 26.09.2019 regarding filling up the HOD level posts in Major Port Authorities, Port official, who withdraws his/her candidature for the post after his/her selection by the Services Selection Committee, will be liable for debarment from future selection to HOD level posts in all Major Port Authorities for a period of two years. Incomplete applications or applications not made following the stated procedure or received after due date will not be considered.

How to Apply

  • Applications are invited from eligible and willing Officers of all the Major Port Authorities possessing the prescribed qualifications, experience and other conditions, for the post of Secretary in the pay scale of Rs.100000-260000 as per Annexure-I. The application may be submitted through "Online Application Portal" (OAP) of the Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways website https://onlinevacancy.shipmin.nic.in from 13.02.2026 to 14.03.2026. No application other than OAP shall be accepted.
  • The candidate will have to submit the printout of application form already uploaded in OAP to his administrative Port for onward forwarding. The administrative Ports are required to forward the applications of the candidates alongwith the following documents on or before 30.03.2026 superscribing "Application for the post of Secretary (HOD) in Mormugao Port Authority".
  • (i) Certified copies of ACRs/APARs for the last 5 years (2020-21 to 2024-25), duly attested by an officer not below the rank of Dy. HOD on each of the pages.
  • (ii) A statement showing year-wise availability of ACRs/APARs and grading duly signed by the Dy. Chairperson/Chairperson as per the Ministry's letter dated 01.02.2007. If ACR/APAR for a particular year during the last 5 years period is pending/not available, "No Report Certificate" may be furnished alongwith ACRs/APARs of the preceding years.
  • (iii) Attested photocopies of all certificates and proof of educational qualification, present and past work experience in the respective post and pay scale.
  • (iv) No objection certificate from the respective Port.
  • (v) Certificate by the Head of the Office of the applicant (Annexure-II).
  • (vi) An undertaking of the applicant to the effect that candidature will not be withdrawn, if selected by Services Selection Committee.
  • (vii) Vigilance and Administrative clearance of the concerned Port, as per enclosed proforma (Annexure-III)

  • Essential Qualification
  • Required Qualification and Experience for direct appointment in Diploma Institutions
  • Desirable Qualification
  • Minimum qualification required for Dress Design & Garment Manufacturing and Interior Design will be as per qualification required for Engineering/Technology as mentioned in the table above.
  • Experience
  • Teaching/Post Doctoral Experience (02 marks for one year each)#

Salary/ Stipend

  • Pay Scale- Entry Pay Rs. 56,100/- Level 9 'A' Entry Pay Rs. 57,700/- Level 10

Age Limit (as on 01-08-2025)

  • The retirement age for the post of Lecturer in Government Polytechnic/Government Women Polytechnic Institutes is 65 years.
  • According to the Jharkhand Technical Education Service Rules, 2024, there is no minimum age limit for candidates to apply. The maximum age limit for applying is 65 years or less.

Application Fee

  • The examination fee for candidates belonging to Unreserved, Economically Weaker Section (EWS), Extremely Backward Classes (Schedule-I) and Backward Classes (Schedule-II) is Rs.600 (Six Hundred) only.
  • The examination fee for Scheduled Tribe/Scheduled Caste candidates of Jharkhand State is Rs.150/- (One Hundred Fifty) only.
  • Disabled candidates (minimum 40% relevant disability) are exempted from examination fee.

Important Dates

Start Date 20 February 2026
Last Date 12 March 2026
Fee Payment Last Date 14 March 2026
Hard Copy Submission Last Date 25 March 2026
Age Calculation Date 1 August 2025

Selection Process

  • As per sl. No. 1 to 8 of above Table, merit list will be made and 05 times candidates against each post will be called for document verification. After document verification, amongst the candidates present in document verification, 03 times candidates against each post will be called for interview.
  • Selection of candidates will be done as per the Merit list prepared as per Marks obtained for Academic Record/Achievements and Interview as per the Table above.
  • The process of selection of Lecturer in Polytechnics shall involve the inviting of the application developed by the Jharkhand Public Service Commission (JPSC), based on the Assessment Criteria and Methodology guidelines set out in Table of clause 8 of advertisement and reprints of all significant publications of the candidates provided that the publications submitted by the candidate have been published during the qualifying period.
  • The Commission shall prepare a merit list in order of preference furnished by the candidate and on the basis of vacancies and reservation roster and shall send recommendation to the appointing authority
  • Final merit list shall be prepared from the aggregate marks obtained in both academic and interview stages. In the event of total marks obtained from educational qualifications, interview and experience being the same, candidates having higher marks in Post Graduation will be placed higher in the final merit list. In the event of candidate having same educational qualifications marks, candidate who is older in age according to the date of birth will be placed higher in the final merit list.

General Information/ Instructions

Note - The number of posts may increase or decrease depending on the outcome of the judgments passed in case no. 3419/2020 (Anand Kumar Dalai vs. State of Jharkhand and others), 525/2016 (Dr. Pankaj Kumar vs. State of Jharkhand and others), 2185/2016 (Uttam Kumar vs. State of Jharkhand and others) and 1922/2017 (Bandana Kumari vs. State of Jharkhand and others) filed in the Hon'ble High Court. Note:- If any candidate attains 65 years of age during the selection process, his/her candidature will not be considered. # (a) However, if the period of continuous teaching/Post-doctoral experience is less than one year but more than six months then 01 mark shall be provided. No fractional marks to be given.

(b) Need Based Teachers/Contractual Teachers recruited under the Higher and Technical Education Department, Government of Jharkhand will get 01 additional mark per year of continuous teaching, upto a maximum of additional 5 marks. However, the total marks awarded to such Need Based Teachers/Contractual Teachers out of 80 for Academic record/achievements shall be capped at 80 marks.

(c) The period of time taken by candidates to acquire M.Phil and/or Ph.D. Degree shall not be considered as teaching/research experience.

(d) Candidates completing Ph.D. directly after B.E./B.Tech shall be awarded full marks for Post Graduation.

(e) Candidates completing 5 year integrated M.E./M.Tech course where marks for B.E./B.Tech is not given separately, their marking for graduation shall be done on the basis of marks awarded for M.E./M.Tech.

  • Applications will be accepted through OTR (One Time Registration) System on the website of Jharkhand Public Service Commission www.jpsc.gov.in.
  • The online application form will be filled by the candidate himself.
  • It will be the responsibility of the candidate to keep safe the e-mail Id, Mobile Number and the received User Id and Password mentioned in the online application form.
  • After submitting the finally filled online application form, the candidate should login again at the same time and download the filled application form from the “Download Filled Application Section” available on the dashboard and must print two copies of it.
  • Before filling the online application form, please read "How to register for OTR" on the Commission's website www.jpsc.gov.in.

Candidates are also required to upload their scanned photograph, signature and other documents related to their eligibility. Please refer to Annexure II regarding scanning of photograph & signature and upload of documents.
  • Candidates are advised to carefully fill in the online application themselves as no change in any of the data filled in the online application will be possible/ entertained. Prior to submission of the online application, candidates are advised to verify the details in the online application form and modify the same if required. No change is permitted after clicking on SUBMIT button. Visually Impaired candidates will be responsible for getting the details filled in/carefully verifying, in the online application and ensuring that the same are correct prior to submission as no change is possible after submission.

  • An online application which is incomplete in any respect and unsuccessful fee payment will not be considered as valid and will summarily be rejected.
  • Candidates shall also be required to submit supporting documents such as Date of Birth Proof, Graduation/Mandatory Qualification Certificate/s, Other Certifications, Experience Letter, Document showing Break up of CTC, Latest Salary Slips, etc. at the time of submitting the online application form.

Selection Process for RRB Group D CEN 09/2025

The recruitment consists of 4 successive stages:

Stage 1: Computer Based Test (CBT)

Duration: 90 minutes (120 minutes for candidates using scribe)

Total Questions: 100 (Each of 1 mark)

Subject Number of Questions
General Science 25
Mathematics 25
General Intelligence and Reasoning 30
General Awareness and Current Affairs 20
TOTAL 100 Questions = 100 Marks

Exam Pattern:

  • Objective type with multiple choices
  • Questions available in English, Hindi, and 13 regional languages (Assamese, Bengali, Gujarati, Kannada, Konkani, Malayalam, Manipuri, Marathi, Odia, Punjabi, Tamil, Telugu, Urdu)
  • Negative Marking: 1/3 mark deducted for each wrong answer
  • Section-wise distribution may vary slightly in actual exam

Minimum Qualifying Marks:

  • UR: 40%
  • EWS: 40%
  • OBC-NCL: 30%
  • SC: 30%
  • ST: 30%
  • PwBD: May be relaxed by 2 marks in case of shortage

Syllabus (Indicative):

  • Mathematics: Number system, BODMAS, Decimals, Fractions, LCM, HCF, Ratio & Proportion, Percentages, Mensuration, Time & Work, Time & Distance, Simple & Compound Interest, Profit & Loss, Algebra, Geometry, Trigonometry, Elementary Statistics, Square root, Age Calculations, Calendar & Clock, Pipes & Cistern
  • General Intelligence & Reasoning: Analogies, Alphabetical & Number Series, Coding & Decoding, Mathematical operations, Relationships, Syllogism, Jumbling, Venn Diagram, Data Interpretation & Sufficiency, Conclusions & Decision making, Similarities & Differences, Analytical Reasoning, Classification, Directions, Statement-Arguments & Assumptions
  • General Science: Physics, Chemistry, Life Sciences of 10th standard level (CBSE)
  • General Awareness & Current Affairs: Science & Technology, Sports, Culture, Personalities, Economics, Politics, and other important subjects

Normalization: Marks will be normalized if CBT conducted in multiple sessions

Stage 2: Physical Efficiency Test (PET)

Shortlisting: 3 times the total vacancies (may vary) based on CBT merit

Nature: Qualifying (Mandatory to pass - marks not counted for final merit)

Candidate Type Test 1: Weight Carrying Test 2: Running
Male Candidates Lift and carry 35 kg weight for 100 meters in 2 minutes (in one chance, without putting down) Run 1000 meters in 4 minutes 15 seconds (in one chance)
Female Candidates Lift and carry 20 kg weight for 100 meters in 2 minutes (in one chance, without putting down) Run 1000 meters in 5 minutes 40 seconds (in one chance)
Transgender Candidates Same relaxed standards as Female candidates

Important PET Notes:

  • Two-stage test: First weight carrying, then running (after recovery gap)
  • Failing in weight carrying means elimination (no running test)
  • Weight carrying involves lifting sandbag (without handle) from waist-height bench and carrying without dropping
  • Candidates' responsibility to ensure medical fitness for PET - Railways not responsible for injuries
  • Exemptions from PET:
    • Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) - must pass medical examination
    • Course Completed Act Apprentices (CCAA)
    • Ex-Servicemen (ExSM)
  • Pregnant Candidates: Must submit self-declaration. If pregnant, PET deferred till 6 weeks post-confinement. Vacancy kept reserved.

Stage 3: Document Verification (DV)

  • Shortlisting: 1:1 ratio of vacancies based on CBT merit + PET qualification
  • Candidates must produce original certificates
  • No additional time given - absence leads to candidature cancellation
  • Scanned copies to be uploaded before DV at https://oirms-ir.gov.in/rrbdv
  • Certificates must be in English/Hindi (translated version required otherwise)
  • Hard copy of signed application form to be brought

Stage 4: Medical Examination (ME)

  • Conducted by Railway Medical Authorities
  • Must pass requisite medical fitness test as per IRMM
  • Visual acuity standards strictly enforced
  • Medical appeal option available (one final opportunity on payment)
  • Candidates found medically unsuitable will NOT be given alternative appointment

Final Merit & Selection

  • Based on CBT marks (after normalization if applicable)
  • Subject to PET qualification, DV clearance, and medical fitness
  • Post/Railway allotment as per candidate's preference, merit, medical fitness, and vacancy
  • In case of tie: Older candidate ranked higher; if age also same, alphabetical order of name (A to Z)
  • No right to appointment - RRB/RRC only recommends; appointment by Railway Administration

Reservation & Relaxation for RRB Group D CEN 09/2025

Vertical Reservation (Community-wise):

  • SC (Scheduled Caste)
  • ST (Scheduled Tribe)
  • OBC-NCL (Other Backward Classes - Non Creamy Layer)
  • EWS (Economically Weaker Sections)

Horizontal Reservation (across all communities):

  • Ex-Servicemen (ExSM)
  • Course Completed Act Apprentices (CCAA) trained in Railway Establishments
  • Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD)

Important Reservation Rules:

For OBC-NCL Candidates:

  • Must produce OBC-NCL certificate issued on or after 01.04.2025 but not later than 02.03.2026
  • Certificate must be as per central list (http://www.ncbc.nic.in)
  • Must submit self-declaration (Annexure IIA) at DV that they don't belong to Creamy Layer
  • Certificate must mention: "Does NOT belong to Creamy Layer as per DOPT OM 36012/22/93-Estt.(SCT) dated 08.09.93, modified vide OM 36033/1/2013-Estt.(Res.) dated 13.09.2017"
  • OBC in state list but not in central list: NOT eligible for reservation

For EWS Candidates:

  • NOT covered under SC/ST/OBC-NCL
  • Gross annual family income < Rs. 8 lakh for F.Y. 2024-25
  • Family should NOT own:
    • 5 acres or more of agricultural land, OR
    • Residential flat of 1000 sq. ft. or more, OR
    • Residential plot of 100 sq. yards or more (notified municipalities), OR
    • Residential plot of 200 sq. yards or more (other areas)
  • Family: Applicant, parents, siblings <18 years, spouse, children <18 years
  • Must possess valid Income & Asset Certificate (Annexure III) based on F.Y. 2024-25 income/assets

For PwBD Candidates:

  • Minimum 40% benchmark disability required for reservation/relaxation
  • Certificate as per Form V/VI of RPwD Rules 2024 (Annexure V-A/V-B)
  • Must submit Unique Disability Identity (UDID)
  • Suitability for posts indicated in Annexure-A
  • Eligible Disabilities:
    • VI (Visually Impaired): Blindness (B), Low Vision (LV)
    • HI (Hearing Impaired): Deaf (D), Hard of Hearing (HH)
    • LD (Locomotor Disability): OA, OL, OAL, BL, LC, DW, AAV, CP, SD (without neurological/limb dysfunction), SI (without neurological/limb dysfunction)
    • MD (Multiple Disabilities)
  • Temporary disability candidates NOT eligible for reservation (as per DePwD OM dated 17.12.2025)

For Ex-Servicemen (ExSM):

  • Must have valid Ex-Serviceman Certificate from Zila Sainik Board
  • Serving defense personnel expected to be released within 1 year can also apply
  • Must submit NOC with probable discharge date (Annexure VI-A) at DV
  • Declaration/Undertaking (Annexure VI) required at DV
  • ExSM who already secured civil employment using ExSM quota: NOT eligible for ExSM reservation (only age relaxation available)
  • Different medical standards applicable (Para 534 of IRMM)

For CCAA (Railway Establishments):

  • Must have completed Act Apprenticeship by 02.03.2026 (appeared in NCVT exam)
  • National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) from NCVT required at DV
  • Weightage: 1/3rd marks from NCVT examination added to CBT marks for merit
  • If NCVT weightage gives lower score, higher of the two will be considered
  • Exempted from PET
  • Can apply to any RRB (not just training Railway)

Eligibility Criteria for Income Tax Gujarat Sports Quota 2025

For Multi-Tasking Staff (MTS):

Sports Eligibility Criteria (Any One):

Category 1:

  • Sportspersons who have represented State or Country in National or International competition, OR
  • Medal winners in Junior National Championships, OR
  • Medal winners in Khelo India Youth Games (age category above 18 years), OR
  • Medal winners in Khelo India Winter Games, OR
  • Medal winners in Khelo India Para Games, OR
  • Medal winners in Khelo India University Games, OR
  • Medal winners in School Games Federation of India (SGFI)

Category 2:

  • Sportspersons who have represented their University in Inter-University Tournaments conducted by Inter-University Sports Boards

Category 3:

  • Sportspersons who have represented State School Teams in National Sports/Games for Schools conducted by All India School Games Federation

Important Note: Candidates must be eligible in all respects (age, educational qualifications, experience) as per Recruitment Rules, except to the extent of relaxations permitted for sports quota.

For Multi-Tasking Staff (MTS):

Category Upper Age Limit Relaxation
General/OBC Meritorious Sportspersons Maximum 5 years

Important: Candidates seeking relaxation must ensure they are entitled to such relaxation as per eligibility prescribed on 01.01.2026.

Order of Preference for Selection (as per DoPT OM dated 04.05.1995 & 04.03.2024)

Sportspersons will be selected based on the following order of preference:

1st Preference:

  • Candidates who have represented the country in International Competition with clearance of Department of Sports, Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports

2nd Preference:

  • Represented State/UT in Senior or Junior National Championships organized by National Sports Federations (recognized by Dept. of Sports) OR National Games organized by Indian Olympics Association
  • Must have won medals or positions up to 3rd place
  • Between Senior and Junior participants, Senior National Championship medal winners get preference

3rd Preference:

  • Represented University in Inter-University competition conducted by Association of Indian Universities/Inter University Sports Board OR Khelo India University Games
  • Must have won medals or positions up to 3rd place in finals

4th Preference:

  • Represented State/UT in Khelo India Youth Games (age category above 18 years) OR Khelo India Winter Games OR Khelo India Para Games
  • Must have won medals or positions up to 3rd place in finals

5th Preference:

  • Represented State Schools in National sports/games for Schools conducted by All-India School Games Federation
  • Must have won medals or positions up to 3rd place

6th Preference:

  • Represented State/UT/University/State Schools Teams at levels mentioned in categories (2) to (5) but could not win medal/position
  • Same order of preference applies

Tie-Breaking Rules:

  • Candidates who secured higher position given preference
  • Candidates who won more than one medal may be given preference
  • Individual and team events given same preference
  • No preference for winning more than one medal/position

Required Sports Achievement Certificates

Only certificates from the following authorities will be accepted as evidence (as per DoPT OM F. No. 14034/01/2013-Estt(D) dated 03.10.2013):

Competition Authority Issuing Certificate Form
International Secretary of the National Federation of the game concerned Form-1
National Secretary of the National Federation OR Secretary of the State Association of the game concerned Form-2
Inter-University Tournament Dean of Sports or other officer in overall charge of Sports of the University concerned Form-3
National/Sports/Games for School Director/Additional/Joint/Deputy Director in overall charge of Sports/games for schools in the Directorate of Public Instructions/Education of the State Form-4
Khelo India University Games/Youth Games/Winter Games/Para Games Officer designated/Officer in charge from Sports Authority of India (SAI) for respective Khelo India Games Form-5

Important Notes:

  • Sports certificates must be in specified forms (Form 1 to Form 5) as per DoPT OM
  • Certificates must be certified by a Gazetted Officer
  • Forms available at: DoPT Circular
  • Certificates in any other form or from non-competent authorities will be ignored and applications rejected
  • Candidate who cannot upload at least one certificate from competent authority need not apply

Application Fee for Income Tax Gujarat Sports Quota 2025

Category Fee Amount
All Candidates (General/SC/ST/OBC/EWS) Rs. 200/- (Rupees Two Hundred Only)

Payment Mode: Online mode only

Important:

  • Proof of payment must be furnished with application
  • Applications without requisite fee will be treated as INCOMPLETE and rejected
  • Fee once paid shall NOT be refunded under any circumstances

Important Dates for Income Tax Gujarat Sports Quota 2025

Event Date
Online Application Start Date 31.01.2026
Online Application Last Date 21.02.2026
Written Examination Date Will be intimated via email
Document Verification Will be intimated to shortlisted candidates
Medical Examination Before formal appointment

Selection Process for Income Tax Gujarat Sports Quota 2025

Stage 1: Scrutiny of Applications

  • All applications received within prescribed time will be scrutinized
  • Scrutiny based on eligibility criteria/qualification/instructions as per advertisement
  • Scrutiny as per eligibility fixed by Sports Recruitment Committee
  • Candidates will be shortlisted as per order of preference (DoPT guidelines)

Stage 2: Written Examination

  • Shortlisted candidates required to appear in written examination
  • Success in written exam does NOT confer right to appointment
  • Appointment subject to Department's satisfaction after necessary enquiry

Stage 3: Data Entry Skill Test (For Tax Assistant only)

  • Candidates must qualify Data Entry Skill Test
  • Requirement: 8,000 key depressions per hour
  • As per relevant recruitment rules

Stage 4: Document Verification

  • Selected candidates required to produce original certificates
  • All documents will be verified

Stage 5: Medical Examination

  • Medical fitness ascertained by O/o Pr. CCIT, Gujarat Region before formal appointment
  • Candidates must be clear in all Doping tests by WADA/NADA or relevant authorities
  • No ongoing investigation regarding doping or unfair means required
  • Declaration to this effect mandatory

Stage 6: Police Verification

  • Appointment subject to clearance from Police authorities
  • Verification of current place of residence

Final Appointment

  • Based on: Eligibility, Order of Preference, Written Exam, Skill Test (for Tax Assistant), Document Verification, Medical Fitness, Police Clearance
  • Probation period: 2 years
  • Posting: Anywhere in Gujarat region

How to Apply for Income Tax Gujarat Sports Quota 2025

Application Process (Online Only):

Step 1: Visit Official Website

  • Go to https://incometaxgujarat.gov.in
  • Click on Sports Quota Recruitment 2025 link
  • Read complete advertisement and instructions carefully
  • Download certificate formats (Form 1 to Form 5) from DoPT OM link provided

Step 2: Fill Online Application Form

  • Click on "Apply Online" link (available from 31.01.2026 to 21.02.2026)
  • Fill all required details:
    • Personal Information (Name, Father's Name, DOB, Gender, Category, Contact details)
    • Educational Qualifications (with percentage and year)
    • Post Applied For: Indicate preference (1st preference: Tax Assistant/MTS, 2nd preference if applying for both)
    • Sports/Game details (Sport name, Level of competition, Achievement, Certificate details)
    • Employment details (if already employed - NOC required)
  • IMPORTANT: Clearly indicate post preference. Failure to indicate post makes application liable for rejection

Step 3: Upload Documents

  • Upload self-attested copies of all required documents (see list below)
  • All documents must be clear and legible
  • File format and size as per instructions on website

Step 4: Pay Application Fee

  • Pay Rs. 200/- through online mode
  • Save payment receipt
  • Upload proof of payment

Step 5: Submit Application

  • Review all details carefully
  • Submit the application
  • Take printout of submitted application for future reference
  • Save Application Number/Registration Number

Documents Required to Upload (Self-attested copies):

  1. Age Proof: Matriculation/SSC or equivalent certificate
  2. Educational Qualification Certificates:
    • For Tax Assistant: Bachelor's Degree certificate and marksheets
    • For MTS: Matriculation or equivalent certificate
  3. Sports/Games Certificates: In prescribed format (Form 1/2/3/4/5) certified by competent authority and attested by Gazetted Officer
  4. Caste/Community Certificate: SC/ST/OBC certificate in prescribed format for appointment under Government of India (if applicable)
  5. EWS Certificate: Income & Asset Certificate (if applicable)
  6. Age Relaxation Certificate: For Departmental Candidates (if claiming relaxation)
  7. Aadhaar Card: Copy of Aadhaar Card
  8. NOC: From present employer (for candidates already employed in Central/State Govt/PSU)
  9. Recent Passport-sized Photograph
  10. Signature
  11. Proof of Fee Payment

Important Application Instructions:

  • Only ONE application should be submitted per candidate
  • If more than one application submitted: ALL applications will be summarily rejected
  • Candidate can apply for more than one post (Tax Assistant & MTS) in SINGLE application
  • Must clearly indicate preference of posts (1st preference, 2nd preference)
  • Application period: 31.01.2026 to 21.02.2026
  • All communications will be via Email ID mentioned in application
  • Ensure Email ID is active and checked regularly
  • Visit https://incometaxgujarat.gov.in regularly for updates

Important Terms & Conditions

Service Conditions for Selected Candidates:

  • Probation: 2 years or as per Government of India instructions
  • Representation Requirement: Must represent Income Tax Department, Gujarat region in tournaments/meets for at least 10 years from joining
  • Undertaking Required: Not to apply for:
    • Deputation to other departments/regions
    • Inter-charge transfer on loan basis
    • Any other inter-charge transfer arrangement
    • Minimum period: 10 years
  • Leave Management: Strictly subject to DOPT O.M No. 6/1/85-Estt.(Pay-I) dated 16.07.1985
  • Posting: Liable for posting anywhere in Gujarat region
  • Declaration Required: To work at any place under Pr. CCIT, Gujarat Region (during pre-appointment process)

Anti-Doping Compliance:

  • Must be clear in all doping tests done by WADA/NADA or relevant authorities
  • No ongoing investigation regarding doping or unfair means
  • Mandatory declaration required

Medical Fitness:

  • Medical examination by O/o Pr. CCIT, Gujarat before appointment
  • Must meet prescribed medical standards

Background Verification:

  • Appointment subject to police clearance
  • Verification from current place of residence

General Warnings:

  • Any form of canvassing renders candidature liable for summary rejection at any stage
  • Furnishing wrong information/false declaration/misrepresentation: Candidature/appointment will be cancelled
  • Failure to comply with instructions/conditions: Application rejected without intimation
  • No travelling allowance for journey to Ahmedabad for joining after selection
  • Pr. CCIT, Gujarat may cancel recruitment process at any stage without assigning reason
  • Decision of Pr. CCIT, Gujarat is final in unforeseen situations not covered by DoPT OMs

HPRCA English & Mathematics Teacher 2026 Vacancy Details

The total number of vacancies for HPRCA English and Mathematics Teacher Recruitment 2026 is 624 posts. Category-wise vacancy distribution for each post is as follows:

1. English Teacher (Post Code 26002)

Total: 312 Posts

Gen (UR) - 112, EWS - 40, Gen (WFF) - 04, SC (WFF) - 02, SC (UR) - 62, SC (BPL) - 12, OBC (WFF) - 02, OBC (UR) - 50, OBC (BPL) - 12, ST (UR) - 12, ST (BPL) - 04.

Note: The number of posts is tentative and may increase or decrease. Vacancies and reservation are liable to be altered without notice as per requisitions and R&P Rules.

Eligibility Criteria for HPRCA English & Mathematics Teacher 2026

1. Educational Qualification

English Teacher (Post Code 26002)

  • M.A. English with 50% marks in Graduation with B.Ed and teaching of English as compulsory subject in B.Ed (B.A B.Ed/B.Com B.Ed/B.Sc B.Ed will be eligible).
  • The applicant must have passed Graduation (including B.Ed) with a minimum of 50% marks and 55% marks in English at Graduation level.
  • SC/ST/OBC candidates should have at least 45% marks in Graduation (and 45% marks in B.Ed) and 50% marks in English at Graduation level.

Mathematics Teacher (Post Code 26003)

  • M.A/M.Sc. Mathematics with 50% marks in Graduation with B.Ed and teaching of Mathematics as compulsory subject in B.Ed (B.A-B.Ed/B.Com-B.Ed/B.Sc-B.Ed will be eligible).
  • The applicant must have passed Graduation (including B.Ed) with a minimum of 50% marks and 55% marks in Mathematics at Graduation level.
  • SC/ST/OBC candidates should have at least 45% marks in Graduation and 45% marks in B.Ed and 50% marks in Mathematics at Graduation level.

2. Age Limit

The age limit for HPRCA English and Mathematics Teacher Recruitment 2026 is:

  • Minimum Age: 25 years
  • Maximum Age: 45 years
  • Age Calculation Date: As on 21.02.2026 (closing date of ORA)
  • Age Relaxation: There will be no age relaxation to any of the categories.

3. Nationality

Candidates from Himachal Pradesh and other states can apply; however, candidates of reserved categories from other States will be treated as General (UR) category for reservation and fee purposes as per instructions.

Selection Process for HPRCA English & Mathematics Teacher 2026

Candidates will be selected based on the following process:

  • Computer Based Test (CBT) / Written Objective Screening Test of 120 marks of 1½ hours duration or as decided by HPRCA.
  • Objective type screening test with 120 multiple-choice questions (1 mark each).
  • Syllabus:
    • Subject/field up to the level of prescribed essential qualifications.
    • General Knowledge including Himachal Pradesh, Current Affairs, Everyday Science, Logical Reasoning, Social Science, General English & General Hindi (Matric level).
  • Normalization of scores using Z-Score Method in case of multiple shifts.
  • Document verification for shortlisted candidates.

Note: Minimum qualifying marks: 45% for General category and 40% for SC/ST/OBC/Wards of Freedom Fighters, with possible relaxation by 5% if required as per notification.

Application Fee for HPRCA English & Mathematics Teacher 2026

  • Examination Fee: ₹100 for all categories.
  • Processing Fee: ₹700 for all categories.
  • Total Fee: ₹800 per application.
  • Correction Fee: ₹100 (for corrections during the correction window).
  • Payment Mode: Online Payment Gateway using Credit Card/Debit Card/Net Banking (no other mode accepted).

How to Apply for HPRCA English & Mathematics Teacher Recruitment 2026?

Eligible candidates can apply online for HPRCA English & Mathematics Teacher 2026 by following these steps:

  1. Visit the official website: https://hprca.hp.gov.in
  2. Register on the portal by using the “Sign Up” option to create username and password.
  3. Complete One Time Registration (OTR) by entering personal, educational, and experience details and uploading photograph, signature and relevant documents.
  4. Update and complete the profile, if required.
  5. View available posts and click on “Apply” for English Teacher or Mathematics Teacher.
  6. Select preferred examination district(s) from the dropdown menu.
  7. Verify auto-filled application details and ensure correctness.
  8. Pay the examination and processing fee through the Online Payment Gateway.
  9. Submit the application and keep a downloaded/printed copy for documentation.

Eligibility Criteria

Qualifications

  • Professor - Eligibility (A or B):
    • Option A: An eminent scholar having a Ph.D. degree in the concerned/allied/relevant discipline, and published work of high quality, actively engaged in research with evidence of published work with a minimum of 10 research publications in the peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals and a total research score of 120 as per UGC Regulations-2018. A minimum of ten years of teaching experience in university/college as Assistant Professor/Associate Professor/Professor, and/or research experience at equivalent level at the University/National Level Institutions with evidence of having successfully guided doctoral candidate
    • Option B: An outstanding professional, having a Ph.D. degree in the relevant/allied/applied disciplines, from any academic institutions/industry, who has made significant contribution to the knowledge in the concerned/allied/relevant discipline, supported by documentary evidence provided he/she has ten years experience
  • Associate Professor: A good academic record, with a Ph.D. Degree in the concerned/allied/relevant disciplines. A Master's Degree with at least 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point-scale, wherever the grading system is followed). A minimum of eight years of experience of teaching and/or research in an academic/research position equivalent to that of Assistant Professor in a University, College or Accredited Research Institution/industry with a minimum of seven publications in the peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals and a total research score of Seventy five (75) as per UGC Regulations-2018
  • Assistant Professor - Eligibility (A or B):
    • Option A: A Master's degree with 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point-scale wherever the grading system is followed) in a concerned/relevant/allied subject from an Indian University, or an equivalent degree from an accredited foreign university. Besides fulfilling the above qualifications, the candidate must have cleared the National Eligibility Test (NET) conducted by the UGC or the CSIR, or a similar test accredited by the UGC, like SLET/SET or who are or have been awarded a Ph.D. Degree in accordance with the University Grants Commission Regulations, 2009 or 2016 and their amendments from time to time as the case may be exempted from NET/SLET/SET
    • Option B: The Ph.D degree has been obtained from a foreign university/institution with a ranking among top 500 in the World University Ranking (at any time) by any one of the following: (i) Quacquarelli Symonds (QS) (ii) the Times Higher Education (THE) or (iii) the Academic Ranking of World Universities (ARWU) of the Shanghai Jiao Tong University (Shanghai)
  • Deputy Librarian: A Master's Degree in library science/information science/documentation science, with at least 55% marks or an equivalent grade in a point-scale, wherever grading system is followed. Eight years experience as an Assistant University Librarian/College Librarian. Evidence of innovative library services including integration of ICT in library. A Ph.D. Degree in library science/Information science/Documentation Science/Archives and manuscript keeping/computerization of library
  • Assistant Librarian: A Master's Degree in Library Science, Information Science or Documentation Science or an equivalent professional degree, with at least 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point-scale, wherever the grading system is followed). Candidates numbering up to 3 times (approx.) of the Circle wise and Category wise vacancies will be called for interview from the top of the merit list.
  • Phase 3 - Interview: Interview will consist of 50 marks. Candidates will have to score minimum qualifying marks in interview to be considered for final selection.
  • Phase 4 - Local Language Proficiency Test: Test of knowledge of specified opted local language will be conducted for provisionally selected candidates before joining the Bank. Candidates who produce 10th or 12th standard mark sheet/certificate evidencing having studied the specified opted local language will not be required to undergo the language test.
  • Final Selection: Final merit list is prepared based on normalization of marks scored in Online Test and Interview with 75:25 weightage respectively. Marks secured by candidates in Online Test (out of 170 marks) are converted to out of 75 marks and Interview scores (out of 50 marks) are converted to out of 25 marks.
  • Note: There will be no penalty for wrong answers marked in Objective Tests. Sectional marks will not be maintained for Online Examination.

General Information/Instructions

  • Selected candidates will be posted in the Circle against whose vacancy they are selected.
  • The selected candidates will not be entitled for Inter-Circle transfer/Corporate Centre Posting/Corporate Centre Establishment Posting/Foreign Posting up to his/her promotion to SMGS-IV Grade OR 12 years of service, whichever is later.
  • On joining, the selected candidates will be designated as "Circle Based Officers" (CBOs) and will be on probation for a period of 6 months from their joining the Bank.
  • The CBOs will be subjected to continuous assessment during probation period for judging their suitability for confirmation.
  • Reservation for Person with Benchmark Disability (PwBD) candidates is horizontal and will be guided by various guidelines of Government of India. Only those persons with benchmark disabilities (not less than 40% of a specified disability) would be eligible for reservation.

Selection Process

  • Selection will be based on a candidate's relative score in the Computer Based Test.
  • CBT Pattern: Total 100 Marks for 90 minutes duration (one sitting), comprising two sections:
    • Section A: Technical Knowledge (discipline related) – 70 Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs) of 1 mark each – 70 Marks.
    • Section B: General Knowledge, General Awareness, Reasoning, Verbal & Mental Ability, and Quantitative Aptitude – 30 MCQs of 1 mark each – 30 Marks.
    • Each question carries 01 mark. There is no penalty for wrong answers. No marks for un-attempted questions.
    • Question paper will be bilingual (English and Hindi). In case of any error/ambiguity in Hindi version, the English version shall be valid and final.

    • SC / ST / ESM / OBC-NCL / PwBD: 40 marks out of 100
  • Computer Based Test will be conducted separately for each post.
  • Tie-Breaking Rule: In case of equal marks, tie will be resolved by: (i) Higher score in Section-A; then (ii) Date of Birth – older candidates preferred; then (iii) Alphabetical order of names.

  • For Assistant Foreman (Mechanical) and Assistant Foreman (Electrical), all candidates will be deemed to have applied for both Excavation Cadre and E&M Cadre. Separate merit lists for each cadre will be prepared; Excavation Cadre merit panel will be prepared first, followed by E&M Cadre with remaining candidates.

Eligibility Criteria

Qualifications

  • Professor - Eligibility (A or B):
    • Option A: An eminent scholar having a Ph.D. degree in the concerned/allied/relevant discipline, and published work of high quality, actively engaged in research with evidence of published work with a minimum of 10 research publications in the peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals and a total research score of 120 as per UGC Regulations-2018. A minimum of ten years of teaching experience in university/college as Assistant Professor/Associate Professor/Professor, and/or research experience at equivalent level at the University/National Level Institutions with evidence of having successfully guided doctoral candidate
    • Option B: An outstanding professional, having a Ph.D. degree in the relevant/allied/applied disciplines, from any academic institutions/industry, who has made significant contribution to the knowledge in the concerned/allied/relevant discipline, supported by documentary evidence provided he/she has ten years experience
  • Associate Professor: A good academic record, with a Ph.D. Degree in the concerned/allied/relevant disciplines. A Master's Degree with at least 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point-scale, wherever the grading system is followed). A minimum of eight years of experience of teaching and/or research in an academic/research position equivalent to that of Assistant Professor in a University, College or Accredited Research Institution/industry with a minimum of seven publications in the peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals and a total research score of Seventy five (75) as per UGC Regulations-2018
  • Assistant Professor - Eligibility (A or B):
    • Option A: A Master's degree with 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point-scale wherever the grading system is followed) in a concerned/relevant/allied subject from an Indian University, or an equivalent degree from an accredited foreign university. Besides fulfilling the above qualifications, the candidate must have cleared the National Eligibility Test (NET) conducted by the UGC or the CSIR, or a similar test accredited by the UGC, like SLET/SET or who are or have been awarded a Ph.D. Degree in accordance with the University Grants Commission Regulations, 2009 or 2016 and their amendments from time to time as the case may be exempted from NET/SLET/SET
    • Option B: The Ph.D degree has been obtained from a foreign university/institution with a ranking among top 500 in the World University Ranking (at any time) by any one of the following: (i) Quacquarelli Symonds (QS) (ii) the Times Higher Education (THE) or (iii) the Academic Ranking of World Universities (ARWU) of the Shanghai Jiao Tong University (Shanghai)
  • Deputy Librarian: A Master's Degree in library science/information science/documentation science, with at least 55% marks or an equivalent grade in a point-scale, wherever grading system is followed. Eight years experience as an Assistant University Librarian/College Librarian. Evidence of innovative library services including integration of ICT in library. A Ph.D. Degree in library science/Information science/Documentation Science/Archives and manuscript keeping/computerization of library
  • Assistant Librarian: A Master's Degree in Library Science, Information Science or Documentation Science or an equivalent professional degree, with at least 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point-scale, wherever the grading system is followed). A consistently good academic record, with knowledge of computerization of a library. Besides fulfilling the above qualifications, the candidate must have cleared the National Eligibility Test (NET) conducted by the UGC, CSIR or similar test accredited by the UGC like SLET/SET or who are or have been awarded a Ph.D. Degree in accordance with the University Grants Commission Regulations, 2009 or 2016 and their amendments from time to time

Essential Qualifications

  • Educational qualification, experience, age of retirement on superannuation and pay scales of Professor, Associate Professor, Assistant Professor, Deputy Librarian and Assistant Librarian will be as per the UGC/NCERT, Government of India norms as amended from time to time and in force at the time of closing date of filling-up online application
  • For Assistant Professor and Assistant Librarian positions, NET/SLET/SET shall not be required for such Masters Programmes in disciplines for which NET/SLET/SET is not conducted by the UGC, CSIR or similar test accredited by the UGC
  • Candidates registered for the Ph.D. programme prior to July 11, 2009, shall be governed by the provisions of the then existing Ordinances/Bye-laws/Regulations of the Institution awarding the degree and such Ph.D. candidates shall be exempted from the requirement of NET/SLET/SET subject to fulfillment of specific conditions: Ph.D. degree awarded in regular mode, Ph.D. thesis evaluated by at least two external examiners, Open Ph.D. viva voce conducted, Candidate has published two research papers from Ph.D. work (at least one in refereed journal), Candidate has presented at least two papers based on Ph.D work in conferences/seminars sponsored/funded/supported by the UGC/ICSSR/CSIR or any similar agency
  • The fulfillment of these conditions is to be certified by the Registrar or the Dean (Academic Affairs) of the University concerned
  • The Academic score as specified in Appendix II for Universities and Colleges shall be considered for short-listing of the candidates for interview only, and the selections shall be based only on the performance in the interview as per UGC Regulations-2018 and as amended from time to time

Experience

  • Professor: A minimum of ten years of teaching experience in university/college as Assistant Professor/Associate Professor/Professor, and/or research experience at equivalent level at the University/National Level Institutions with evidence of having successfully guided doctoral candidate OR ten years experience as an outstanding professional from academic institutions/industry with significant contribution to the knowledge in the concerned discipline
  • Associate Professor: A minimum of eight years of experience of teaching and/or research in an academic/research position equivalent to that of Assistant Professor in a University, College or Accredited Research Institution/industry
  • Deputy Librarian: Eight years experience as an Assistant University Librarian/College Librarian with evidence of innovative library services including integration of ICT in library
  • Assistant Professor and Assistant Librarian: No specific years of experience required, but must have NET/SLET/SET qualification or Ph.D. degree exemption as per UGC norms

Desirable

  • For Professor positions: Published work of high quality, actively engaged in research with evidence of published work with a minimum of 10 research publications in the peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals and a total research score of 120
  • For Associate Professor positions: A minimum of seven publications in the peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals and a total research score of 75
  • For Deputy Librarian: Evidence of innovative library services including integration of ICT in library
  • For Assistant Librarian: A consistently good academic record with knowledge of computerization of a library

Salary/Stipend
