    • Technician and Graduate Apprentices: Enroll in National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (NATS 2.0) portal of BOAT(SR) at https://nats.education.gov.in (if not already enrolled).
    • Trade Apprentices: Register in the apprenticeship portal of Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship at https://www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in (if not already registered).
  2. Apply through Establishment Registration Numbers:
    • Trade Apprentices: Apply against Establishment Registration No. E11153200006.
    • Technician & Graduate Apprentices: Apply against Establishment Registration No. SKLERC000015.
  3. Download & Fill Application (Annexure-A): Fill the application in the prescribed proforma (preferably on A4 size paper) as given in the advertisement.
  4. Prepare Scanned Documents: Scan and self-attest photocopies of:
    • 10th Pass/Matriculation Certificate or Birth Certificate (proof of date of birth).
    • 10th Mark Sheet.
    • SC/ST/OBC (NCL)/EWS/Disability certificates (as applicable) in prescribed format.
    • Declaration form for OBC-NCL, if applicable.
    • All semester/year-wise mark sheets and final certificate of ITI/Diploma/Degree, as applicable to the apprentice category.
    • Nativity Certificate.
    • Aadhaar Card.
    • Proof of enrollment/registration in the respective apprenticeship portal (NATS/NAPS).
  5. Email Submission: Send the scanned copy of duly filled application form affixed with passport size photograph along with all supporting documents to [email protected].
  6. Subject Line: Mention in email subject: “APPLICATION FOR ENGAGEMENT OF APPRENTICES AGAINST NOTIFICATION NO. IREL/RED/HRM/Apprentices Engagement/2026-27/01”.
  7. Ensure that the email with complete scanned application and documents reaches on or before 15/03/2026; applications after this date will not be considered.

Interested and eligible candidates can apply Online through the official C-DAC website. The last date to submit the application form is 20-02-2026. In this article, you’ll find the C-DAC Project Engineer, Project Technician and Other Posts recruitment details, including eligibility criteria, age limit, salary structure, selection process, application steps, and direct links to the official notification and Online application form.

C-DAC Project Engineer, Project Technician and Other Recruitment 2026 Overview

Advertisement
Company Name Centre for Development of Advanced Computing (C-DAC)

No of Posts 805
Qualification B.Tech/B.E, M.Sc, M.E/M.Tech, MCA

Eligibility Criteria

  • BE/B. Tech or Equivalent Degree with 60% or equivalent CGPA OR
  • ME/M. Tech/Equivalent Degree OR
  • Post Graduate Degree in Science/Computer Application or in relevant Domain with 60% or equivalent CGPA OR
  • PhD. in relevant discipline

in  Computer Science and Engineering and aligned branches - AI, data science, cybersecurity, IoT, etc., or Information Security, or Electronics & Communication Engineering or Electrical Engineering

 Age Limit and Relaxation

  • Maximum Age limit: 56 Years
  • Age relaxation is applicable as per rules.

Upper Age limit will be as specified against each post

Applicants belonging to reserved category (SC/ST/OBC) / physically challenged/Ex-servicemen could be eligible for relaxations according to the ‘Government of India’ norms.

 Government employees on payscale will be eligible for relaxation in age by 5 years including  other  age relaxations as applicable.

 The cut-off date for ascertaining the age and experience will be Last Date of submission of    application.

Candidates seeking age relaxation need to submit a copy of caste certificate when called for document verification.  

 SSLC/SSC/ISC mark sheet/ certificate and any other valid document will be considered as proof of date of birth.

The Economically Weaker Section’s Certificate should be strictly in the format prescribed by DoPT.  The format is available on the website www.persmin.nic.in

The application of the candidates not meeting the prescribed age criteria will be reject/cancelled without any prior intimation.

Candidates belonging to OBC category (Non creamy layer) should produce the certificate issued in prescribed format.

Application Fee

  • No application fee is charged by C-DAC for applying to this advertisement.

Important Dates

  • Notification Release Date: 01-02-2026
  • Starting Date for Apply Online: 01-02-2026
  • Last Date for Apply Online: 20-02-2026
  • Interview Dates: Will be communicated via email to shortlisted candidates

Selection Process

  • Candidate should meet the eligibility criteria as specified in the advertisement.  
  • The qualification and experience prescribed, are the minimum requirements and possession of the  same does not automatically make the candidates entitled to be called for written test and / or selection processes. 
  • There will be an initial screening based on the academic records and other parameters declared in  the on-line application and only screened-in candidates will be considered for further selection process. 
  • The management reserves the right to increase/alter the minimum eligibility criteria/cut off  limits, in  the event of the number of applicants are more, for any post(s), at its discretion. 
  • Candidates will be selected on the basis of their academic credentials, experience profile, written   test marks (if any), performance in the interview and such other selection processes/parameters, as adopted and deemed fit by management. e. Mere application and fulfilment of the mentioned qualifications etc., does not entitle a candidate  to be called for written/skill test/ interview.
  • C-DAC may restrict the number of candidates to be  called to participate in interview/selection process to a reasonable limit, on the basis of qualifications and experience higher than that of the minimum prescribed in the advertisement. The  candidates should, therefore, furnish all the qualifications and experience possessed in the relevant field, over and above the minimum qualifications prescribed.  
  • The selection process shall be carried out by the respective C-DAC Centre based on its requirements and only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for further process.
  • All information submitted in the application will be verified with the original documents at the time  of document verification or at any stage of the recruitment process. If any documents/information provided by the candidate is found to be false or incorrect or Non- conformity with the eligibility criteria, then his/her candidature is liable to be rejected/cancelled at  any stage of the recruitment and selection process without any prior intimation.
  • The candidature is also liable for rejection at any stage if C-DAC comes across any evidence/knowledge that the qualification, experience and any other particulars indicated in the application/other    forms/formats are not recognized/false misleading and/or amounts to suppression of information/particulars which should have been brought to the notice of C-DAC

How to Apply

  • Before filling the online application form, Candidates should read General Terms and Conditions carefully.
  • Candidate should read all the eligibility parameters and ensure that he/she is eligible for the post before starting to apply online.
  • Candidate should have a valid email id and mobile no. which should remain valid & active till the completion of selection process.
  • While applying online Candidates can click on the ‘Apply’ button provided against each position for which he/she wish to apply.
  • The candidate needs to log in with mobile no. and then fill in the OTP received on the said mobile no.
  • On filling the correct OTP, the applicant will be directed to fill in the application form. In case you have filled in an application in our previous advertisement, the applicant will receive a prefilled editable application.
  • Candidates shall check the prefilled application and submit it, after adding additional details by clicking on ‘Submit’ button.
  • Candidates should scan their photograph in .jpg format (not more than 400 KB) and keep it ready before starting to apply online for uploading.
  • Candidate should upload their resume in PDF format (Not more than 500 KB)
  • A unique application number will be generated by the system, please note this application number for future reference and use. Candidates can take a print of the application form and keep it with them for their own records.
  • No hard copy/printed applications should be sent to C-DAC. Incomplete and defectively filled online forms shall be rejected straightway and no subsequent correspondences will be entertained in this regard.
  • Candidates working in Government/PSUs/Govt. Autonomous bodies should also apply online in advance and print of the application form, duly filled and signed should be forwarded through proper channel to HRD Section, C-DAC, Bangalore.
  • Those who are not forwarding their application through proper channel are required to produce 'No objection certificate (NOC)' from their current employer at the time of interview, if called for, failing which they will not be permitted to attend the interview.
  • Any dispute with regard to selection/recruitment process will be subject to Courts/Tribunals having jurisdiction over Bangalore, Karnataka only.

Selection Process

Phase-I: Objective Type Online Test (60 marks)

  • Duration: 60 Minutes
  • Total Questions: 60 Multiple Choice Questions
  • Distribution:
    • General Awareness: 5 marks
    • English Language: 5 marks
    • Numerical Ability: 5 marks
    • Reasoning Ability: 5 marks
    • Subject Based: 40 marks
  • Each question carries one mark
  • No negative marks
  • Test centres in Kerala only
  • Candidates can choose test centres while completing online application

Minimum Pass Marks for Phase-I

  • Unreserved posts & EWS candidates: 50% of total marks
  • OBC Candidates: 45% of total marks (only for vacancies reserved for OBC)
  • SC/ST Candidates: 40% of total marks (only for vacancies reserved for SC/ST)
  • PwBD Candidates (HR & Finance posts): 40% of total marks

Certificate Verification

  • Candidates who score minimum pass marks shall be shortlisted for certificate verification
  • Minimum ratio of 6 candidates against one post in order of merit/reservation
  • Only candidates who successfully complete certificate verification shall be allowed to attend Phase II

Phase-II: Group Discussion, Writing Skills and Personal Interview (40 marks)

  • Group Discussion (GD): 10 marks
  • Writing Skills: 10 marks
  • Personal Interview: 20 marks
  • Venue: CSL, Kochi

Final Selection

  • Total marks: 100 (Phase-I: 60 marks + Phase-II: 40 marks)
  • Rank lists prepared based on total marks secured in Phase I & Phase II
  • In case of tie: marks scored in discipline part of Objective test shall be basis
  • If tie persists: relative merit decided based on seniority in age

  • EWS candidates should produce valid Income and Asset Certificate in prescribed format
  • SC/ST/OBC (Non Creamy Layer) candidates should produce valid community certificate issued by Revenue Authority not below rank of Thahsildar
  • PwBD candidates: minimum 40% disability required (for HR & Finance posts)
  • Valid Certificate of disability in prescribed format as per Rights of Persons with Disabilities Rules, 2017 required

PwBD Categories Identified (HR & Finance Posts Only)

  • Low vision
  • Deaf and hard of hearing
  • One Arm, One Leg, Both Leg
  • Leprosy Cured without functional impairment
  • Dwarfism
  • Acid Attack Victims without other functional disability

Important Instructions

  • Only Indian Nationals need to apply
  • Applicants should apply for only one post as online exams for various posts will be conducted simultaneously
  • Application once submitted shall be final - no changes allowed
  • Applicants in regular Government service should upload declaration that they have informed their employer
  • Original certificates will be verified at time of joining or at any other stage as decided by CSL
  • Biometric/photograph will be captured at time of online examination
  • No travelling allowance for objective type test
  • SC/ST/PwBD candidates appearing for certificate verification shall be reimbursed single to & fro third AC rail fare
  • Call letters shall not be sent by post - will be available for download from website
  • Candidates should frequently check CSL website for updates
  • Medical examination required at hospitals prescribed by CSL
  • CSL reserves right to increase/decrease vacancies or cancel recruitment process
  • Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification
  • Documents related to selection preserved for 2 years from date of publication of results
  • Legal jurisdiction: Courts/Tribunals/Forums at Ernakulam only

How to Apply

  • Visit official website www.cochinshipyard.in
  • Go to Career page CSL, Kochi
  • Click on the link for online application
  • Complete Registration phase first
  • Fill in all details correctly in the online application
  • Ensure you meet the notified requirements before applying
  • Upload required documents:
    • Certificates towards proof of age, qualification, caste, disability etc
    • Recent passport size colour photograph
    • Signature
    • Educational qualification certificates/mark sheets
    • Declaration (for Government employees as per Annexure-I)
  • Submit the application online
  • Pay application fee of ₹1,000 using online payment options (Debit card/Credit card/Internet Banking/Wallets/UPI)
  • Note down the unique registration number generated by the system
  • Retain soft copy/printout of online application for reference

  • Do not send application printout/certificates/fee by post
  • Submit application well in advance to avoid last minute rush
  • Last date for submission: 20 February 2026
  • Quote Registration Number for any correspondence with CSL
  • Check CSL website regularly for updates and selection schedule

  • For clarification related to advertisement and conduct of selection: [email protected]

Submarine Tech Electrical 08 Only for Men

Eligibility Criteria

  • Executive Branch (GS(X)/ Hydro Cadre): BE/ B.Tech in any discipline with minimum 60% marks.
  • Pilot: BE/ B.Tech in any discipline with minimum 60% marks. (Candidate must have 60% aggregate marks in class X and XII and minimum 60% marks in English in class X or class XII).
  • Naval Air Operations Officer (Observers): BE/ B.Tech in any discipline with minimum 60% marks. (Candidate must have 60% aggregate marks in class X and XII and minimum 60% marks in English in class X or class XII).
  • Air Traffic Controller (ATC): BE/ B.Tech in any discipline with minimum 60% marks. (Candidate must have 60% aggregate marks in class X and XII and minimum 60% marks in English in class X or class XII).
  • Logistics: BE/ B.Tech in any discipline with First Class or MBA with First Class, or B.Sc/ B.Com/ B.Sc.(H) with First class along with PG Diploma in Finance / Logistics / Supply Chain Management / Material Management or MCA/ M.Sc.(H) with First Class.
  • Education: MSc/MA with minimum 60% marks in Maths/ Operational Research (with Physics in BSc) or MSc/MA with minimum 60% marks in Physics/ Applied Physics (with Maths in BSc)/ Meteorology/ Oceanography/ Atmospheric Sciences (with Physics and Maths in BSc) or BE/ B.Tech with minimum 60% marks in Mechanical/ Production Engineering or BE/ B.Tech/ M.Tech with minimum 60% marks in Computer Science Engineering/ MCA (with either Physics or Mathematics in graduation level) or BE/ B.Tech with minimum 60% marks in Electrical/ Electronics and Communication/ Electronics and Instrumentation or ME/ M.Tech with minimum 60% marks in Electronics & Communication/ Controls/ Radar and Microwave/ Optical Fibre Communication/ Digital Signal Processing/ Wireless Communication/ Laser and Electro Optics/ VLSI/ Power Systems/ Communications Systems/ Electronics & Instrumentation or ME/ M.Tech with minimum 60% marks in Thermal/ Production Engineering/ Machine Design/ System and Controls/ Manufacturing/ Mechatronics/ Meteorology/ Oceanography/ Atmospheric Sciences (with Physics and Maths at graduation level). Candidates applying for the Education entry must have scored minimum of 60% marks in class X or class XII.
  • Engineering Branch (General Service (GS)): BE/ B.Tech with minimum 60% marks in the following streams :- Marine Engineering, Aero Space Engineering, Metallurgy Engineering, Instrumentation Engineering, Automobiles Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering.
  • Submarine Tech Engineering: BE/ B.Tech with minimum 60% marks in the following streams :- Production Engineering, Control Engineering, Aeronautical Engineering, Industrial Engineering & Management, Instrumentation & Control, Mechanical/Mechanical with Automation.
  • Electrical Branch (General Service (GS)): BE/ B.Tech with minimum 60% marks in the following streams :- Electrical Engineering, Instrumentation, Power Electronics, Electronics Engineering, Tele Communication, Power Engineering.
  • Submarine Tech Electrical: BE/ B.Tech with minimum 60% marks in the following streams :- Electrical & Electronics, Electronics & Tele Communication, Applied Electronics and Communication (AEC).

Salary/Stipend

  • The initial gross salary of Sub Lieutenant starts from Rs 1,25,000/- (approximately) per month alongwith other allowances as applicable.
  • Pilot/ NAOO allowance of Rs 31,250/- will be admissible to candidates post successful completion of training.
  • Submarine allowance of Rs 31,250/- will be admissible to candidates post successful completion of training.
  • Submarine allowance will be admissible to candidates post successful completion of submarine training in accordance with extant rules.

Age Limit (as on 01-01-2027)

  • Executive Branch (GS(X)/ Hydro Cadre): Born Between 02 Jan 2002 to 01 Jul 2007
  • Pilot: Born Between 02 Jan 2003 to 01 Jan 2008
  • Naval Air Operations Officer (Observers): Born Between 02 Jan 2003 to 01 Jan 2008
  • Air Traffic Controller (ATC): Born Between 02 Jan 2002 to 01 Jan 2006
  • Logistics: Born Between 02 Jan 2002 to 01 Jun 2007
  • Education: Born Between 02 Jan 2002 to 01 Jan 2006
  • Engineering Branch (General Service (GS)): Born Between 02 Jan 2002 to 01 Jul 2007
  • Electrical Branch (General Service (GS)): Born Between 02 Jan 2002 to 01 Jul 2007

Important Dates

Event Date
Apply Online from 24 Jan 2026
Last date for Online Application 24 Feb 2026
Course commencing Jan 2027
Inform final result to Indian Navy prior 20 Dec 2026

Selection Process

  • Shortlisting of application will be based on normalised marks obtained by the candidates in the qualifying degree. Marks obtained by the candidates in the qualifying degree will be normalised using formulae mentioned in Join Indian Navy website (URL: - https://www.joinindiannavy.gov.in/files/normalisation.pdf)
  • BE/ B.Tech. For candidates who have completed or are in final year of BE/ B.Tech, marks obtained upto fifth semester will be considered for SSB shortlisting.
  • Post-Graduate Degree Programme. For candidates who have completed MSc, MCA, MBA, M.Tech, marks obtained in all semesters will be considered. For candidates who are in final year, shortlisting will be based on pre-final year performance.
  • Candidates selected in the final merit list will be required to submit the proof of completing the qualifying degree with minimum 60% marks by sending an email at the address [email protected]. Candidates failing to meet the criteria will not be permitted to join the Academy.
  • Shortlisted candidates will be informed about their selection for SSB interview through e-mail or SMS (provided by candidates in their application form). Candidates are advised not to change their e-mail/ mobile number till selection process is over and check their inbox and spam folder periodically.
  • Change of SSB Centre for interview is not permissible under any circumstances.
  • Any correspondence regarding change of SSB dates be addressed to the call up officer of the concerned SSB on receipt of call up letter. Candidates are to download the call up letter on receiving intimation from Naval Headquarters through SMS/ email (provided by candidates in their application).
  • No compensation is admissible in case of any injury sustained as a result of tests during SSB interviews.
  • AC 3 tier rail fare is admissible for the SSB interview, if appearing for the first time for particular type of commission. Candidates are required to bring photocopy of the first page of pass book or cheque leaf where the name, A/C No. & IFSC details are mentioned, while appearing for SSB.
  • Details of SSB procedure are available on Indian Navy website www.joinindiannavy.gov.in
  • Merit list will be prepared based on SSB marks for all entries as per availability of vacancies and medical clearance for respective entry. Candidates declared fit in medical examination would be appointed as per availability of vacancies in the entry.

General Information/Instructions

  • Vacancies mentioned in para 2 are tentative and may be changed depending on availability of training slots.
  • Only one application can be filled by a candidate. In case of multiple applications, candidature will be cancelled.
  • Male Candidates shortlisted for GS(X) are also eligible to volunteer for submarine arm subject to medical fitness, vacancies and service requirements. Candidates exercising option for this branch will have to additionally indicate option for submarine specialisation while filling the online application form.
  • Eventual selection/ nomination to undergo submarine specialisation will be subject to clearing submarine medicals (after joining INA) and service requirements.
  • Submarine allowance will be admissible to candidates post successful completion of submarine training in accordance with extant rules.
  • Candidates selected under GS(X) may be nominated to undergo specialisation in RPA (after completion of training at INA), subject to medical fitness and service requirements.
  • Candidates having Government of India, Ministry of Shipping & Transport Certificate of Competency (Foreign going) either as a Second Mate, Mate or Master and born between 02 Jan 1997 to 01 Jul 2007 (both dates inclusive) can apply for Executive Branch entry (General Service) as per stipulations stated at Para 2(1).
  • Candidates having Government of India, Ministry of Shipping & Transport Certificate of Competency as 1st class Engineer and born between 02 Jan 1997 to 01 Jul 2007 (both dates inclusive) can apply for Technical Branch entry (SSC Engineering) as per stipulations stated at Para 2(7) and 2(8).
  • Candidates having valid CPL issued by DGCA (India) and born between 02 Jan 2002 to 01 Jan 2008 (both dates inclusive) can apply for Pilot entry as per eligibility criteria stated at Para 2(2).
  • NCC 'C' certificate holders will be given relaxation of 5% in cut off marks towards shortlisting for SSB subject to meeting following criteria: Having NCC 'C' certificate of Naval/Army/Air Wing with minimum 'B' Grade. Not served less than two academic years in the Senior Division, Naval/Army/Air Wing of the NCC. 'C' certificate should not be dated prior to 01 Jan 2024.
  • The final selection will be subject to verification of the certificate by DG(NCC) concerned NCC unit for its validity. Candidature of individual will be cancelled at any stage of selection/ training/ post-commissioning, in case of false declaration, misinformation or concealing of information.
  • The candidate will be required to fulfil the educational qualification stipulated above before joining INA, Ezhimala by Jan 2027.
  • The candidate failing to meet stipulated educational criteria will not be permitted to join INA, Ezhimala.
  • All SSB recommended candidates would be required to inform their final result of respective degree to Indian Navy at the email ID [email protected] prior 20 Dec 2026.
  • Specified number of candidates based on service requirement, who have chosen SSC (Pilot) entry will be considered for SSB/ CPSS/ Aviation Medical Examination and are advised to check physical/ medical standards (Height, leg length etc) for this entry prior selecting this option. Remaining candidates will be considered for other preferences opted by them.
  • Candidates must indicate their preference for other branches/ cadres also, if they wish to be considered for those branches/ cadres.
  • Candidates will not be considered for branches/ cadres that they have not selected.
  • Candidates are advised to ascertain their eligibility for branches/ cadres, with respect to applicable medical standards, prior to indicating their preference.
  • No equivalent stream of BE/ B.Tech qualifications other than those mentioned in para 2(5), 2(6), 2(7), 2(8), 2(9) and 2(10) above, will be considered valid for selection process at any stage.
  • Candidates will be denied to appear SSB if any backlog in any subject is pending at the time of document verification at SSB centers.
  • Medical standards/ Relaxation in Height and Weight/ Tattoo. Please visit website www.joinindiannavy.gov.in for information. SSB recommended candidates are required to undergo medical examination as applicable to their entry. Change of medical hospital/ centre is not permissible under any circumstances.
  • Selected candidates will be granted Short Service Commission initially for 12 years extendable by maximum 02 years, subject to service requirement, performance, medical eligibility and willingness of candidates
  • Candidates will be inducted in the rank of Sub Lieutenant subject to clearing of induction medical examination at INA, Ezhimala post reporting.
  • Only unmarried candidates are eligible for training. Any candidate who is found to be married or marries while under training will be discharged from service and shall be liable to refund full pay and allowances drawn by him/ her and other expenditure incurred on the candidate by the Government.
  • If the officer voluntarily withdraws from initial training or resigns during the probationary period, he/ she shall be required to refund the cost of training in whole or in part, as may be determined by Govt and all money received by him/ her as pay and allowances from the Govt together with the interest on the said money calculated at the rate in force for Govt loans.
  • Probation period for all branches/cadres is two years. The probation period will commence from the date of grant of the rank of Sub Lieutenant and will terminate after two years or on completion of initial training (whichever is later). During probation the officers are liable to be discharged in case of unsatisfactory performance at any stage.
  • All officers/ cadets would be compulsorily members of the Naval Group Insurance Scheme (NGIS) as received and approved for insurance cover on contribution basis. The cover would be applicable whilst in service and post retirement as per extant regulations.
  • Mere inclusion of candidates in the Select List/Merit list does not confer upon them a vested right to appointment.
  • Candidates may also note that mere empanelment is under no circumstances be treated as final selection and is not an enforceable claim to the post applied for.
  • All vacancies are to be filled as per service requirement and as per statutory guidelines issued in this regard from time to time.
  • Please read the instructions given on the website carefully before finally submitting your online application.
  • Your candidature will be cancelled if any declaration is found wrong at any stage of selection.
  • Use/ possession of narcotics is banned. Candidate may be tested for presence of drugs in the body during SSB selection/ medical/ training and subsequently during service. If candidate is found to be using/ in-possession of narcotics during any time of selection/ medical/ training/ service, candidate would be debarred from joining the Indian Navy or be removed from service if already joined.
  • Your application is subject to subsequent scrutiny and the application can be rejected, if found INELIGIBLE/ INVALID at any point of time.

How to Apply

  • Candidates are to register and fill application on Indian Navy website www.joinindiannavy.gov.in. To save time during the application submission window, candidates can fill in their details and upload documents in advance.
  • Whilst filling up the e-application, it is advisable to keep the relevant documents readily available to enable the following: Correct filling up of personal particulars. Details are to be filled up as given in the Matriculation Certificate. Fields such as e-mail address, mobile number are mandatory fields and need to be filled.
  • All relevant documents (preferably in original), marks sheets upto 5th & 7th semester for regular and integrated BE/ B.Tech courses respectively and all semesters for other degree examination, date of birth proof (as per 10th & 12th certificate), CGPA conversion formula for BE/ B.Tech, Merchant Navy certificate issued by Government of India, Ministry of Shipping and Transport, NCC 'C' certificate issued by National Cadet Corps and a recent passport size colour photograph should be scanned in original JPG/TIFF format, for attaching the same while filling up the application.
  • If any scanned document is not legible/readable for any reason, the application will be rejected. Candidates are to take print out of application and carry it while appearing for SSB interview.
  • The application once submitted will be final and no request for amendments/change will be entertained.

Event Date & Time
Online Application Portal Opening 28-01-2026 (Wednesday)
Online Application Closing 27-02-2026 (Friday) 11:30 PM IST

Examination/Selection Process To be announced on CSU website

Selection Process

  • Scrutiny of Applications: Initial screening based on eligibility criteria and submitted documents
  • Written Examination/OMR Test: For applicable posts (pattern to be announced)
  • Skill Test: Typing test for LDC/UDC and other relevant skill assessments
  • Document Verification: Original certificates to be verified
  • Interview: Where applicable, as per CSU procedures
  • Merit-Based Selection: Final selection on merit within each zone

How to Apply

  • Visit the official CSU recruitment portal: https://csu.co.in/adarsh_nt/
  • Register with your email ID and mobile number
  • Fill the online application form with accurate details
  • Select your preferred zone and institution from the available options
  • Choose examination centre (Delhi, Mumbai, Kolkata, or Chennai)
  • For multiple posts: Apply separately if choosing different post categories or zones, paying individual fees for each
  • Upload required documents (as mentioned in portal)
  • Pay the prescribed application fee online
  • Submit the online application
  • After online submission, send a duly signed hard copy of the application along with self-attested copies of supporting documents to:
    The Registrar
    Central Sanskrit University
    56-57, Institutional Area, Janakpuri
    New Delhi - 110058
    Latest by 10-03-2026 at 6:00 PM IST by registered post
  • Preserve application receipt and printout for future reference

Required Documents (Hard Copy)

  • Duly signed hard copy of online application form
  • Self-attested copies of all supporting documents:
  • • Educational certificates and mark sheets
  • • Experience certificates
  • • Proof of date of birth
  • • Government-issued photo ID proof
  • • Category certificates (SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PwBD) if applicable
  • • No Objection Certificate from current employer (if government employee)
  • • NET/SLET/SET certificate (for College Librarian post)
  • Publication list (for applicable posts)

Important Instructions

  • Dual Requirement: Both online submission AND hard copy must reach by specified deadlines. Applications failing either requirement will be rejected
  • Multiple Applications: Candidates can apply for different post categories but only ONE per category per zone. Applying for same post in different zones is NOT allowed for same category
  • Examination Centres: Available at Delhi, Mumbai, Kolkata, and Chennai. Candidates may choose any centre regardless of zone applied
  • Eligibility Date: Criteria reckoned as on 27-02-2026 (application closing date)
  • Document Verification: Original certificates must be produced at the time of verification/interview
  • Disqualification Grounds:
  • • Incomplete applications
  • • Incorrect/mismatched information
  • • Signature/photograph variations
  • • Non-payment or incorrect fee payment
  • • Late receipt of hard copy (after 10-03-2026)
  • • False/fake certificates
  • • Use of unfair means in examination
  • Employed Candidates: Must submit No Objection Certificate from employer in hard copy at document verification
  • PwBD Candidates: Must inform about required assistance at least 10 days before examination
  • No TA/DA: Candidates bear own travel expenses for examination/interview
  • Merit-Based Selection: Mere fulfillment of qualifications does not guarantee selection
  • CSU reserves right to cancel, modify, or withdraw vacancy at any stage
  • Canvassing in any form leads to automatic disqualification
  • No interim inquiries entertained; updates available only on CSU website
  • Territorial jurisdiction: Delhi High Court for any legal disputes

Zone-wise Recruitment Details

Candidates can apply in only ONE zone for each post category. However, candidates are free to choose different zones for different post categories. For example, a candidate can apply for LDC in Zone-1 and UDC in Zone-3, but cannot apply for LDC in both Zone-1 and Zone-3.

Zone Definition: Zones are designed for institutional stability and continuity. There is no domicile restriction—any candidate can apply to any zone. Selected candidates will be allotted to institutions within their chosen zone based on merit and preference.

Examination Details

  • Scheme of examination and syllabus available at: https://sanskrit.nic.in/uploads/2026_01_05_CSU_NT_Scheme_of_Examination_r.pdf
  • Detailed examination pattern, selection criteria, and interview schedule will be announced on CSU website
  • Candidates advised to regularly visit www.sanskrit.nic.in for updates

Vacancy Details

Centre for Management Development (CMD), a nodal agency under Survey and Land Records Department (SLRD), Government of Kerala, is recruiting one Senior Hardware Support Engineer on a contract basis for a period of one year. This position involves managing and monitoring IT infrastructure, ensuring system availability, and providing comprehensive hardware and software support for critical government systems.

Position Vacancies Contract Period Location
Senior Hardware Support Engineer 1 1 Year Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala

Eligibility Criteria

Educational Qualification (Mandatory)

  • First Class B.Tech Degree in any of the following:
    • Computer Science & Engineering (CSE)
    • Information Technology (IT)
    • Electronics and Communication Engineering (ECE)
    • Electrical and Electronics Engineering (EEE)
  • OR First Class M.Tech / MCA in Computer Science
  • OR First Class MSc (Computer Science)
  • All qualifications must be from a recognized University/Institute
  • Desirable: MCSE (Microsoft Certified Solutions Expert) / Red Hat Certification (will be an added advantage)

Experience Requirements (Mandatory)

  • Minimum Total Experience: 5 years post-graduation working in IT infrastructure, system administration, or related technical roles
  • UNIX/Linux Experience (Mandatory): Minimum 2 years of hands-on working experience in installing, configuring, and troubleshooting UNIX/Linux based environments
  • Additional Required Experience:
    • Solid experience in administration and performance tuning of application stacks
    • Hands-on experience with virtualization and containerization (e.g., VMware, VirtualBox)
    • Experience with network monitoring systems
    • Solid networking knowledge (OSI network layers, TCP/IP protocols)
    • Solid experience with tape library backup systems
    • Experience in handling application tools for database maintenance and monitoring
    • Experience with PostgreSQL (mandatory) and SQL servers/databases
    • Experience in installing and upgrading operating systems

Age Limit

  • Maximum Age: 45 years
  • Cut-off Date for Age and Experience: 01.01.2026

Important Dates

Event Date & Time
Notification Released 09.02.2026
Online Application Opens 09.02.2026 (10:00 AM)
Last Date for Online Application Submission 19.02.2026 (5:00 PM)
Selection Process (Expected) To be announced after application closure
Contract Period 1 Year from date of joining

Selection Process

  • Application Screening: All submitted applications will undergo preliminary screening to verify eligibility criteria and completeness
  • Criteria-Based Shortlisting: Qualified candidates will be shortlisted based on educational qualifications, experience, technical skills, and certificates
  • Written Test: May include a technical assessment to evaluate knowledge in Linux, networking, databases, and system administration
  • Skill Test/Proficiency Assessment: Practical demonstration of technical competencies in hardware troubleshooting, system configuration, or performance tuning
  • Group Discussion: May be conducted for shortlisted candidates to assess communication and problem-solving abilities
  • Interview: Final interview round to assess technical depth, experience, and suitability for the position
  • Merit-Based Selection: Final selection will be based on overall merit combining all assessment methods
  • Note: CMD reserves the right to determine the exact combination of selection methods based on requirements

Salary/Remuneration

  • Consolidated Monthly Pay: ₹70,000/- (Seventy Thousand Rupees only)
  • Payment Frequency: Monthly
  • Nature of Payment: Consolidated (fixed amount, no separate allowances or benefits)
  • Contract Basis: Remuneration is for 1-year contract period; no extension of pay guaranteed upon renewal or continuation

Job Responsibilities

  • Manage and monitor all installed systems and IT infrastructure ensuring optimal performance
  • Install, configure, test, and maintain Linux-based operating systems, application software, and system management tools
  • Proactively ensure the highest levels of systems and infrastructure availability to end users
  • Monitor and test application performance for potential bottlenecks and identify possible solutions
  • Work with developers and system administrators to implement performance fixes and optimizations
  • Maintain comprehensive security, backup, and redundancy strategies for critical systems
  • Provide first and second level technical support to end users and departments
  • Liaise with OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) vendors, TSP/ISP providers, and other IT personnel for issue resolution
  • Troubleshoot and resolve LAN/WAN network issues affecting connectivity and performance
  • Handle application deployment and ongoing monitoring in production environments
  • Perform performance tuning of servers and databases to ensure high availability and reliability
  • Hands-on experience in installing and upgrading operating systems and critical software
  • Manage SQL servers and databases (PostgreSQL mandatory) with expertise in maintenance and monitoring
  • Handle application tools for database maintenance and monitoring during absence of Database Administrator
  • Manage tape library backup systems and ensure data protection strategies are implemented effectively

How to Apply

Application Process

  1. Visit the recruitment portal: recruitopen.com/cmd/slrd4.html
  2. Click on the link to open the online application form
  3. Fill all mandatory fields in the online application form completely and accurately
  4. Upload scanned copies of required documents in the specified format
  5. Review all entries carefully before final submission
  6. Submit the completed application form by clicking the Submit button
  7. Take a screenshot or note of the application reference number for future reference

Required Documents to Upload

  • Photograph: Recent passport-size color photograph (less than 200 KB, JPG format only)
  • Signature: Full signature on white paper, scanned (less than 50 KB, JPG format only)
    • Note: Signature must be complete and genuine; initials are NOT sufficient
    • Signature in CAPITAL LETTERS is NOT permitted
    • Signature must be by the candidate only, no other person's signature is acceptable
  • Educational Certificates: Upload original or provisional certificates (NOT mark sheets or consolidated mark sheets)
  • Equivalency Certificate: If qualification is equivalent to prescribed qualification (issued by competent authority)
  • Work Experience Certificates: Detailed experience certificates including:
    • Date of joining and relieving
    • Designation held
    • Nature of duties and responsibilities performed
    • Authorized signature and official seal
  • For Latest Experience: Affidavit with details of current employer, designation, period, nature of job, and tasks (applicable only for latest/ongoing employment)

Application Submission Tips

  • Submit application via ONLINE mode only from the recruitment portal
  • Applications window: 09/02/2026 (10:00 AM) to 19/02/2026 (5:00 PM)
  • Ensure all required fields are filled before submission
  • Photograph and signature must be clear and legible (blurred/illegible ones will be rejected)
  • Use only JPG format for all image uploads
  • Do NOT submit mark sheets, consolidated mark sheets, or statements in lieu of degree certificates
  • Do NOT submit salary slips or appointment letters as proof of experience
  • Keep a valid personal email ID and mobile number active throughout the recruitment process
  • Enable email notifications to receive updates about selection process
  • Check spam/junk folder regularly for important communications

MRVC Sr. Manager/Manager/Project Engineer (Rolling Stock) Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF

For complete details including application format (Annexure-I), all eligibility criteria, and detailed instructions, download the official notification PDF from MRVC website.

? Download Official PDF

Vacancy Details

Mumbai Railway Vikas Corporation (MRVC), a Public Sector Undertaking under the Ministry of Railways, is recruiting 7 professionals for Rolling Stock projects on a 5-year contractual basis. These positions are critical for executing EMU (Electric Multiple Unit) projects and enhancing suburban rail transportation capacity in Mumbai.

Position Vacancies Category Pay Scale (IDA)
Sr. Manager (Rolling Stock) 3 UR E4 (₹70,000 - ₹2,00,000)
Manager (Rolling Stock) Included in 3 UR E3 (₹60,000 - ₹1,80,000)
Project Engineer (Rolling Stock) 4 3 UR, 1 OBC E1 (₹40,000 - ₹1,40,000)

Eligibility Criteria

Educational Qualification

  • B.E / B.Tech in Electrical, Mechanical, Electrical & Electronics, Power Electronics, or Instrumentation from a Government recognized University/Institute
  • Minimum 60% marks in engineering graduation (aggregate percentage as per university conversion norms if CGPA/OGPA/CPI/DGPA is awarded)
  • Note: Rounding off percentages will NOT be acceptable (e.g., 59.99% will be treated as less than 60%)

Experience Requirements (Post-Qualification)

  • Sr. Manager (Rolling Stock): Minimum 8 years post-qualification working experience. Currently working in E-3/L-10 grade with minimum 2 years in that level or higher grade
  • Manager (Rolling Stock): Minimum 4 years post-qualification working experience. Currently working in E-2/L-8 grade with minimum 2 years in that level or higher grade
  • Project Engineer (Rolling Stock): Minimum 2 years post-qualification working experience
  • Preferred: Candidates with working experience in design, technical specifications, bid preparation, testing, operation and maintenance of EMU rolling stock in Railway/RRTS/Metro/LRT/HSR/Suburban rail systems will be preferred

Age Limit (as on 28.02.2026)

  • Sr. Manager (Rolling Stock): Not exceeding 40 years
  • Manager (Rolling Stock): Not exceeding 35 years
  • Project Engineer (Rolling Stock): Not exceeding 30 years
  • Age relaxation as per Government of India policy applicable

Important Dates

Event Date
Notification Released 29.01.2026
Last Date for Application Submission 28.02.2026
Eligibility Cut-off Date 28.02.2026
Document Verification & Interview To be announced (5x vacancies will be shortlisted)
Contract Period 5 Years

Selection Process

  • Preliminary Screening: Applications will be screened for compliance with eligibility criteria and prescribed format
  • Shortlisting: If more applications are received, candidates equal to 5 times the notified vacancies will be shortlisted based on engineering marks and experience
  • Document Verification: Shortlisted candidates must bring original application, original certificates, one set of self-attested photocopies, and character certificate from Gazetted/Executive Officer
  • Interview: Candidates will be interviewed by a nominated Committee of MRVC
  • Merit-Based Selection: Final selection will be based on performance in interview, qualifications, and post-qualification experience
  • Medical Examination: Selected candidates must pass medical fitness examination by a doctor (minimum MBBS qualification)
  • Decision: The decision of the Nominated Committee shall be final and binding

Salary/Remuneration

  • Sr. Manager (Rolling Stock) - IDA E4/L-11: Basic Pay ₹70,000 - ₹2,00,000 with annual increment @ 3% of basic pay
  • Manager (Rolling Stock) - IDA E3/L-10: Basic Pay ₹60,000 - ₹1,80,000 with annual increment @ 3% of basic pay
  • Project Engineer (Rolling Stock) - IDA E1: Basic Pay ₹40,000 - ₹1,40,000 with annual increment @ 3% of basic pay
  • Additional Allowances: DA (Dearness Allowance), HRA (House Rent Allowance), Provident Fund, Cafeteria, and other perks as per MRVC policy
  • Medical Benefits: As per MRVC policy
  • Pay Protection: Provided to candidates already working in Govt/Semi-government/PSU organizations (including on contract)

How to Apply

Application Process

  1. Download the application proforma (Annexure-I) from the official PDF
  2. Fill the application form completely with all required information in the prescribed format
  3. Paste a recent passport-size photograph and sign across it
  4. Fill all mandatory fields including:
    • Full name, father's/husband's name, postal address with PIN code
    • Contact details (mobile number and email address)
    • Date of birth in DD/MM/YYYY format
    • Gender, Category (SC/ST/OBC/UR)
    • Current working position and pay level
    • Complete educational qualifications with aggregate percentage marks
    • Detailed work experience in chronological order

Required Documents (Self-Attested)

Mandatory Documents:

  • Copy of original application with photo and signature
  • Certificates in proof of educational qualifications (all degrees/diplomas)
  • Proof of Date of Birth (SSLC/SSC Certificate or Birth Certificate)
  • OBC-NCL certificate in format prescribed for Central Government employment (if applicable)
  • Photo ID proof (Aadhar Card or PAN Card)
  • Documents regarding work experience and last service record
  • Character certificate from Gazetted Officer or Executive Officer
  • NOC from Government/PSU employer if currently employed

Recommended Documents:

  • Employment letters from previous and present employers
  • Form 16 (Income Tax) from previous/present employer

Eligibility Criteria

  • Essential Academic Qualifications: Graduation in any discipline from a recognised University or any equivalent qualification recognised as such by the Central Government including Integrated Dual Degree (IDD). Candidates possessing qualifications such as Medical, Engineering, Chartered Accountant, Cost Accountant would also be eligible.
  • Experience: Minimum 2 years' experience as on 31.12.2025 as an officer in any Scheduled Commercial Bank or any Regional Rural Bank as listed in Second Schedule of Reserve Bank of India.
  • Salary Requirement: Candidates having experience in Scheduled Commercial Banks other than Public Sector Banks/Regional Rural Banks shall be drawing minimum annual gross salary of Rs. 9.50 lacs for each year and shall provide documentary evidence for their annual gross salary such as Form-16/Annual Income Statement (AIS)/pay slips for last 24 months or certificate from employer.
  • Local Language: Candidates applying for vacancies of a particular Circle should be proficient (reading, writing and understanding) in any one of the specified opted local language of that Circle.
  • Exclusions: Candidates working with subsidiaries of Scheduled Commercial Banks, candidates working in SBI in clerical/supervisory cadre, employees engaged on contract basis, and candidates who have resigned from officer grade in SBI/Associate Banks will not be eligible to apply.
  • CIBIL Status: Candidates who have defaulted in repayment under any lending arrangement with Banks or NBFCs including credit card dues and have not regularised/repaid their outstanding are not eligible for appointment.
  • Character & Antecedents: Candidates against whom there is/are adverse report regarding character & antecedents, moral turpitude are not eligible to apply for the post.

Salary/Stipend

  • Starting basic pay is Rs. 48,480/- in the scale of 48480-2000/7-62480-2340/2-67160-2680/7-85920 applicable to Junior Management Grade Scale-I plus 2 advance increments.
  • The official will also be eligible for D.A, H.R.A/Lease rental, C.C.A, PF, Contributory Pension Fund i.e., NPS, LFC, Medical Facility etc. and other allowances & perquisites as per rules in force from time to time.

Age Limit (as on 31.12.2025)

  • Minimum Age: 21 years (candidates must have been born not later than 31.12.2004)
  • Maximum Age: 30 years (candidates must have been born not earlier than 01.01.1996)
  • Age Relaxation for SC/ST: 5 Years
  • Age Relaxation for OBC (Non-Creamy Layer): 3 Years
  • Age Relaxation for PwBD (SC/ST): 15 Years
  • Age Relaxation for PwBD (OBC): 13 Years
  • Age Relaxation for PwBD (Gen/EWS): 10 Years
  • Age Relaxation for Eligible Ex-Servicemen: 5 Years
  • Note: Cumulative age relaxation will not be available either under the above items or in combination with any other items.

Application Fee

Category Fee Amount

SC/ST/PwBD Nil

Online Registration of Application & Payment of Fees Last Date 18/02/2026

Download of Call Letter for Online Test March 2026 (Tentative)
Online Test March 2026 (Tentative)

Selection Process

  • Phase 1 - Online Examination: Online test will consist of Objective Tests for 120 marks and Descriptive Test for 50 marks. The duration of objective test is 2 hours consisting of 4 Sections - English Language (30 marks, 30 minutes), Banking Knowledge (40 marks, 40 minutes), General Awareness/Economy (30 marks, 30 minutes), and Computer Aptitude (20 marks, 20 minutes). The Descriptive Test (30 minutes) will be a Test of English Language (Letter Writing & Essay) for total 50 marks.
  • Phase 2 - Screening: The Screening Committee will examine whether candidates fulfil the required eligibility criteria of experience and match the job profile submitted by candidates with the job profile of Scale-I Generalist Officer of State Bank of India. Candidates numbering up to 3 times (approx.) of the Circle wise and Category wise vacancies will be called for interview from the top of the merit list.
  • Phase 3 - Interview: Interview will consist of 50 marks. Candidates will have to score minimum qualifying marks in interview to be considered for final selection.
  • Phase 4 - Local Language Proficiency Test: Test of knowledge of specified opted local language will be conducted for provisionally selected candidates before joining the Bank. Candidates who produce 10th or 12th standard mark sheet/certificate evidencing having studied the specified opted local language will not be required to undergo the language test.
  • Final Selection: Final merit list is prepared based on normalization of marks scored in Online Test and Interview with 75:25 weightage respectively. Marks secured by candidates in Online Test (out of 170 marks) are converted to out of 75 marks and Interview scores (out of 50 marks) are converted to out of 25 marks.
  • Note: There will be no penalty for wrong answers marked in Objective Tests. Sectional marks will not be maintained for Online Examination.

General Information/Instructions

  • The candidate will have to apply for vacancy of one Circle only. A candidate applying against vacancy of one Circle will not be eligible to apply against vacancy of any other Circle.
  • Candidature of the applicant will be considered only against the vacancies in the Circle for which he/she has applied/opted. Merit list will be drawn Circle wise and category wise.
  • Selected candidates will be posted in the Circle against whose vacancy they are selected.
  • The selected candidates will not be entitled for Inter-Circle transfer/Corporate Centre Posting/Corporate Centre Establishment Posting/Foreign Posting up to his/her promotion to SMGS-IV Grade OR 12 years of service, whichever is later.
  • On joining, the selected candidates will be designated as "Circle Based Officers" (CBOs) and will be on probation for a period of 6 months from their joining the Bank.
  • The CBOs will be subjected to continuous assessment during probation period for judging their suitability for confirmation.
  • Reservation for Person with Benchmark Disability (PwBD) candidates is horizontal and will be guided by various guidelines of Government of India. Only those persons with benchmark disabilities (not less than 40% of a specified disability) would be eligible for reservation.
  • OBC category candidates should submit the OBC certificate on format prescribed by Govt. of India, having "Non-Creamy Layer (NCL)" clause issued during period 01.04.2025 to the date of interview.
  • EWS candidates are required to produce 'Income & Asset Certificate' issued based on gross annual income for the Financial Year 2024-25 and valid for the year 2025-26 at the time of interview.
  • Candidates serving in Government/Quasi Government, Public Sector Undertakings including Nationalised Banks/RRBs are required to submit 'No Objection Certificate' from their employer at the time of interview.
  • Bank will arrange pre-examination training (PET) in online mode for SC/ST/OBC/PwBD candidates in consonance with the guidelines issued by Government of India.
  • Outstation candidates called for interview will be reimbursed Railway AC-III fare for the shortest route in India or actual expenses incurred (whichever is lower) from place of residence/posting to Interview venue.
  • Bank reserves right to cancel the recruitment process entirely at any stage.
  • Any legal proceedings in respect of any matter of claim or dispute arising out of this advertisement can be instituted only in Mumbai and Courts/Tribunals/Forums at Mumbai only shall have sole and exclusive jurisdiction.
  • Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification.
  • State Bank of India does not endorse, authorize or associate with any external coaching platform, consultancy, individual or digital channel claiming to provide guaranteed selection, influence in recruitment or insider guidance.

How to Apply

  • Candidates can apply online only from 29.01.2026 to 25.02.2026. No other mode of application will be accepted.
  • Candidates should have valid email ID and mobile no. which should be kept active till the declaration of final results.
  • Visit Bank's website https://sbi.bank.in/web/careers/current-openings and open the Online Application Form available under 'Current Openings'.
  • Fill the application carefully. Once the application is filled completely, candidates should submit the data.
  • After ensuring the correctness of the particulars of the application form, candidate should pay fees through the payment gateway integrated with the application.
  • The payment can be made by using debit card/credit card/Internet Banking by providing information as asked on the screen.
  • On successful completion of the transaction, e-receipt and application form will be generated, which may be printed for record.
  • Before applying online, candidates will be required to have a scanned (digital) image of their photograph, signature, left thumb impression, handwritten declaration, and all relevant documents (ID Proof, Date of Birth Proof, Job Profile, Resume, Educational Certificates, Experience Certificate, Form-16, Salary Slip) as per specifications.
  • Candidates should download their call letter (for Online Exam & Interview) by entering their registration number and password/date of birth from the Bank's website. No hard copy of the call letter will be sent by post.
  • Candidates who are called for online exam/interview will be required to bring one photo identity proof such as Passport/Aadhaar/PAN Card/Driving License/Voter's Id Card/Bank Passbook with duly attested Photograph in original as well as a self-attested photocopy thereof.
  • Not more than one application should be submitted by a candidate. In case of multiple applications, only the last valid (completed) application will be retained.
  • Helpdesk: In case of any problem, queries may be made at telephone no. 022-22820427 (between 11:00 AM to 05:00 PM on working days) or lodge their query on http://cgrs.ibps.in. Candidates should mention 'RECRUITMENT OF CIRCLE BASED OFFICERS IN STATE BANK OF INDIA-2026' in the subject.

  • Negative Marking: 0.5 marks per wrong answer

UPSC CSE 2026 – Preliminary Examination Pattern

The Civil Services (Preliminary) Examination is the first stage of the UPSC selection process. It is a screening test used to shortlist candidates for the Main Examination. Marks scored in Prelims are not counted in the final merit ranking.

Paper Subject Type Marks Duration
Paper I General Studies (GS) Objective (MCQs) 200 Marks 2 Hours
Paper II CSAT (Aptitude Test) Objective (MCQs) 200 Marks 2 Hours

Prelims Key Rules

  • Both papers are objective type (Multiple Choice Questions).
  • Paper II (CSAT) is qualifying in nature – minimum 33% marks required.
  • Marks of Paper I are considered for cutoff and shortlisting for Mains.
  • Negative marking applies: 1/3rd mark deducted for each wrong answer.
  • Leaving a question blank carries no penalty.

UPSC CSE 2026 – Main Examination Pattern

The Civil Services (Main) Examination is the second stage and consists of a written examination followed by an Interview/Personality Test. Marks obtained in the written papers and interview are counted for the final merit list.

Paper Subject Marks Nature
Paper A Compulsory Indian Language 300 Qualifying
Paper B English 300 Qualifying
Paper I Essay 250 Merit
Paper II General Studies I 250 Merit
Paper III General Studies II 250 Merit
Paper IV General Studies III 250 Merit
Paper V General Studies IV (Ethics) 250 Merit
Paper VI Optional Subject – Paper 1 250 Merit
Paper VII Optional Subject – Paper 2 250 Merit

Main Exam Structure

  • Total Written Papers: 9
  • Qualifying Papers: 2 (Indian Language & English)
  • Merit Papers: 7
  • Total Marks (Written): 1750

Interview / Personality Test

Stage Marks
Personality Test / Interview 275

Final Merit Calculation

  • Written Exam Marks: 1750
  • Interview Marks: 275
  • Total Merit Marks: 2025

Important Notes

  • Prelims marks are used only for qualification, not for final ranking.
  • Mains + Interview marks decide final service allocation.
  • Negative marking applies in Prelims only.
  • Candidates must qualify in both language papers to have their merit papers evaluated.

Selection Process for RRB Group D CEN 09/2025

The recruitment consists of 4 successive stages:

Stage 1: Computer Based Test (CBT)

Duration: 90 minutes (120 minutes for candidates using scribe)

Total Questions: 100 (Each of 1 mark)

Subject Number of Questions
General Science 25
Mathematics 25
General Intelligence and Reasoning 30
General Awareness and Current Affairs 20
TOTAL 100 Questions = 100 Marks

Exam Pattern:

  • Objective type with multiple choices
  • Questions available in English, Hindi, and 13 regional languages (Assamese, Bengali, Gujarati, Kannada, Konkani, Malayalam, Manipuri, Marathi, Odia, Punjabi, Tamil, Telugu, Urdu)
  • Negative Marking: 1/3 mark deducted for each wrong answer
  • Section-wise distribution may vary slightly in actual exam

Minimum Qualifying Marks:

  • UR: 40%
  • EWS: 40%
  • OBC-NCL: 30%
  • SC: 30%
  • ST: 30%
  • PwBD: May be relaxed by 2 marks in case of shortage

Syllabus (Indicative):

  • Mathematics: Number system, BODMAS, Decimals, Fractions, LCM, HCF, Ratio & Proportion, Percentages, Mensuration, Time & Work, Time & Distance, Simple & Compound Interest, Profit & Loss, Algebra, Geometry, Trigonometry, Elementary Statistics, Square root, Age Calculations, Calendar & Clock, Pipes & Cistern
  • General Intelligence & Reasoning: Analogies, Alphabetical & Number Series, Coding & Decoding, Mathematical operations, Relationships, Syllogism, Jumbling, Venn Diagram, Data Interpretation & Sufficiency, Conclusions & Decision making, Similarities & Differences, Analytical Reasoning, Classification, Directions, Statement-Arguments & Assumptions
  • General Science: Physics, Chemistry, Life Sciences of 10th standard level (CBSE)
  • General Awareness & Current Affairs: Science & Technology, Sports, Culture, Personalities, Economics, Politics, and other important subjects

Normalization: Marks will be normalized if CBT conducted in multiple sessions

Stage 2: Physical Efficiency Test (PET)

Shortlisting: 3 times the total vacancies (may vary) based on CBT merit

Nature: Qualifying (Mandatory to pass - marks not counted for final merit)

Candidate Type Test 1: Weight Carrying Test 2: Running
Male Candidates Lift and carry 35 kg weight for 100 meters in 2 minutes (in one chance, without putting down) Run 1000 meters in 4 minutes 15 seconds (in one chance)
Female Candidates Lift and carry 20 kg weight for 100 meters in 2 minutes (in one chance, without putting down) Run 1000 meters in 5 minutes 40 seconds (in one chance)
Transgender Candidates Same relaxed standards as Female candidates

Important PET Notes:

  • Two-stage test: First weight carrying, then running (after recovery gap)
  • Failing in weight carrying means elimination (no running test)
  • Weight carrying involves lifting sandbag (without handle) from waist-height bench and carrying without dropping
  • Candidates' responsibility to ensure medical fitness for PET - Railways not responsible for injuries
  • Exemptions from PET:
    • Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) - must pass medical examination
    • Course Completed Act Apprentices (CCAA)
    • Ex-Servicemen (ExSM)
  • Pregnant Candidates: Must submit self-declaration. If pregnant, PET deferred till 6 weeks post-confinement. Vacancy kept reserved.

Stage 3: Document Verification (DV)

  • Shortlisting: 1:1 ratio of vacancies based on CBT merit + PET qualification
  • Candidates must produce original certificates
  • No additional time given - absence leads to candidature cancellation
  • Scanned copies to be uploaded before DV at https://oirms-ir.gov.in/rrbdv
  • Certificates must be in English/Hindi (translated version required otherwise)
  • Hard copy of signed application form to be brought

Stage 4: Medical Examination (ME)

  • Conducted by Railway Medical Authorities
  • Must pass requisite medical fitness test as per IRMM
  • Visual acuity standards strictly enforced
  • Medical appeal option available (one final opportunity on payment)
  • Candidates found medically unsuitable will NOT be given alternative appointment

Final Merit & Selection

  • Based on CBT marks (after normalization if applicable)
  • Subject to PET qualification, DV clearance, and medical fitness
  • Post/Railway allotment as per candidate's preference, merit, medical fitness, and vacancy
  • In case of tie: Older candidate ranked higher; if age also same, alphabetical order of name (A to Z)
  • No right to appointment - RRB/RRC only recommends; appointment by Railway Administration

Reservation & Relaxation for RRB Group D CEN 09/2025

Vertical Reservation (Community-wise):

  • SC (Scheduled Caste)
  • ST (Scheduled Tribe)
  • OBC-NCL (Other Backward Classes - Non Creamy Layer)
  • EWS (Economically Weaker Sections)

Horizontal Reservation (across all communities):

  • Ex-Servicemen (ExSM)
  • Course Completed Act Apprentices (CCAA) trained in Railway Establishments
  • Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD)

Important Reservation Rules:

For OBC-NCL Candidates:

  • Must produce OBC-NCL certificate issued on or after 01.04.2025 but not later than 02.03.2026
  • Certificate must be as per central list (http://www.ncbc.nic.in)
  • Must submit self-declaration (Annexure IIA) at DV that they don't belong to Creamy Layer
  • Certificate must mention: "Does NOT belong to Creamy Layer as per DOPT OM 36012/22/93-Estt.(SCT) dated 08.09.93, modified vide OM 36033/1/2013-Estt.(Res.) dated 13.09.2017"
  • OBC in state list but not in central list: NOT eligible for reservation

For EWS Candidates:

  • NOT covered under SC/ST/OBC-NCL
  • Gross annual family income < Rs. 8 lakh for F.Y. 2024-25
  • Family should NOT own:
    • 5 acres or more of agricultural land, OR
    • Residential flat of 1000 sq. ft. or more, OR
    • Residential plot of 100 sq. yards or more (notified municipalities), OR
    • Residential plot of 200 sq. yards or more (other areas)
  • Family: Applicant, parents, siblings <18 years, spouse, children <18 years
  • Must possess valid Income & Asset Certificate (Annexure III) based on F.Y. 2024-25 income/assets

For PwBD Candidates:

  • Minimum 40% benchmark disability required for reservation/relaxation
  • Certificate as per Form V/VI of RPwD Rules 2024 (Annexure V-A/V-B)
  • Must submit Unique Disability Identity (UDID)
  • Suitability for posts indicated in Annexure-A
  • Eligible Disabilities:
    • VI (Visually Impaired): Blindness (B), Low Vision (LV)
    • HI (Hearing Impaired): Deaf (D), Hard of Hearing (HH)
    • LD (Locomotor Disability): OA, OL, OAL, BL, LC, DW, AAV, CP, SD (without neurological/limb dysfunction), SI (without neurological/limb dysfunction)
    • MD (Multiple Disabilities)
  • Temporary disability candidates NOT eligible for reservation (as per DePwD OM dated 17.12.2025)

For Ex-Servicemen (ExSM):

  • Must have valid Ex-Serviceman Certificate from Zila Sainik Board
  • Serving defense personnel expected to be released within 1 year can also apply
  • Must submit NOC with probable discharge date (Annexure VI-A) at DV
  • Declaration/Undertaking (Annexure VI) required at DV
  • ExSM who already secured civil employment using ExSM quota: NOT eligible for ExSM reservation (only age relaxation available)
  • Different medical standards applicable (Para 534 of IRMM)

For CCAA (Railway Establishments):

  • Must have completed Act Apprenticeship by 02.03.2026 (appeared in NCVT exam)
  • National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) from NCVT required at DV
  • Weightage: 1/3rd marks from NCVT examination added to CBT marks for merit
  • If NCVT weightage gives lower score, higher of the two will be considered
  • Exempted from PET
  • Can apply to any RRB (not just training Railway)

Eligibility Criteria

Educational Qualifications

  • Junior Engineer (Electrical): Diploma in Electrical Engineering from a recognized institution with valid certificate

Desirable Qualifications

Selection Process

  • Written Examination: Computer-based test covering general knowledge, reasoning, mathematics, technical subjects related to the post, and Marathi language
  • Document Verification: Candidates qualifying in written test will be called for document verification. Candidates must bring all original documents along with self-attested photocopies
  • Personal Interview/Skill Test: For technical and specialist posts, candidates may have to appear for personal interview and/or skill test
  • Medical Examination: Selected candidates must undergo medical fitness test as per NMMC norms
  • Final Merit List: Final selection will be based on performance in written test, interview (if applicable) and document verification
  • Typing Test: For Clerk-Typist and similar posts, typing test in Marathi and English will be conducted

General Information/Instructions

  • Candidates must read the official notification carefully before applying
  • Only online applications through the official website www.nmmc.gov.in will be accepted
  • Candidates should have a valid email ID and mobile number which should be active during the entire recruitment process
  • Incomplete applications or applications without required documents will be rejected
  • False information or suppression of facts will lead to cancellation of candidature at any stage
  • NMMC reserves the right to cancel or modify the recruitment process at any stage
  • Only Indian citizens are eligible to apply unless otherwise specified
  • Candidates already employed in government/semi-government organizations must produce NOC (No Objection Certificate) from their employer
  • Selected candidates will be appointed on probation for a period as per NMMC rules
  • The decision of NMMC in all matters related to recruitment will be final and binding
  • Canvassing in any form will disqualify the candidate
  • No TA/DA will be provided for attending the exam or interview

How to Apply

  • Step 1: Visit the official website of Navi Mumbai Municipal Corporation at www.nmmc.gov.in
  • Step 2: On the homepage, locate the "Recruitment" or "Career" section
  • Step 3: Click on the relevant recruitment notification link for NMMC Recruitment 2025
  • Step 4: Read the detailed notification and instructions carefully
  • Step 5: Click on "Apply Online" button to start the application process
  • Step 6: Register yourself by providing basic details like name, email ID, and mobile number
  • Step 7: After registration, login using the credentials received on your email/mobile
  • Step 8: Fill the online application form with accurate personal, educational, and other required details
  • Step 9: Upload scanned copies of your photograph, signature, and other required documents in prescribed format and size
  • Step 10: Pay the application fee online through available payment modes (Credit Card/Debit Card/Net Banking/UPI)
  • Step 11: Review all the entered information carefully before final submission
  • Step 12: Submit the application form and take a printout of the confirmation page for future reference
  • Step 13: Keep the payment receipt and application confirmation safe until the recruitment process is complete

NMMC Recruitment 2026 - FAQs

1. What is the starting date to apply for NMMC Recruitment 2026?

Ans: Starting Date to apply is 20/01/2026

2. What is the last apply date for NMMC Recruitment 2026?

Ans: Last apply date is 01/03/2026 

3. What is the Eligibility to apply for NMMC Recruitment 2026?

Ans: Eligibility varies by post. For Junior Engineer posts, Diploma in relevant engineering is required. For medical posts, MBBS with respective post-graduate qualification is mandatory. For administrative posts, Graduate degree with relevant qualifications is required.

4. What is the Maximum Age Limit to apply for NMMC Recruitment 2026?

Ans: Maximum age limit is 38 years for most posts, with relaxation for reserved categories as per government norms.

5. How many vacancies are being recruited by NMMC in 2026?

Ans: Total 432+ Vacancies across Group A (12 posts), Group B (07 posts), and Group C (113 posts).

6. What is the application fee for NMMC Recruitment 2026?

Ans: Application fee is Rs. 1,000/- for General/OBC/Other categories and Rs. 900/- for SC/ST/PWD categories.

7. What is the salary for NMMC posts?

Ans: Salary ranges from Rs. 38,600 to Rs. 1,77,500 per month depending on the post, as per 7th Pay Commission norms.

8. Is there any negative marking in the NMMC examination?

Ans: Details about negative marking will be mentioned in the exam pattern section of the official notification. Candidates should check the detailed notification before appearing for the exam.

9. Can candidates apply for multiple posts in NMMC Recruitment 2026?

Ans: Candidates can apply for multiple posts if they meet the eligibility criteria for each post. Separate application forms and fees must be submitted for each post.

10. What documents are required for NMMC online application?

Ans: Required documents include scanned photograph, signature, educational certificates, caste certificate (if applicable), experience certificates, age proof, and other relevant documents as specified in the notification.

Advertisement
