SEBI Young Professional Program 2026 Vacancy Details

The total number of vacancies for SEBI Young Professional Program Recruitment 2026 is 91 posts distributed among domains as under:

Domain Number of Young Professionals
Young Professional (Securities Market Operations) 40
Young Professional (Law) 13
Young Professional (Research) 4
Young Professional (Information Technology) 29
Young Professional (Rajbasha) 5
Total 91

The Board reserves the right to modify the number of Young Professionals to be engaged or not to engage any Young Professional at all.

Eligibility Criteria

1. Age & Nationality

  • The candidate must be an Indian citizen.
  • Age must not be more than 30 years as on the date of publication of the advertisement.

2. General Essential Skills (for all domains)

All candidates are expected to have reasonable:

  • Understanding of financial markets.
  • Analytical ability.
  • Knowledge of Information Technology tools.
  • Aptitude for research.
  • Oral and written communication skills.
  • Judgment and interpersonal skills.

3. Domain-wise Educational Qualification, Work Experience & Skills

Young Professional (Securities Market Operations)

  • Post Graduate qualification (degree / 2-year diploma) in Management (with specialization in Finance) from a recognized and reputed university/institution with minimum 60% aggregate marks or equivalent CGPA; OR
  • Chartered Accountant (CA) / Company Secretary (CS) / Cost Management Accountant (CMA) with minimum 55% aggregate marks in the final level of the course; OR
  • Successfully completed all 3 levels of Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA) course from CFA Institute (USA).
  • At least 1 year of work experience in the financial sector after completion of Post Graduate qualification or CA/CS/CMA/CFA.

Young Professional (Law)

  • Bachelors’ Degree in Law from a recognized and reputed university/institution with minimum 60% aggregate marks or equivalent CGPA.
  • At least 1 year of work experience in corporate/securities laws after completion of Bachelors’ Degree in Law / LLM.
  • Preference to candidates with experience in a financial or investment environment requiring knowledge of market practices and rules, regulations and guidelines governing the securities industry.

Young Professional (Research)

  • Post Graduate qualification (degree / 2-year diploma) in Management (with specialization in Finance) / Economics / Commerce / Financial Economics / Business Economics / Applied Statistics / Econometrics from a recognized and reputed university/institution with minimum 60% aggregate marks or equivalent CGPA.
  • For candidates with only Post Graduate qualification: at least 1 year of research/work experience in areas including but not limited to financial markets, corporate finance, macroeconomic theory, corporate governance, financial institutions and related areas of international finance, supported by published work/working papers/submission of papers in research conferences.
  • For candidates with PhD in relevant fields (Economics/Econometrics/Finance/Commerce, preferably focused on financial markets): work experience requirement is not mandatory.
  • Skill: Knowledge of statistical software.

Young Professional (Information Technology)

  • Any of the following degrees from a recognized and reputed university/institution with minimum 60% aggregate marks or equivalent CGPA:
    • B.E. / B.Tech in Electronics / Electronics and Communication / Information Technology / Computer Science; OR
    • MCA / MSc (IT) / MSc (Computer Science) / MBA (Systems) / MBA (Analytics) / M.Tech (Computer Science/IT/Relevant Stream) / MS (Computer Science/IT/Relevant Stream) or equivalent degree.
  • At least 1 year of work experience in software development (programming) or cyber security.

Skills – Software Development (Programming)

  • Proficiency in any of: JSP/J2EE with Spring/Hibernate; Angular; SAP-ABAP/Web Dynpro; Python (with ML frameworks like Pandas, Pytorch, scikit-learn, NumPy, Matplotlib, Plotly); IBM BPM development.
  • Knowledge of ML algorithms, Deep Learning frameworks and NLP; or deep understanding of statistical concepts and methodologies including Multivariate Analysis, anomaly and pattern detection techniques, graph database.
  • Proficiency in front-end frameworks like React, Vue etc. and/or knowledge of digital forensic analysis or OSINT frameworks.
  • Database proficiency in DB2/ORACLE/PostgreSQL/MySQL etc.

Skills – Cyber Security

  • Knowledge of global best practices in cyber security and IT.
  • Ability to take corrective measures/prudent response in case of cyber-attacks.
  • Experience in development, implementation and compliance with cyber and information security policies and procedures.
  • Installation/operation of Data Security (DLP/DAM), Network Security (Firewall/IPS/Proxy/DDoS), or System Security (PIM/Antivirus/Anti-APT) products.

Young Professional (Rajbasha)

  • Master’s Degree in Hindi/Hindi Translation with English as a subject at Bachelor’s Degree level; OR
  • Master’s Degree in Sanskrit/English/Economics/Commerce with Hindi as a subject at Bachelor’s Degree level; OR
  • Master’s Degree in both English and Hindi/Hindi Translation from a recognized University/Institute.
  • At least 1 year of work experience in the field including knowledge of Hindi typing.

Age Limit

  • Maximum age: Not more than 30 years as on the date of publication of advertisement.

Selection Process for SEBI Young Professional Program 2026

Candidates will be selected based on a three-step process:

  • 1. Application Screening: Applications will be screened and shortlisted as per criteria decided by SEBI, which may include institute ranking (e.g. NIRF), academic performance, relevance of work experience, Statement of Purpose, extracurricular activities, and overall profile.
  • 2. Preliminary Interview: Conducted in virtual mode for shortlisted candidates.
  • 3. Final Interview: Conducted in virtual mode; candidates must have valid ID proof for verification as required.

For Young Professionals (IT), additional factors considered may include relevant programming/cyber security certifications, valid GATE score and achievements in coding competitions, bug bounty, hackathons, or zero-day vulnerability reporting.

SEBI’s decision regarding eligibility, screening, interviews, assessment, number of vacancies and results will be final and binding. SEBI may select or reject any candidate and may cancel the advertisement fully or partly.

How To Apply

Eligible candidates can apply online for SEBI Young Professional Program 2026 by following these steps:

  1. Visit SEBI’s official website: www.sebi.gov.in and go to the “Careers” section.
  2. Access the Young Professional Program online application form at:
    Apply for SEBI YPP 2026.
  3. Fill the online application form carefully with accurate personal, academic, experience and domain choice details. A candidate is permitted to apply for only one domain.
  4. On submission, note down the generated Application Number and save the system-generated filled-in application form for future reference.
  5. Ensure that no false, tampered, fabricated or invalid particulars are furnished and that no material information is suppressed.

No other mode of application is permitted. The online application window will remain open for 21 days from the date of publication of the advertisement in newspapers.

Important Dates

Event Date / Duration
Notification issue date (on letter) 08/02/2026
Application Window 21 days from date of publication of advertisement in newspapers

Instructions

  • Candidates can apply for only one domain; multiple applications across same or different domains will lead to cancellation of candidature.
  • Information submitted in the online application will be treated as final; no changes are allowed after submission.
  • Application Numbers of shortlisted candidates at each stage will be published on SEBI website under “Careers” and further stage details will be sent to registered email IDs.
  • Candidates must produce original documents for verification at the time of onboarding; absence of any required original document will result in cancellation of candidature.
  • Engagement/candidature can be cancelled/terminated at any stage if any material information is found inaccurate, false, tampered, fabricated or invalid, or in case of unfair means, impersonation, canvassing, etc.
  • Corrigendum, if any, will be published only on SEBI website (www.sebi.gov.in).

Application Fee

The notification does not mention any application fee for SEBI Young Professional Program 2026.

Salary/Stipend

  • Monthly stipend: INR 70,000 (all inclusive).
  • Income tax or any other applicable tax will be deducted at source. SEBI will not be liable for taxes or other contributions payable by the YP on payments made under this engagement.
  • SEBI may provide unfurnished shared accommodation in Mumbai (subject to availability) for YPs not based in and around Mumbai; no additional payment/reimbursement for non-availability.
  • For official domestic travel approved by Competent Authority, YPs will be eligible for local conveyance, halting, boarding and incidental allowances to the same extent as Grade A officers.

  • 1. The examination will be conducted at venues given in the respective call letters.
  • 2. No request for change of centre/venue/date/session for Examination shall be entertained.
  • 3. Export-Import Bank of India, however, reserves the right to cancel any of the Examination Centres and/ or add some other Centres, at its discretion, depending upon the number of candidates, administrative feasibility, etc.
  • 4. Export-Import Bank of India also reserves the right to allot the candidate to any Centre other than the one he/she has opted for.
  • 5. Candidate will appear for the examination at an Examination Centre at his/her own risks and expenses and Export-Import Bank of India will not be responsible for any injury, expense or losses etc. of any nature.
  • 6. Choice of centre once exercised by the candidate will be final. If sufficient number of candidates do not opt for a particular centre for examination, OR if the number of candidates is more than the capacity available for exam for a centre, Export-Import Bank of India reserves the right to allot any other centre to the candidate.
  • Decision of Export-Import Bank of India in all matters relating to recruitment will be final and binding on the candidate. No correspondence or personal enquiries shall be entertained by the Export-Import Bank of India in this behalf.
  • Export-Import Bank of India would be analysing the responses (answers) of individual candidates with those of other candidates to detect patterns of similarity of right and wrong answers. If in the analytical procedure adopted by Export-Import Bank of India in this regard, it is inferred/ concluded that the responses have been shared and scores obtained are not genuine/ valid, Export-Import Bank of India reserves the right to cancel the candidature of the concerned candidates and the result of such candidates (disqualified) will be withheld.
  • There will be no sectional cut off but the final list for interviews will be drawn based on the candidate’s performance in the written test.
  • Instances for providing incorrect information and/or process violation by a candidate detected at any stage of the selection process will lead to disqualification of the candidate from the selection process and he/she will not be allowed to appear in any recruitment process of Export-Import Bank of India in the future. If such instances go undetected during the current selection process but are detected subsequently, such disqualification will take place with retrospective affect.
  • A pre-recruitment training will be organised for the candidates from reserved categories. Details of the training and its mode of delivery (online / offline) will be intimated to the candidates who opt for it through the online application form. Details will be shared with such candidates after the last date of registration.
  • Candidates whose writing speed is adversely affected permanently for any reason can use their own scribe at their cost during the examination. In all such cases where a scribe is used, the following rules will apply:
  • • The candidate will have to arrange his/her own scribe at his/her own cost.
  • • The scribe arranged by the candidate should not be a candidate for the same examination. If violation of the above is detected at any stage of the process, candidature of both the candidate and the scribe will be cancelled. Candidates eligible for and who wish to use the services of a scribe in the examination should invariably carefully indicate the same in the online application form. Any subsequent request may not be favourably entertained.
  • • A person acting as a scribe for one candidate cannot be a scribe for another candidate.
  • • The scribe may be from any academic stream.
  • • Both the candidate as well as scribe will have to give a suitable undertaking confirming that the scribe fulfils all the stipulated eligibility criteria for a scribe mentioned above. Further in case it later transpires that he/she did not fulfil any laid down eligibility criteria or suppressed material facts the candidature of the applicant will stand cancelled, irrespective of the result of the examination.
  • • Those candidates who use a scribe shall be eligible for compensatory time of 20 minutes for every hour of the examination or as otherwise advised.
  • • Scribe should not answer on his/her own. Any such behaviour observed will result in cancellation of candidature.
  • • Only candidates registered for compensatory time will be allowed such concessions since compensatory time given to candidates shall be system based, it shall not be possible for the test conducting agency to allow such time if he / she is not registered for the same. Candidates not registered for compensatory time shall not be allowed such concessions.
  • • During the exam, at any stage, if it is found that scribe is independently answering the questions, the exam session will be terminated, and candidate’s candidature will be cancelled. The candidature of such candidates using the services of a scribe will also be cancelled if it is reported after the examination by the test administrator personnel that the scribe independently answered the questions.
  • A compensatory time of twenty minutes per hour or otherwise advised shall be permitted for the candidates with locomotor disability and cerebral palsy where dominant (writing) extremity is affected to the extent of slowing the performance of function (minimum of 40% impairment).
  • Visually Impaired candidates (who suffer from not less than 40% of disability) may opt to view the contents of the test in magnified font and all such candidates will be eligible for compensatory time of 20 minutes for every hour or otherwise advised of examination.
  • These guidelines are subject to change in terms of GoI guidelines/ clarifications, if any, from time to time.

How to Apply

  • Candidates need to apply online only from January 26, 2026, up to February 22, 2026. No other mode of application will be accepted.
  • Scan their: Photograph (4.5cm × 3.5cm), Signature (with black ink), Left thumb impression (on white paper with black or blue ink), A handwritten declaration (on a white paper with black ink) (text given below), The consolidated Mark Sheets of Graduation and Post-Graduation, Graduation and Post-Graduation Degree, Caste Certificate (if applicable) Ensuring that all these scanned documents adhere to the required specifications as given in this Advertisement.
  • Signature in CAPITAL LETTERS will NOT be accepted.
  • The left thumb impression should be properly scanned and not smudged. (If a candidate is not having left thumb, he/she may use his/ her right thumb for applying.)
  • The text for the handwritten declaration is as follows – “I, _______ (Name of the candidate), hereby declare that all the information submitted by me in the application form is correct, true and valid. I will present the supporting documents as and when required.”
  • The above-mentioned handwritten declaration has to be in the candidate’s handwriting and in English only. If it is written and uploaded by anybody else or in any other language, the application will be considered as invalid.
  • Keep the necessary details/documents ready to make Online Payment of the requisite application fee/ intimation charges.
  • Have a valid personal email ID and mobile no., which should be kept active till the completion of this Recruitment Process. Bank may send intimation to download call letters for the Examination etc. through the mentioned e-mail ID and / or SMS. In case a candidate does not have a valid personal e-mail ID, he/she should create his/her new e-mail ID and mobile no. before applying on-line and must maintain that email account and mobile number.
  • Candidates to visit Online Application and click on the option "APPLY ONLINE" which will open a new screen.
  • To register, choose the tab "Click here for New Registration" and enter Name, Contact details and Email-id. A Provisional Registration Number and Password will be generated by the system and displayed on the screen. Candidate should note down the Provisional Registration Number and Password. An Email & SMS indicating the Provisional Registration number and Password will also be sent.
  • In case the candidate is unable to complete the application form in one go, he / she can save the data already entered by choosing "SAVE AND NEXT" tab. Prior to submission of the online application, candidates are advised to use the "SAVE AND NEXT" facility to verify the details in the online application form and modify the same if required. Visually Impaired candidates should fill the application form carefully and verify/ get the details verified to ensure that the same are correct prior to final submission.
  • Candidates are advised to carefully fill and verify the details filled in the online application themselves as no change will be possible/ entertained after clicking the COMPLETE REGISTRATION BUTTON.
  • The Name of the candidate or his /her father/ Husband etc. should be spelt correctly in the application as it appears in the Certificates/ Mark sheets/Identity proof. Any change/alteration found may disqualify the candidature.
  • Validate your details and save your application by clicking the 'Validate your details' and 'Save & Next' button.
  • Candidates can proceed to upload Photo & Signature as per the specifications given in the Guidelines for Scanning and Upload of Photograph and Signature detailed under point "C".
  • Candidates can proceed to fill other details of the Application Form.
  • Click on the Preview Tab to preview and verify the entire application form before COMPLETE REGISTRATION.
  • Modify details, if required, and click on 'COMPLETE REGISTRATION' ONLY after verifying and ensuring that the photograph, signature uploaded and other details filled by you are correct.
  • Click on 'Payment' Tab and proceed for payment.
  • Click on 'Submit' button.
  • The application form is integrated with the payment gateway and the payment process can be completed by following the instructions.
  • The payment can be made by using Debit Cards (RuPay/Visa/MasterCard/Maestro), Credit Cards, Internet Banking, IMPS, Cash Cards/ Mobile Wallets.
  • After submitting your payment information in the online application form, PLEASE WAIT FOR THE INTIMATION FROM THE SERVER. DO NOT PRESS BACK OR REFRESH BUTTON IN ORDER TO AVOID DOUBLE CHARGE.
  • On successful completion of the transaction, an e-Receipt will be generated.
  • Non-generation of 'E-Receipt' indicates PAYMENT FAILURE. On failure of payment, Candidates are advised to login again using their Provisional Registration Number and Password and repeat the process of payment.
  • Candidates are required to take a printout of the e-Receipt and online Application Form containing fee details. Please note that if the same cannot be generated, online transaction may not have been successful.
  • For Credit Card users: All charges are listed in Indian Rupee. If you use a non-Indian credit card, your bank will convert to your local currency based on prevailing exchange rates.
  • To ensure the security of your data, please close the browser window once your transaction is completed.
  • There is facility to print application form containing fee details after payment of fees.
  • While filling in the Online Application Form the candidate will be provided with separate links for uploading Photograph, signature, left thumb impression and handwritten declaration.
  • Click on the respective link “Upload Photograph / signature / Upload left thumb impression / handwritten declaration/ other relevant documents”.
  • Browse and select the location where the Scanned Photograph / signature / left thumb impression / handwritten declaration/ other relevant document’s file has been saved.
  • Select the file by clicking on it
  • Click the ‘Open/Upload’
  • If the file size and format are not as prescribed, an error message will be displayed.
  • Preview of the uploaded image will help to see the quality of the image. In case of unclear / smudged, the same may be re-uploaded to the expected clarity /quality.

  • Essential qualifications: Minimum engineering graduation marks 60% required.
  • Desirable: Candidates having working experience in EMU rolling stock in Railway/RRTS/Metro/LRT/HSR/Suburban rail system will be preferred.

Experience:

  • (i) Sr. Manager (IDA E4/L-11) – Presently the candidate should be working either in the analogue grade or in E-3/L-10 with minimum 2 years in E-3/L-10.
  • (ii) Manager (IDA E3/L-10) – Presently the candidate should be working either in the analogue grade or in E-2/L-8 with minimum 2 years in E-2/L-8.
  • (iii) Candidates should have minimum 8 years / 4 years of post-qualification working experience.
  • (iv) Candidates should have working experience in design, technical specifications/bid preparation, testing, operation and maintenance of EMU rolling stock in Railway/RRTS/Metro/LRT/HSR/Suburban rail system.
  • For Project Engineer: The applicants should have minimum 2 years of post-qualification working experience.

Salary/Stipend

  • Basic Pay at minimum of the IIDA pay scale, DA, HRA, PF, Cafeteria and other perks and allowances as per the policy of the corporation.
  • Annual increment @ 3% of basic pay.
  • Medical benefits as per the policy of the corporation
  • Pay protection will be given to the candidates working in Govt/Semi-government/PSU organisation (including on contract).

Age Limit (as on 28-02-2026)

  • The upper age should not exceed 40/35/30 years as on the date of closing date of Vacancy Notification for Senior Manager/Manager/Project Engineer respectively.
  • Age relaxation – as per Government Policy.

Important Dates

Date Description
29-01-2026 Notification Date
28-02-2026 Last Date for Submission of Application
28-02-2026 Cut-off Date for Eligibility

Selection Process

  • After preliminary screening of the applications received from candidates by mail, the eligible candidate(s) will only be called for document verification and interview.
  • In case of more number of eligible applications received, then candidates equal to 05 times the notified vacancies will only be called for document verification and interview based on their engineering marks and experience.
  • The candidate will be interviewed by a nominated Committee and the selection will be finalized on merit based on the performance in the interview, qualification and post qualification experience gained by the Candidate.
  • The decision of the Nominated Committee of MRVC shall be final and binding.
  • The period of contract will be for a period of Five years.
  • Panel of standby candidates over and above requirement will be maintained as per merit as decided by MRVC. Such candidates may be engaged as per requirements of MRVC projects within the validity of panel. Posts notified are not regular establishment posts.
  • The candidate selected for the above contractual agreement shall not be absorbed in MRVC regular service. The candidate therefore shall not have right to claim for permanent absorption in MRVC and shall be required to give an undertaking in writing to MRVC to that effect.
  • The Corporation reserves the right to terminate the contract if the contract appointee is found unsuitable, by giving one month notice or payment in lieu thereof. Similarly, the appointee will be required to give one month notice to MRVC for termination of contract.
  • The selected candidate on engagement should also attend emergencies and other calls of duties, as demanded and expected, during their day to day activities.
  • In the event the appointee is found involved in undesirable activities such as embezzlement, unlawful activities (including passing on confidential information of MRVC), unauthorized absence, in-subordination or breach of any of the terms of contract without prejudice to the right to initiate civil/criminal proceedings, the contract appointment shall be terminated.
  • Selected candidates shall use electronic resources of MRVC in strict adherence to the policies and guidelines issued by MRVC from time to time. The email account and user ID's created for official purposes shall always be used in a responsible, effective, ethical and lawful manner. Any misuse of these resources and / or putting the Corporation at risk of any liability based on such misuse shall result in termination of employment and appropriate legal action.

General Information/Instructions

  • The candidates must bring with them original application, original certificates, along with one set of self-attested photocopy in proof of photo identity, age, caste, educational qualification along with mark sheets of all semesters of Degree and experience on the date of document verification and interaction, failing which candidate will not be eligible for interview. Formula of aggregate % calculation of Degree (CGPA/SGPA etc) to be attached with application.
  • Candidate should bring one character certificate from Gazetted Officers/Executives Officers for certifying that he is bearing good moral character.
  • Incomplete or vague educational qualification will be invalid.
  • Even after contractual agreement, if any document/ certificate/ information are found incorrect or false in any scrutiny or verification, then the contractual service will be immediately terminated forthwith without assigning any reason and prior notice, besides legal action which may also be initiated.
  • The Corporation reserves the right to cancel/ restrict/ curtail/ enlarge the contract engagement process, if need so arises, without any prior notice and without assigning any reasons therefore.
  • No train/bus fare/ TA/DA shall be payable by the Corporation to the candidates for appearing document verification and interaction.
  • Selected candidate will have to pass prescribed medical examination before the contract is entered into, for fitness to perform the work awarded.
  • The selected candidates should be able to join at the project site within maximum 45 days after issuing of offer of appointment by MRVC. Any deviation in the said policy will be dealt on case to case basis, based on the merits of the case.

How to Apply

  • Duly filled in application should be sent to Senior Manager (HR), Mumbai Railway Vikas Corporation Ltd. by email on [email protected].

  • The cut-off date for eligibility is 28.02.2026.
  • Self-attested documents to be attached with the filled application : Mandatory documents i. Copy of original application ii. Copies of certificate in proof of qualification (As per the qualification specified in Notification) iii. Copy of Proof of Date of Birth (SSLC/SSC Certificate/Birth Certificate) iv. Copy of Photo ID proof (Aadhar/Pan Card) v. Copy of valid OBC-NCL certificate in the format required for Central Government employment. vi. Copy of document regarding experience, last served and others. vii. Candidates employed with Government Departments / PSUs / Autonomous Bodies have to produce NOC at the time of document verification, failing which they would not be allowed to appear for document verification. viii. Character certificate from Gazetted officer/Executive officers for certifying that he/she is bearing good moral character.

Eligibility Criteria

Educational Qualification

  • Ph.D. in Life Sciences or Biological Sciences.
  • Minimum 60% marks or first class or equivalent grade in Ph.D.
  • Degree must be from recognized universities/institutions.

Mandatory Experience

  • Experience in LC-MS based proteomics is mandatory.
  • Must include sample preparation, instrument handling, and data analysis.
  • Candidacy will NOT be considered without LC-MS based proteomics experience.

Preferred Qualifications & Experience

  • Experience in mammalian tissue culture.
  • Molecular biology expertise.
  • Biochemical assays experience.
  • Peer-reviewed publications showing experience in the above areas.
  • Candidates with publications demonstrating proteomics expertise will be preferred.

Age Limit

  • Not more than 35 years as on date of walk-in interview.
  • Age relaxation may be considered for candidates with higher qualifications/experience (with prior approval of competent authority).

Selection Process

Interview Based Selection

  • Selection through walk-in interview.
  • Screening committee will evaluate candidates based on qualifications and experience.
  • If candidates are large in number, the institute may restrict interviews to a reasonable limit based on screening committee recommendations.
  • Candidates with additional qualifications/experience above minimum may be preferred.

Important Selection Points

  • Minimum qualifications and experience are bare minimum requirements.
  • Mere possession of minimum qualifications does not entitle a candidate to be considered.
  • Additional qualifications and experience must be clearly mentioned in the application for better evaluation.
  • Interview date is the criterion date for determining age, qualifications, and experience.
  • If selected candidate does not join or resigns, waitlisted candidates may be offered the position.

Salary / Remuneration

  • Monthly consolidated emoluments: ₹80,000 per month.
  • Tenure: Initially for 1 year, extendable for further period subject to continuation of project and satisfactory performance.
  • Funding: Position is funded by Private Agency (project-based).

Important Terms & Conditions

  • Appointment is purely temporary and contractual.
  • Will terminate automatically without notice or compensation on project termination.
  • No claim for permanent appointment in IISER Pune or Funding Agency.
  • Appointment will be governed by funding agency terms and conditions.
  • No TA/DA admissible for interview.

Job Description / Responsibilities

  • Handle LC-MS based proteomics experiments.
  • Analyze proteomics data at cohort level.
  • Set up cell models and biochemical assays for validating findings from proteomics experiments.

ACTREC Vacancy Details 

Sl. No. Post Name Pay Level No. of Posts Location
1 Professor - Medical Oncology (F) Level 13 1 Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital & Research Centre, Muzaffarpur
2 Assistant Professor - Pathology (Tumor Tissue Repository) (E) Level 12 1 ACTREC, Navi Mumbai
3 Assistant Professor - Radiation Oncology (E) Level 12 1 Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital & Research Centre, Muzaffarpur
4 Assistant Professor - Anesthesiology (E) Level 12 2 ACTREC, Navi Mumbai
5 Assistant Professor - Pathology (E) Level 12 3 ACTREC, Navi Mumbai
6 Assistant Professor - Medical Oncology, Solid Tumor (E) Level 12 3 ACTREC, Navi Mumbai
7 Assistant Professor - Intensivist, Critical Care (E) Level 12 2 ACTREC, Navi Mumbai
8 Assistant Professor - Interventional Radiology (E) Level 12 2 ACTREC, Navi Mumbai
9 Consultant - Infectious Diseases (E) Level 12 2 ACTREC, Navi Mumbai & Tata Memorial Hospital, Parel
10 Consultant - Pulmonary Medicine (E) Level 12 1 ACTREC, Navi Mumbai
11 Consultant - Pathology (D) Level 11 2 ACTREC, Navi Mumbai
Total 20  

Eligibility Criteria

1. Professor - Medical Oncology

  • D.M. or D.N.B. in Medical Oncology or equivalent postgraduate degree recognized by National Medical Commission.
  • Minimum 5 years post D.M./D.N.B. experience in Medical Oncology in a teaching institute.

2. Assistant Professor - Pathology (Tumor Tissue Repository)

  • M.D. or D.N.B. in Pathology or equivalent postgraduate degree recognized by National Medical Commission.
  • Minimum 3 years experience in Tumor Tissue Repository/Tissue Banking/Biorepository with expertise in tissue handling, processing and cryopreservation techniques.
  • Knowledge of bio-banking regulations and biosafety guidelines.

3. Assistant Professor - Radiation Oncology

  • M.D. or D.N.B. in Radiation Oncology/Radiotherapy or equivalent postgraduate degree.
  • 3 years post M.D./D.N.B. experience in Radiation Oncology in a teaching hospital or cancer centre.
  • Experience in Brachytherapy, 3D conformal treatment planning and IMRT is desirable.

4. Assistant Professor - Anesthesiology (2 Posts)

  • M.D. or D.N.B. in Anesthesia or equivalent postgraduate degree in Anesthesiology.
  • 3 years post M.D./D.N.B. experience in Anesthesia in a teaching hospital.
  • Experience in critical care and pain management is desirable.

5. Assistant Professor - Pathology (3 Posts)

  • D.M. in Oncopathology or Haematopathology, or M.D./D.N.B. in Pathology or equivalent postgraduate degree.
  • Minimum 3 years post M.D./D.N.B. experience in Pathology in a teaching hospital.

6. Assistant Professor - Medical Oncology, Solid Tumor (3 Posts)

  • D.M. or D.N.B. in Medical Oncology or equivalent postgraduate degree.
  • 1 year experience in Solid Tumor Medical Oncology in a teaching hospital is desirable.

7. Assistant Professor - Intensivist, Critical Care (2 Posts)

  • D.M. in Critical Care or M.D./D.N.B. in Anaesthesia/General Medicine/Pulmonary Medicine/Pediatrics or equivalent postgraduate degree.
  • For M.D./D.N.B.: 3 years post M.D./D.N.B. experience in Critical Care.

8. Assistant Professor - Interventional Radiology (2 Posts)

  • D.M. in Interventional Radiology or M.D./D.N.B. in Radiodiagnosis recognized by National Medical Commission.
  • For M.D./D.N.B.: 3 years post M.D./D.N.B. experience in Interventional Radiology.

9. Consultant - Infectious Diseases (2 Posts)

  • D.M. in Infectious Disease, or M.D. Medicine/Pediatrics with Fellowship in Infectious Diseases (minimum 1 year), recognized by National Medical Commission.
  • 3 years post M.D. experience in Infectious Diseases unit.
  • Experience in Transplant Infectious Diseases is desirable.

10. Consultant - Pulmonary Medicine (1 Post)

  • M.D. or D.N.B. in Respiratory Medicine/Pulmonary Medicine, or D.M. in Pulmonary Medicine/Pulmonary and Critical Care Medicine, recognized by National Medical Commission.
  • For M.D./D.N.B.: Minimum 3 years post M.D./D.N.B. experience in Pulmonary Medicine in a teaching hospital.
  • Skills in EBUS, Medical Thoracoscopy and advanced bronchoscopy procedures are desirable.

11. Consultant - Pathology (2 Posts)

  • M.D. or D.N.B. in Pathology or equivalent postgraduate degree recognized by National Medical Commission.
  • Minimum 1 year post M.D./D.N.B. experience in Pathology in a teaching hospital.

Age Limit

Post Category Upper Age Limit (General) Age Relaxation
Professor 50 years SC/ST: +5 years, OBC: +3 years, PwBD: +10 years
Assistant Professor / Consultant 45 years SC/ST: +5 years, OBC: +3 years, PwBD: +10 years

Salary & Pay Scales

Grade / Level Posts Pay Scale Initial Pay
Level 13 (Grade F) Professor - Medical Oncology Rs. 37,400 – 67,000 + GP 8,700 Rs. 1,23,100/-
Level 12 (Grade E) Assistant Professor positions, Consultant posts Rs. 15,600 – 39,100 + GP 7,600 Rs. 78,800/-
Level 11 (Grade D) Consultant - Pathology Rs. 15,600 – 39,100 + GP 6,600 Rs. 67,700/-

Additional Benefits: Dearness Allowance (DA), House Rent Allowance (HRA), Transport Allowance (TA), medical facility, residential accommodation (subject to availability), institutional financial support for medical meetings and conferences after probation, and retirement benefits/pension under New Pension Scheme as per TMC rules.[web:2]

Application Fee

Category Application Fee
General / OBC Candidates Rs. 300/-
SC / ST Candidates Exempted
Female Candidates Exempted
Persons with Disabilities (PwBD) Exempted
Ex-Servicemen (1st time applying) Exempted

Note: Application fee once paid will not be refunded under any circumstances. Payment can be made through Debit Card, Credit Card, UPI or Net Banking.

Important Dates

Event Date
Notification Release Date 03-02-2026
Online Application Start Date 03-02-2026
Online Application Last Date 04-03-2026 (5:30 PM IST)
Document Verification & Interview As per interview schedule notified later

Selection Process

  • Initial Screening: Applications will be screened based on details filled in the online form and uploaded documents.
  • Interview: Shortlisted candidates will be called for personal interview; there is no written examination for these posts.
  • Document Verification: Candidates must produce original certificates along with photocopies at the time of interview.
  • Final Selection: Final merit list will be prepared based on interview performance and eligibility.

How to Apply for ACTREC Recruitment 2026

  1. Visit the official ACTREC website: https://actrec.gov.in/.
  2. Go to the “Jobs” or “Recruitment/Career” section and open Advt No. ACTREC/ADVT/A-01/2026 for medical posts. [web:3][web:5]
  3. Click on the “Click here to apply” or “Apply Online” link.
  4. Register (if required) and log in to the recruitment portal.
  5. Fill the online application form carefully with personal, educational and experience details.
  6. Upload scanned copies of required documents (educational certificates, experience certificates, caste/Category/EWS/PwBD certificates, etc.).
  7. Upload recent passport-size photograph and signature as per specifications.
  8. Pay the application fee online (if applicable) using Debit Card, Credit Card, UPI or Net Banking.
  9. Review all entered details and submit the application form before the last date and time.
  10. Download/print the submitted application form and fee receipt for future reference.

Important Instructions

  • Applications will be accepted only through the online portal; offline forms will not be considered.
  • Candidates must ensure they fulfill all eligibility criteria regarding age, qualification and experience before applying.
  • A valid email ID and mobile number must be kept active throughout the recruitment process.
  • Candidates are advised to apply well before the closing date to avoid last minute server issues.
  • Selected candidates may be rotated to different Tata Memorial Centre units across India as per organizational requirement.
  • Minimum service of 5 years at the initial place of posting is generally required before seeking transfer.
  • TMC/ACTREC reserves the right to make appointments on contract basis with consolidated salary, if required.
  • For any recruitment related queries, candidates can email at [email protected] (phone queries are not entertained).

  • Minimum Educational Qualification: BE/B.Tech in Electrical, Mechanical, Electrical & Electronics, Electronics & Communication, Power Electronics, Instrumentation & Control Engineering from a Government recognized Institute/University approved by AICTE/UGC with not less than 60% marks or equivalent CGPA/OGPA.

  • For DGM (Rolling Stock) – Applicants from Government organizations, Metro Rail, Railway PSUs or other PSUs must have minimum 6 years of post-qualification work experience and be working in analogous Grade Rs. 80000-220000 (IDA E5)/equivalent CDA pay scale or in Grade Rs. 70000-200000 (IDA E4)/equivalent CDA pay scale with minimum 2 years in E4.
  • Candidates working in reputed Private Sector companies and consultancy firms in managerial positions with minimum 06/08/10 years and above overall post qualification working experience for DGM/JGM/AGM respectively (with minimum 4 years in planning, tendering, designing, testing, commissioning, operation, maintenance of rolling stock) and drawing CTC of minimum Rs. 1,80,000 per month will be considered for AGM/JGM/DGM as per their length of experience and expertise in the relevant field.

Age Limit 

  • Maximum Age: 50 years (maximum age limit as on closing date).

Important Dates

Notification Date 29/01/2026
Application Start Date 29/01/2026
Application Last Date 28/02/2026

Selection Process

  • After preliminary screening of the applications received from candidates by email, eligible candidates will be called for document verification and interaction.
  • In case of large number of eligible applications, candidates up to 5 times the notified vacancies will be called for document verification and interaction based on their experience.
  • Candidates will be interviewed by a nominated Committee and selection will be finalized on merit based on performance in the interview, qualification and post-qualification experience.
  • The overall qualifying marks shall be minimum 60; candidates must obtain at least 60 marks in the personal interview.
  • Panel of standby candidates over and above requirement will be maintained as per merit as decided by MRVC and may be engaged as per project requirements within the validity of the panel.
  • Posts notified are not regular establishment posts and selected candidates shall not be absorbed in MRVC regular service and shall have no right to claim permanent absorption.
  • The Corporation reserves the right to terminate the contract if the contract appointee is found unsuitable, by giving one month notice or payment in lieu thereof; similarly, the appointee will be required to give one month notice to MRVC for termination of contract.

General Information / Instructions

  • Candidates must bring original application, original certificates and one set of self-attested photocopies in proof of photo identity, age, caste, educational qualification and experience on the date of document verification and interaction.
  • Candidates should bring one character certificate from Gazetted Officers/Executive Officers certifying that they are bearing good moral character.
  • Incomplete or vague educational qualifications will be invalid.
  • If any document/certificate/information is found incorrect or false in any scrutiny or verification, the contractual service will be terminated forthwith without assigning any reason or prior notice, besides legal action.
  • The Corporation reserves the right to cancel, restrict, curtail or enlarge the contract engagement process without prior notice and without assigning reasons.
  • No train/bus fare (TA/DA) shall be payable by the Corporation for appearing in document verification and interaction.
  • Selected candidates should be able to join at the project site within a maximum of 45 days after issue of offer of appointment; any deviation will be dealt with on case-to-case basis.
  • Officials serving Govt./PSUs/Autonomous Bodies, if selected, will be allowed to join only after proper relieving from their parent organization.
  • Selected candidates shall use electronic resources of MRVC in strict adherence to policies and guidelines; misuse may result in termination of employment and legal action.
  • On termination or expiry of contract, appointees must return all MRVC property, documents, passwords/user IDs and clear all advances or dues.

How to Apply

  • Duly filled in application should be sent to Senior Manager (HR), Mumbai Railway Vikas Corporation Ltd. by email on careermrvc.gov.in.
  • Last date for submission of application by email is 28/02/2026.
  • Applications must be complete in all respects and strictly as per the prescribed format (Annexure-I); applications not in prescribed format or with illegible/ambiguous or missing certificates or incomplete applications will be summarily rejected.
  • The cut-off date for eligibility is 28/02/2026.
  • Self-attested documents to be attached with the filled application include: copy of original application, proof of qualification as specified in the notification, proof of date of birth (SSC Certificate/Birth Certificate), photo ID proof (Aadhar/PAN Card), documents regarding experience (last served and others), and character certificate from Gazetted/Executive officer.
  • Recommended documents include copy of employment letter issued by previous as well as present employer, Form 16 issued by previous/present employer and document indicating Employees Provident Fund (EPF)/PF Number.

Indian Army Agniveer Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details 

The official notification for the Indian Army Agniveer Vacancy 2026 has been released, announcing over 25,000+ (Expected) vacancies across various positions including GD, Tradesman, Technical, Soldier Pharma, and more.

Eligibility Criteria

Candidates Should Posses 12TH, 10TH, 8TH Pass 

Class 10th /Matric pass with 45% marks in aggregate of five basic subjects and min 33% marks in each of those five subjects. For boards following grading system, grades commensurate to percentages, as above, will be considered. Indian Gorkhas – Class 10th simple pass.

Note: Candidates who have appeared in class 10th Board Exam and are awaiting declaration of results are also eligible to apply provided they fulfill all other Qualification Required. Such candidates, however, shall only be selected when they produce the original marksheet during the Phase II of recruitment process.

 Age Limit

  • Minimum Age: 17 ½ years
  • Maximum Age: 22 years
  • Candidates born between 01 Jul 2005 to 01 Jul 2009 (both days inclusive) are eligible to apply.

Age relaxation is applicable as per rules.

  • Upper Age limit will be relaxable upto 30 years of age (as on date of joining training) in respect of widows of Defence personnel who have died in harness.
  • Note: Women who are widowed, divorced or legally separated are also eligible provided they do not have any children subject to fulfilling all other eligibility criteria. Widows of Defence Personnel who have died in harness will be eligible to apply for enrolment as Women Military Police. Such widows even with children will be, however, eligible only if they have not remarried.

Physical Standards

  • Height: 162 cms.
  • Chest Expansion: The candidate should be capable of chest expansion of 05 cms.
  • Weight: Weight standards are based on BMI as per the chart below.

  • North East Region: Sikkim, Nagaland, Arunachal Pradesh, Manipur, Tripura, Mizoram, Meghalaya and Assam.
  • Gorkhas.
  • Garhwalis.
  • Ladakher.
  • Tribals of recognized tribal areas.

Note: Domicile and Caste certificate will be considered to determine applicability of height relaxation.

Application Fee

  • Examination Fee: Rs 250/- per application for all categories.
  • Payment Mode: Online (through the website during application).

Important Dates

  • Starting Date for Apply Online: 13-02-2026
  • Last Date for Apply Online: 01-04-2026
  • Online Exam Dates: 01/06/2026 to 15/06/2026 (Tentative)
  • Firm dates for online exam will be announced later on the website.

Selection Process

  • Phase I - Online Common Entrance Exam (CEE): Conducted at Computer based test centres. This will be conducted for provisionally shortlisted candidates. Admission to the examination will be purely on the basis of Admit Card. The CEE will be conducted at designated centres tentatively between 01 Jun 2026 to 15 Jun 2026.
  • Phase II - Recruitment Rally: Proportionate to the vacancies available candidates would be shortlisted based on the aggregate marks scored in the CEE. Shortlisted candidates will attend the Recruitment Rally at designated venue where the Physical Fitness Test, Physical Measurement Test, Medical Test and Document Verification will be conducted.

Physical Fitness Test (PFT) (At Rally Site)

  • 1.6 Km Run
    • Group I: Upto 7 Min 45 Secs - Excellent
    • Group II: 7 Min 46 Sec to 8 Min 30 Sec - Good
  • Long Jump: 10 Feet (Need to qualify)
  • High Jump: 3 Feet (Need to qualify)

Note: Provisions for extra time for 1.6 Km run in hilly terrain and lower timing for Long Jump and High Jump in such cases.

Medical Standards

  • Candidates must be in good physical and mental health, free from any disability likely to interfere with efficient performance of duties.
  • Detailed medical examination as per Army standards.

Final Merit List

  • Final merit list will be based on aggregate of marks scored in CEE and performance in PFT (if applicable).
  • Recruitment is purely based on merit depending on available vacancies.

Note: Selection in the Indian Army is 'Fair & Transparent' and on merit only. At no stage any bribe is to be paid to anyone for selection or recruitment in the Indian Army. Candidates should not fall prey to unscrupulous persons posing as recruiting agents.

How to Apply

  1. Visit the official website: www.joinindianarmy.nic.in.
  2. If new user, complete the registration process by providing basic details and creating a login ID.
  3. Login using the credentials and fill the online application form carefully.
  4. Upload required documents, photographs, and signatures as per specifications.
  5. Pay the examination fee of Rs 250/- online.
  6. Submit the application and take a printout for future reference.

Note: Applications invited from domiciles of all districts of Haryana, Himachal Pradesh, UT of Chandigarh & Delhi. Any change in policy or details published in notification will be intimated on registered email/mobile number and with a ticker on the www.joinindianarmy.nic.in web portal.

Documents Required

Candidates must carry the following documents in original along with self-attested photocopies at the rally site (Phase II):

  • Admit Card.
  • 20 copies of passport size photographs.
  • Education Certificates (Marksheets, Degree, etc.).

  • Single Bank A/C, PAN Card & AADHAR Card.
  • Police Verification Form.
  • Certificate from serving personnel for wards of serving soldiers (if applicable).
  • Any other relevant documents as specified in the notification.

Salary Structure

Agniveers will be paid a customized package with fixed yearly increment. In addition, Risk and Hardship, Ration, Dress and Travel allowances as applicable.

    • Option B: The Ph.D degree has been obtained from a foreign university/institution with a ranking among top 500 in the World University Ranking (at any time) by any one of the following: (i) Quacquarelli Symonds (QS) (ii) the Times Higher Education (THE) or (iii) the Academic Ranking of World Universities (ARWU) of the Shanghai Jiao Tong University (Shanghai)
  • Deputy Librarian: A Master's Degree in library science/information science/documentation science, with at least 55% marks or an equivalent grade in a point-scale, wherever grading system is followed. Eight years experience as an Assistant University Librarian/College Librarian. Evidence of innovative library services including integration of ICT in library. A Ph.D. Degree in library science/Information science/Documentation Science/Archives and manuscript keeping/computerization of library
  • Assistant Librarian: A Master's Degree in Library Science, Information Science or Documentation Science or an equivalent professional degree, with at least 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point-scale, wherever the grading system is followed). A consistently good academic record, with knowledge of computerization of a library. Besides fulfilling the above qualifications, the candidate must have cleared the National Eligibility Test (NET) conducted by the UGC, CSIR or similar test accredited by the UGC like SLET/SET or who are or have been awarded a Ph.D. Degree in accordance with the University Grants Commission Regulations, 2009 or 2016 and their amendments from time to time

Essential Qualifications

  • Educational qualification, experience, age of retirement on superannuation and pay scales of Professor, Associate Professor, Assistant Professor, Deputy Librarian and Assistant Librarian will be as per the UGC/NCERT, Government of India norms as amended from time to time and in force at the time of closing date of filling-up online application
  • For Assistant Professor and Assistant Librarian positions, NET/SLET/SET shall not be required for such Masters Programmes in disciplines for which NET/SLET/SET is not conducted by the UGC, CSIR or similar test accredited by the UGC
  • Candidates registered for the Ph.D. programme prior to July 11, 2009, shall be governed by the provisions of the then existing Ordinances/Bye-laws/Regulations of the Institution awarding the degree and such Ph.D. candidates shall be exempted from the requirement of NET/SLET/SET subject to fulfillment of specific conditions: Ph.D. degree awarded in regular mode, Ph.D. thesis evaluated by at least two external examiners, Open Ph.D. viva voce conducted, Candidate has published two research papers from Ph.D. work (at least one in refereed journal), Candidate has presented at least two papers based on Ph.D work in conferences/seminars sponsored/funded/supported by the UGC/ICSSR/CSIR or any similar agency
  • The fulfillment of these conditions is to be certified by the Registrar or the Dean (Academic Affairs) of the University concerned
  • The Academic score as specified in Appendix II for Universities and Colleges shall be considered for short-listing of the candidates for interview only, and the selections shall be based only on the performance in the interview as per UGC Regulations-2018 and as amended from time to time

Experience

  • Professor: A minimum of ten years of teaching experience in university/college as Assistant Professor/Associate Professor/Professor, and/or research experience at equivalent level at the University/National Level Institutions with evidence of having successfully guided doctoral candidate OR ten years experience as an outstanding professional from academic institutions/industry with significant contribution to the knowledge in the concerned discipline
  • Associate Professor: A minimum of eight years of experience of teaching and/or research in an academic/research position equivalent to that of Assistant Professor in a University, College or Accredited Research Institution/industry
  • Deputy Librarian: Eight years experience as an Assistant University Librarian/College Librarian with evidence of innovative library services including integration of ICT in library
  • Assistant Professor and Assistant Librarian: No specific years of experience required, but must have NET/SLET/SET qualification or Ph.D. degree exemption as per UGC norms

Desirable

  • For Professor positions: Published work of high quality, actively engaged in research with evidence of published work with a minimum of 10 research publications in the peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals and a total research score of 120
  • For Associate Professor positions: A minimum of seven publications in the peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals and a total research score of 75
  • For Deputy Librarian: Evidence of innovative library services including integration of ICT in library
  • For Assistant Librarian: A consistently good academic record with knowledge of computerization of a library

Salary/Stipend

  • Professor: Academic level 14 with rationalized entry pay of Rs. 1,44,200/- per month (Pre-revised scale of pay: Rs.37,400-67,000 with AGP-10,000)
  • Associate Professor/Deputy Librarian: Academic level 13A with rationalized entry pay of Rs. 1,31,400/- per month (Pre-revised scale of pay: Rs.37,400-67,000 with AGP-9,000)
  • Assistant Professor/Assistant Librarian: Academic level 10 with rationalized entry pay of Rs. 57,700/- per month (Pre-revised scale of pay: Rs.15,600-39,100 with AGP-6,000)
  • All pay scales are as per UGC/NCERT/Government of India norms and will be applicable as amended from time to time
  • Selected candidates will be entitled to other allowances and benefits as per Government of India/NCERT rules applicable from time to time

Age Limit (as on 20/02/2026)

  • The relaxation in age and percentage of marks to candidates belonging to SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/EWS/PWD categories is provided in accordance with the UGC/GOI/NCERT rules
  • Persons with Disability (PWD) having disability less than forty percent will not be considered. The disability certificate shall be from a competent medical board constituted by the central or state Government Hospital
  • Such persons should meet the prescribed criteria of physical disability of the respective category as per the Government of India rules

PSTET 2026 Eligibility Criteria

Nationality & Age Limit

  • Applicants must be citizens of India to be eligible for PSTET 2026.
  • There is no specified minimum or maximum age limit for appearing in PSTET 2026.

Educational Qualification for Paper 1 (Class 1–5)

Candidates who wish to appear in PSTET Paper 1 for primary teacher eligibility must meet the minimum academic and professional qualifications as prescribed by NCTE and mentioned in the detailed PSTET notification

  • Senior Secondary (10+2) with at least 50% marks and passed or appearing in final year of 2-year Diploma in Elementary Education (D.El.Ed) or equivalent teacher training programme.
  • Senior Secondary with minimum 45–50% marks and 2-year D.El.Ed or equivalent, in accordance with NCTE regulations.
  • Graduation with 2-year D.El.Ed or Bachelor of Education (B.Ed) as allowed in the official notification

Educational Qualification for Paper 2 (Class 6–8)

For PSTET Paper 2, candidates must have graduation along with prescribed teacher education qualifications for upper primary level.

  • Graduation and 2-year Diploma in Elementary Education (D.El.Ed).
  • Graduation with at least 50% marks and 1-year Bachelor in Education (B.Ed).
  • 4-year integrated B.El.Ed / B.A.B.Ed / B.Sc.B.Ed or equivalent as specified by NCTE and PSTET notification.

Candidates are advised to carefully read the official PSTET 2026 notification PDF for complete and exact combinations of qualifications and relaxations for reserved categories.

PSTET 2026 Application Form

The PSTET 2026 application form is available only in online mode, and no offline forms will be accepted. The direct registration link is active on the PSTET official website for new registration, login and fee payment.

Direct Apply Online Link

  • Main portal: https://pstet2025.org/
  • Register & Apply: RegisterEmailIDwithOTPNew.aspx
  • Official advertisement PDF: adv_pstet2025.pdf

Steps to Apply Online for PSTET 2026

  1. Visit the official website pstet2025.org and click on the link for “PSTET 2026 Online Application”.
  2. Click on “New Registration” and enter your valid email ID and mobile number to generate OTP.
  3. Verify the OTP received on your mobile/email and create login credentials for PSTET 2026 application.
  4. Login using your registered email ID and password and fill in personal details, address, educational qualifications and other required information correctly.
  5. Select the paper(s) you wish to apply for – Paper 1, Paper 2 or both as per your eligibility.
  6. Upload scanned copies of your recent passport size photograph and signature in the prescribed format and size as mentioned in the instructions.
  7. Pay the required application fee online through debit/credit card, net banking or other available payment gateways.
  8. After successful payment, submit the application form and download/print the confirmation page and fee receipt for future use.

A correction window will be activated between 21 and 23 February 2026 to edit limited fields such as name, date of birth, photograph, signature, contact details and exam centre city, as permitted by the portal.

PSTET 2026 Application Fee

The application fee for PSTET 2026 varies according to category and number of papers applied for. The fee is non-refundable and must be paid through online mode only.

Candidates are advised to check the fee status after payment and ensure that the application form is finally submitted and not left incomplete.

PSTET 2026 Exam Pattern

PSTET 2026 will be conducted as two separate papers – Paper 1 for primary level and Paper 2 for upper primary level. Both papers will consist of multiple-choice questions and will be conducted in offline mode.

PSTET Paper 1 Exam Pattern (Class 1–5)

Subject No. of Questions Marks

Language I 30 30

Mathematics 30 30
Environmental Studies 30 30
Total 150 150

All questions in Paper 1 will be objective type with four options, and each correct answer will carry 1 mark with no negative marking as per the PSTET pattern.

PSTET Paper 2 Exam Pattern (Class 6–8)

Subject No. of Questions Marks
Child Development & Pedagogy 30 30
Language I 30 30
Language II 30 30
Mathematics & Science (for Maths/Science teacher) OR Social Studies (for Social Studies teacher) OR other subject chosen 60 60
Total 150 150

Paper 2 will also be conducted in offline mode and will test subject knowledge along with pedagogy at the upper primary level.

PSTET 2026 Syllabus (Brief)

The detailed PSTET syllabus is provided in the official notification and on the exam portal, covering child development, languages, mathematics, environmental studies and subject-specific content.

  • Child Development & Pedagogy: Concept of development and learning, inclusive education, understanding children with special needs, pedagogy of learning and teaching at elementary level.
  • Language I & II: Proficiency in the chosen language, comprehension passages, language skills, grammar and pedagogy of language development.
  • Mathematics & Environmental Studies (Paper 1): Basic concepts, problem-solving, teaching-learning strategies and pedagogy relevant to primary level.
  • Subject-specific (Paper 2): Content and pedagogy of Mathematics & Science or Social Studies or other applicable subjects for upper primary classes.

Applicants should refer to the topic-wise syllabus PDF to plan their preparation in a structured manner and focus on conceptual clarity and pedagogy sections.

PSTET 2026 Qualifying Marks & Certificate Validity

To qualify PSTET 2026, candidates must obtain the minimum qualifying marks as set by SCERT Punjab.

  • General category: 60% marks i.e. 90 out of 150.
  • OBC / SC / ST category: 55% marks i.e. 82 out of 150.

The PSTET qualifying certificate will be valid for 7 years from the date of issue for all categories. Qualifying PSTET does not guarantee a teaching job, but it is a mandatory eligibility requirement for applying to teacher recruitment in Punjab schools.

Special Physical Standards

Candidates belonging to following regions will be given 4 cms height relaxation:

  • North East Region: Sikkim, Nagaland, Arunachal Pradesh, Manipur, Tripura, Mizoram, Meghalaya and Assam.
  • Gorkhas.
  • Garhwalis.
  • Ladakher.
  • Tribals of recognized tribal areas.

Note: Domicile and Caste certificate will be considered to determine applicability of height relaxation.

Application Fee

  • Examination Fee: Rs 250/- per application for all categories.
  • Payment Mode: Online (through the website during application).

Important Dates

  • Starting Date for Apply Online: 13-02-2026
  • Last Date for Apply Online: 01-04-2026
  • Online Exam Dates: 01/06/2026 to 15/06/2026 (Tentative)
  • Firm dates for online exam will be announced later on the website.

Selection Process

  • Phase I - Online Common Entrance Exam (CEE): Conducted at Computer based test centres. This will be conducted for provisionally shortlisted candidates. Admission to the examination will be purely on the basis of Admit Card. The CEE will be conducted at designated centres tentatively between 01 Jun 2026 to 15 Jun 2026.
  • Phase II - Recruitment Rally: Proportionate to the vacancies available candidates would be shortlisted based on the aggregate marks scored in the CEE. Shortlisted candidates will attend the Recruitment Rally at designated venue where the Physical Fitness Test, Physical Measurement Test, Medical Test and Document Verification will be conducted.

Physical Fitness Test (PFT) (At Rally Site)

  • 1.6 Km Run
    • Group I: Upto 7 Min 45 Secs - Excellent
    • Group II: 7 Min 46 Sec to 8 Min 30 Sec - Good
  • Long Jump: 10 Feet (Need to qualify)
  • High Jump: 3 Feet (Need to qualify)

Note: Provisions for extra time for 1.6 Km run in hilly terrain and lower timing for Long Jump and High Jump in such cases.

Medical Standards

  • Candidates must be in good physical and mental health, free from any disability likely to interfere with efficient performance of duties.
  • Detailed medical examination as per Army standards.

Final Merit List

  • Final merit list will be based on aggregate of marks scored in CEE and performance in PFT (if applicable).
  • Recruitment is purely based on merit depending on available vacancies.

Note: Selection in the Indian Army is 'Fair & Transparent' and on merit only. At no stage any bribe is to be paid to anyone for selection or recruitment in the Indian Army. Candidates should not fall prey to unscrupulous persons posing as recruiting agents.

How to Apply

  1. Visit the official website: www.joinindianarmy.nic.in.
  2. If new user, complete the registration process by providing basic details and creating a login ID.
  3. Login using the credentials and fill the online application form carefully.
  4. Upload required documents, photographs, and signatures as per specifications.
  5. Pay the examination fee of Rs 250/- online.
  6. Submit the application and take a printout for future reference.

Note: Applications invited from domiciles of all districts of Haryana, Himachal Pradesh, UT of Chandigarh & Delhi. Any change in policy or details published in notification will be intimated on registered email/mobile number and with a ticker on the www.joinindianarmy.nic.in web portal.

Documents Required

Candidates must carry the following documents in original along with self-attested photocopies at the rally site (Phase II):

  • Admit Card.
  • 20 copies of passport size photographs.
  • Education Certificates (Marksheets, Degree, etc.).
  • Domicile Certificate.
  • Caste Certificate (if applicable for relaxation).
  • Religion Certificate (if required).
  • School Character Certificate.
  • Character Certificate from Village Sarpanch/Municipal Corporation.
  • Unmarried Certificate.
  • NCC Certificate (if applicable).
  • Sports Certificate (if applicable).
  • Affidavit on Rs 10 stamp paper as per format.
  • Single Bank A/C, PAN Card & AADHAR Card.
  • Police Verification Form.
  • Certificate from serving personnel for wards of serving soldiers (if applicable).
  • Any other relevant documents as specified in the notification.

Salary Structure

Agniveers will be paid a customized package with fixed yearly increment. In addition, Risk and Hardship, Ration, Dress and Travel allowances as applicable.

Eligibility Criteria

Educational Qualification:

  • Company Secretary: Must have passed final examination of The Institute of Company Secretaries of India (ICSI) and shall hold the Membership of the said Institute. Must have minimum of Five years' experience as Company Secretary in a Company having minimum paid capital of Rs 50 Crore or more.
  • Assistant Town Planner: Degree in Architecture (5 years full time course) with minimum 60% marks and Post Graduation in Town Planning from recognized University.
  • Programmer: B.E./B.Tech./M.Sc. in Information Technology/Computer Science/Engineering or Electronics and Communications or M.C.A. from a recognized University OR ME/M.Tech degree in Information Technology or Computer Science/Engineering or Electronics and Communications from a recognized University OR B.Com with minimum 60% Marks from recognized university WITH Certificate Course in Information Technology (RSCIT/DOEACC "O" Level/COPA/DPCS/Diploma in Computer Science/Computer Applications/Information Technology).
  • Assistant Accounts Officer Grade-II: Degree/Diploma/Certificate of CA/CMA from the institute of ICAI/ICMAI from a recognized university OR B.Com with minimum 60% Marks from recognized university WITH Certificate Course in Information Technology (RSCIT/DOEACC "O" Level or Higher/COPA/DPCS certificate/Diploma in Computer Science).
  • Junior Legal Officer: Law graduate (Professional Degree) from a recognized university with minimum 55% marks or LL.M. from a recognized university.
  • Personal Assistant Grade-II: Senior Secondary from a recognized Board or its equivalent examination AND Higher Level Certificate Course conducted by DOEACC under control of the Department of Electronics, Government of India OR Certificate Course on computer concept by NIELIT, New Delhi OR Computer Operator & Programming Assistant (COPA)/Data Preparation and Computer Software (DPCS) certificate OR Degree/Diploma/Certificate in Computer Science/Computer applications OR Senior Secondary Certificate with Computer Science/Computer Application as one of the subjects OR Diploma in Computer Science & Engineering from a polytechnic institution OR RSCIT OR Any equivalent or higher qualification.
  • Draughtsman-cum-Tracer (Civil): Diploma in Architecture from Polytechnic from recognized institute alongwith knowledge of AUTOCAD software OR Certificate course of Draughtsman (Civil) from National Council of Vocational Trade alongwith knowledge of AUTOCAD software.
  • Junior Assistant: Senior Secondary from a recognized Board or its equivalent examination AND "O" or Higher Level Certificate Course conducted by DOEACC OR Certificate Course on computer concept by NIELIT, New Delhi OR Computer Operator & Programming Assistant (COPA)/Data Preparation and Computer Software (DPCS) certificate OR Degree/Diploma/Certificate in Computer Science/Computer applications OR Senior Secondary Certificate with Computer Science/Computer Application as one of the subjects OR Diploma in Computer Science & Engineering OR RSCIT OR Any equivalent or higher qualification.

Citizenship:

  • A citizen of India
  • A subject of Nepal
  • A subject of Bhutan
  • A Tibetan refugee who came over to India before 1st January, 1962 with the intention of permanently settling in India
  • A person of Indian origin who has migrated from Pakistan, Burma, Sri Lanka or East African countries with the intention of permanently settling in India

Note: Candidates belonging to categories (b), (c), (d) and (e) above shall be a person in whose favour a certificate of eligibility has been issued by the Home Department and Justice Department of Government of India.

Salary/Stipend

Appointment of selected candidates will be made for Probation Period for an initial period of two years. A fixed remuneration shall be payable to such candidates during the probation period:

  • Company Secretary: Level-16, Rs.4,7200/- per month (Fixed Remuneration during probation)
  • Assistant Town Planner: Level-14, Rs.3,9300/- per month (Fixed Remuneration during probation)
  • Programmer: Level-12, Rs.3,1100/- per month (Fixed Remuneration during probation)
  • Assistant Accounts Officer Grade-II: Level-11, Rs.2,6500/- per month (Fixed Remuneration during probation)
  • Junior Legal Officer: Level-10, Rs.2,3700/- per month (Fixed Remuneration during probation)
  • Personal Assistant Grade-II: Level-10, Rs.2,3700/- per month (Fixed Remuneration during probation)
  • Draughtsman-cum-Tracer (Civil): Level-8, Rs.1,8500/- per month (Fixed Remuneration during probation)
  • Junior Assistant: Level-5, Rs.1,4600/- per month (Fixed Remuneration during probation)

Note: On successful completion of Probation Period, the salary shall be payable in regular Pay-Matrix. The regular salary with other allowances shall be paid, as per rules.

Age Limit (as on 20/02/2026)

  • Minimum Age: 18 years
  • Maximum Age: Less than 40 years

Age Relaxation:

  • SC/ST/BC/MBC/EWS Male Candidates of Rajasthan State: 5 years relaxation
  • General Category Women Candidates: 5 years relaxation
  • SC/ST/BC/MBC/EWS Women Candidates of Rajasthan State: 10 years relaxation
  • Differently Abled Persons: Additional 5 years relaxation beyond the above-mentioned relaxations
  • Widow and Divorcee: No upper age limit, but at the time of appointment, their age should be less than the age of superannuation fixed by RIICO

Note: The provisions for relaxation in upper age limit are non-cumulative i.e. the benefit of any one provision shall be given for relaxation in upper age limit.

Application Fee

Category Fee for Post 1-6 Fee for Post 7-8
Unreserved (General) category and Creamy Layer category of BC/MBC of Rajasthan Rs.700/- Rs.1,000/-
Non-Creamy Layer category of BC/MBC of Rajasthan and EWS of Rajasthan Rs.525/- Rs.750/-

Special Note:

  • Candidates of SC/ST/BC/MBC/EWS of a State other than Rajasthan/Union Territories shall be treated as a candidate of General category and are liable to pay the examination fee as fixed for the General category candidates.
  • According to Circular dated 02.05.2018, the candidate's fee for candidates of all categories whose annual income of family is less than Rs.2.50 lakhs shall be payable same as of the candidates of SC/ST.

Important Dates

Event Date
Notification Date 20/01/2026

Selection Process

  • Selection of the candidates shall be made through a competitive examination conducted online.
  • The merit list shall be prepared on the basis of marks secured in the examination.
  • All questions in written examination paper shall be objective type.

Examination Structure:

  • Company Secretary: Part First (180 Marks) + Part Second (270 Marks) + Interview (50 Marks) = Total 400 Marks
  • Assistant Town Planner: Part First (180 Marks) + Part Second (270 Marks) = Total 450 Marks
  • Programmer: Part First (180 Marks) + Part Second (270 Marks) + Proficiency Test (100 Marks) = Total 550 Marks
  • Assistant Accounts Officer Grade-II: Part First (180 Marks) + Part Second (270 Marks) = Total 450 Marks
  • Junior Legal Officer: Part First (180 Marks) + Part Second (270 Marks) = Total 450 Marks
  • Personal Assistant Grade-II: Part First (180 Marks) + Part Second (270 Marks) + Proficiency Test (100 Marks) = Total 550 Marks
  • Draughtsman-cum-Tracer (Civil): Part First (180 Marks) + Part Second (270 Marks) + Proficiency Test (100 Marks) = Total 550 Marks
  • Junior Assistant: Part First (180 Marks) + Part Second (270 Marks) + Proficiency Test (100 Marks) = Total 550 Marks

Note:

  • Only those candidates who have obtained minimum qualifying marks shall be eligible for appearing in the proficiency test.
  • Maximum five times of candidates of respective vacancies of the posts shall be called for appearing in the proficiency test.
  • For Company Secretary post, candidates who qualify in the written examination will be called for an interview. The number of candidates called for the interview will be five times the number of advertised vacancies.

General Information/Instructions

Reservation Policy:

  • 5% reservation shall be admissible to More Backward Class (non-creamy layer) belonging to State of Rajasthan.
  • 10% reservation shall be admissible to Economically Weaker Section of the State of Rajasthan.
  • Horizontal reservation of vacancies for women shall be 30% category-wise.
  • Out of the 30% reserved posts for women, 8% posts are reserved for widows and 2% for divorced women.
  • 2% reservation for Outstanding Sports Person (horizontal reservation).
  • Reservation for specially abled persons is also horizontal reservation.

Important Points:

  • The benefit of reserved posts of SC/ST/BC/MBC/EWS is only admissible to bonafide residents of the State of Rajasthan.
  • Candidates of SC/ST/BC/MBC/EWS of a State other than Rajasthan State/Union Territories shall be treated as candidates of General category.
  • According to judgment by Supreme Court and Rajasthan High Court, a woman of a State other than Rajasthan State who becomes bonafide resident of Rajasthan State after marriage, the benefit of reservation in SC/ST/OBC/MBC category shall not be allowed to her for public employment.
  • Married female candidates of BC/MBC are required to submit certificate on the basis of father's name, residence and income. Certificate on the basis of husband shall not be valid.
  • No candidate having more than two children on or after 01.04.2007 shall be eligible for appointment to the service.
  • Registration of marriage has been made compulsory for appointment in the services of state from 22.01.2006.
  • The candidate who smokes and/or consumes gutkha will not be eligible for appointment.

Special Instructions:

  • Candidates should fill the online application carefully. No change will be possible after clicking "Complete Registration" button.
  • Prior to filling online application, candidates must go through the detailed advertisement and service rules.
  • Candidates are required to upload Photograph, Signature, Left Thumb Impression and Handwritten Declaration as per guidelines.
  • Mobile phone, Bluetooth, calculator, smart watch and any other electronic/communication devices are not permitted in examination hall.
  • Call letters shall be uploaded on the website www.riico.rajasthan.gov.in and no call letter will be sent by post.
  • Result of examination shall be communicated by uploading on the authorized website.
  • No travelling allowance/meal allowance shall be payable to candidates.

How to Apply

  • Candidates may visit the website www.riico.rajasthan.gov.in and click on the option "Apply Online".
  • To register the application, select the tab "Click here for New Registration" and enter the name, contact details and email-id.
  • A Provisional Registration Number and Password will be generated by the system and sent through email and SMS.
  • Candidates can save the data by selecting "SAVE & NEXT" tab and can complete it later.
  • Before completing the registration, candidates should click on the Preview tab to preview and verify the entire application form.
  • After verifying all details, click on 'Complete Registration'.
  • Click on the 'Payment' tab and proceed for payment through online mode (Credit/Debit Cards, Internet Banking, IMPS, Cash Cards/Mobile Wallets).
  • After successful payment, an e-receipt will be generated. Take a printout of the e-receipt and online application form.
  • Candidates should upload:
    • Recent colour photograph (maximum one month old) - Size: 20-50 KB, Dimensions: 200 x 230 Pixels
    • Signature (scanned) - Size: 10-20 KB, Dimensions: 140 x 60 Pixels
    • Left thumb impression - Size: 20-50 KB, Dimensions: 240 x 240 pixels
    • Handwritten declaration - Size: 50-100 KB, Dimensions: 800 x 400 pixels
    • Live photograph using webcam or mobile phone
  • All documents should be in JPG/JPEG format only.
  • After successful submission, take a printout of the application form for future reference.

Note:

  • Candidates should submit their online application in the prescribed time without waiting for the last date.
  • Any change/modification may disqualify the candidate if details don't match with certificates.
  • In case of applying through e-mitra or any other source, candidate must get submission in his/her presence.
