Eligibility Criteria

Qualifications

  • Professor - Eligibility (A or B):
    • Option A: An eminent scholar having a Ph.D. degree in the concerned/allied/relevant discipline, and published work of high quality, actively engaged in research with evidence of published work with a minimum of 10 research publications in the peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals and a total research score of 120 as per UGC Regulations-2018. A minimum of ten years of teaching experience in university/college as Assistant Professor/Associate Professor/Professor, and/or research experience at equivalent level at the University/National Level Institutions with evidence of having successfully guided doctoral candidate
    • Option B: An outstanding professional, having a Ph.D. degree in the relevant/allied/applied disciplines, from any academic institutions/industry, who has made significant contribution to the knowledge in the concerned/allied/relevant discipline, supported by documentary evidence provided he/she has ten years experience
  • Associate Professor: A good academic record, with a Ph.D. Degree in the concerned/allied/relevant disciplines. A Master's Degree with at least 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point-scale, wherever the grading system is followed). A minimum of eight years of experience of teaching and/or research in an academic/research position equivalent to that of Assistant Professor in a University, College or Accredited Research Institution/industry with a minimum of seven publications in the peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals and a total research score of Seventy five (75) as per UGC Regulations-2018
  • Assistant Professor - Eligibility (A or B):
    • Option A: A Master's degree with 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point-scale wherever the grading system is followed) in a concerned/relevant/allied subject from an Indian University, or an equivalent degree from an accredited foreign university. Besides fulfilling the above qualifications, the candidate must have cleared the National Eligibility Test (NET) conducted by the UGC or the CSIR, or a similar test accredited by the UGC, like SLET/SET or who are or have been awarded a Ph.D. Degree in accordance with the University Grants Commission Regulations, 2009 or 2016 and their amendments from time to time as the case may be exempted from NET/SLET/SET
    • Option B: The Ph.D degree has been obtained from a foreign university/institution with a ranking among top 500 in the World University Ranking (at any time) by any one of the following: (i) Quacquarelli Symonds (QS) (ii) the Times Higher Education (THE) or (iii) the Academic Ranking of World Universities (ARWU) of the Shanghai Jiao Tong University (Shanghai)
  • Deputy Librarian: A Master's Degree in library science/information science/documentation science, with at least 55% marks or an equivalent grade in a point-scale, wherever grading system is followed. Eight years experience as an Assistant University Librarian/College Librarian. Evidence of innovative library services including integration of ICT in library. A Ph.D. Degree in library science/Information science/Documentation Science/Archives and manuscript keeping/computerization of library
  • Assistant Librarian: A Master's Degree in Library Science, Information Science or Documentation Science or an equivalent professional degree, with at least 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point-scale, wherever the grading system is followed). A consistently good academic record, with knowledge of computerization of a library. Besides fulfilling the above qualifications, the candidate must have cleared the National Eligibility Test (NET) conducted by the UGC, CSIR or similar test accredited by the UGC like SLET/SET or who are or have been awarded a Ph.D. Degree in accordance with the University Grants Commission Regulations, 2009 or 2016 and their amendments from time to time

Essential Qualifications

  • Educational qualification, experience, age of retirement on superannuation and pay scales of Professor, Associate Professor, Assistant Professor, Deputy Librarian and Assistant Librarian will be as per the UGC/NCERT, Government of India norms as amended from time to time and in force at the time of closing date of filling-up online application
  • For Assistant Professor and Assistant Librarian positions, NET/SLET/SET shall not be required for such Masters Programmes in disciplines for which NET/SLET/SET is not conducted by the UGC, CSIR or similar test accredited by the UGC
  • Candidates registered for the Ph.D. programme prior to July 11, 2009, shall be governed by the provisions of the then existing Ordinances/Bye-laws/Regulations of the Institution awarding the degree and such Ph.D. candidates shall be exempted from the requirement of NET/SLET/SET subject to fulfillment of specific conditions: Ph.D. degree awarded in regular mode, Ph.D. thesis evaluated by at least two external examiners, Open Ph.D. viva voce conducted, Candidate has published two research papers from Ph.D. work (at least one in refereed journal), Candidate has presented at least two papers based on Ph.D work in conferences/seminars sponsored/funded/supported by the UGC/ICSSR/CSIR or any similar agency
  • The fulfillment of these conditions is to be certified by the Registrar or the Dean (Academic Affairs) of the University concerned
  • The Academic score as specified in Appendix II for Universities and Colleges shall be considered for short-listing of the candidates for interview only, and the selections shall be based only on the performance in the interview as per UGC Regulations-2018 and as amended from time to time

Experience

  • Professor: A minimum of ten years of teaching experience in university/college as Assistant Professor/Associate Professor/Professor, and/or research experience at equivalent level at the University/National Level Institutions with evidence of having successfully guided doctoral candidate OR ten years experience as an outstanding professional from academic institutions/industry with significant contribution to the knowledge in the concerned discipline
  • Associate Professor: A minimum of eight years of experience of teaching and/or research in an academic/research position equivalent to that of Assistant Professor in a University, College or Accredited Research Institution/industry
  • Deputy Librarian: Eight years experience as an Assistant University Librarian/College Librarian with evidence of innovative library services including integration of ICT in library
  • Assistant Professor and Assistant Librarian: No specific years of experience required, but must have NET/SLET/SET qualification or Ph.D. degree exemption as per UGC norms

Desirable

  • For Professor positions: Published work of high quality, actively engaged in research with evidence of published work with a minimum of 10 research publications in the peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals and a total research score of 120
  • For Associate Professor positions: A minimum of seven publications in the peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals and a total research score of 75
  • For Deputy Librarian: Evidence of innovative library services including integration of ICT in library
  • For Assistant Librarian: A consistently good academic record with knowledge of computerization of a library

Salary/Stipend

  • Professor: Academic level 14 with rationalized entry pay of Rs. 1,44,200/- per month (Pre-revised scale of pay: Rs.37,400-67,000 with AGP-10,000)
  • Associate Professor/Deputy Librarian: Academic level 13A with rationalized entry pay of Rs. 1,31,400/- per month (Pre-revised scale of pay: Rs.37,400-67,000 with AGP-9,000)
  • Assistant Professor/Assistant Librarian: Academic level 10 with rationalized entry pay of Rs. 57,700/- per month (Pre-revised scale of pay: Rs.15,600-39,100 with AGP-6,000)
  • All pay scales are as per UGC/NCERT/Government of India norms and will be applicable as amended from time to time
  • Selected candidates will be entitled to other allowances and benefits as per Government of India/NCERT rules applicable from time to time

Age Limit (as on 20/02/2026)

  • Age of retirement on superannuation will be as per the UGC/NCERT, Government of India norms as amended from time to time and in force at the time of closing date of filling-up online application
  • The relaxation in age and percentage of marks to candidates belonging to SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/EWS/PWD categories is provided in accordance with the UGC/GOI/NCERT rules
  • Persons with Disability (PWD) having disability less than forty percent will not be considered. The disability certificate shall be from a competent medical board constituted by the central or state Government Hospital
  • Such persons should meet the prescribed criteria of physical disability of the respective category as per the Government of India rules

Application Fee

  • UR/OBC/EWS Candidates: Rs. 1000/- (Rupees One thousand only) through online payment mode only
  • Women applicants and applicants belonging to SC/ST/PWD: Exempted from payment of fee
  • No other mode of payment will be accepted other than online payment mode
  • Fee once paid shall not be refunded under any circumstances

Selection Process

  • For Assistant Professor Posts: Up to 50 candidates (category-wise) for the first vacancy and 05 candidates for every additional vacancy will be called for the interview in order of their rank/merit in the list as prepared by the Shortlisting Committee on the basis of marks scored by the candidates, which should not be less than academic score of 60 (Sixty) in any case. In case of tie of marks at the 50th place for 01 vacancy and tie of marks at 5th place for every additional vacancy, all candidates whose marks tie will be called for interview
  • For Professor and Associate Professor Posts: The existing criterion of minimum academic score as per UGC guidelines will be followed subject to the condition up to 10 candidates (category-wise) for the first vacancy and 05 candidates for every additional vacancy will be called for interview in order of their rank/merit in the list as prepared by the Shortlisting Committee on the basis of marks scored by the candidates. In case of tie of marks at the 10th place for 01 vacancy and tie of marks at 5th place for every additional vacancy, all candidates whose marks tie will be called for interview
  • The Academic score shall be considered for short-listing of the candidates for interview only, and the selections shall be based only on the performance in the interview
  • The list of shortlisted candidates will be displayed on the NCERT website
  • The shortlisted candidates will be allowed to appear for the interview only after verification of their eligibility
  • The registration will be provisional as the eligibility of the shortlisted candidate will be verified at the time of Interview from the original documents
  • All Certificates, Degrees and other documents must be produced in original for verification at the time of interview (if shortlisted), failing which the candidate may not be allowed to appear for the interview
  • Final result of the selected candidates will be displayed on NCERT website
  • The Council will not entertain any correspondence with the candidates about their non-selection in the recruitment
  • The decision of the NCERT in all matters relating to selection and allotment of posts/organizations to selected candidates will be final and binding on the candidates

General Information/Instructions

  • National Council of Educational Research and Training (NCERT) is an apex organization for Educational Research, Teacher Training and Development of Curriculum and Instructional material in school education
  • Positions are available at NCERT, New Delhi and at its constituent units located at Ajmer, Bhopal, Bhubaneswar, Mysuru and Shillong
  • Only Indian Nationals need to apply
  • Eligible and interested candidates are required to apply online only through the NCERT website www.ncert.nic.in at Announcement-Vacancy-Academic. No other means/mode of submission of applications will be accepted
  • The candidates must have a valid email id and mobile number through which he/she will get registered with the online application portal
  • Candidates should fill in the details to register and then fill the information in the online application form at the appropriate places very carefully
  • Fields with STAR (*) mark are mandatory and essential to be filled in by the candidate
  • After the required information have been provided, click submit button. However, before clicking "Submit" button, candidate must make sure that no changes are required and the information provided is correct and final. After application is submitted, no changes will be entertained
  • Candidates are required to upload their scanned recent/colour passport size photograph, applicant's signature and all the relevant documents. The candidates have to keep a copy of application with documents for record and the same to be produced at the time of verification of document/interview, if shortlisted
  • In case a candidate wishes to apply for more than one post, he/she should submit separate application online along with the requisite fee for each post applied for. All the online applications should be completed in all respects. Only one application for individual post from one applicant will be accepted
  • The candidate should meet the eligibility criteria and provide the information which he/she possesses as on the last date of submission of the application. Candidates who do not possess the requisite educational qualification as on the closing date of receipt of application will not be eligible
  • Candidature of a registered candidate is liable to be rejected at any stage of recruitment process or even after joining, if any information provided by the candidate is found to be false or not in conformity with the eligibility criteria
  • Candidate must indicate his/her caste/category in the appropriate column of the application form (SC, ST, UR, OBC (NCL) & EWS etc). Leaving the caste column blank would not automatically be assumed as an application for un-reserved category and the application will be rejected as incomplete
  • The OBC-Non Creamy Layer candidates will be required to submit a valid caste certificate for purpose of reservation in appointment to posts under Government of India/Central Government from a competent authority along with latest Non Creamy Layer certificate and self-declaration that he/she does not belong to the creamy layer as on the closing date of submission of applications
  • The EWS candidates will be required to submit a valid certificate for purpose of reservation in appointment to posts under Government of India/Central Government from a competent authority and self declaration
  • Number of vacancies may vary depending upon the actual requirement. NCERT reserves the right not to fill up any or all the posts or cancel the whole process of recruitment without assigning any reason
  • Mere fulfilling the minimum eligibility requirements does not entitle a candidate to be called for interview. NCERT reserves the right to restrict the number of candidates to be called for interview
  • The certificates, which are neither in English nor in Hindi, need to be translated preferably to either in English or in Hindi and the same shall be submitted along with the copy of the certificate in local language
  • The candidate who have received letter grades or grading points instead of marks, should provide conversion chart and percentage equivalent of their respective letter grades, issued by concerned board/university/institution
  • Any subsequent change of address/Telephone No./Email address should be promptly communicated to the Section Officer, Recruitment-1 Section, Room No. 12, 5th Floor, Zakir Hussain Block, NCERT, New Delhi- 110016
  • Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification and the candidature is liable to be summarily rejected
  • In order to avoid last minute rush, the candidates are advised in their own interest to apply well in time
  • All applicants should submit Self Declaration as per prescribed format
  • Applicants serving under Government, Quasi-Government, Public Sector Undertaking and Autonomous Organizations should apply through proper channel and submit at the time of online application the permission letter from their present employer (No Objection Certificate)
  • The shortlisted non-local candidates will be entitled for reimbursement of Train fare restricted up to 3rd AC (except for Special trains like Rajdhani, Shatabadi, etc.) or the actual fare, whichever is less, on submission of tickets
  • Any litigation in the matter will be subject to the Delhi jurisdiction only
  • Candidates in their own interest are advised to remain updated with the selection/recruitment process by visiting the website www.ncert.nic.in regularly for any further instruction/information
  • In case of any query related to Advt. No. 177/2026, e-mail id of the section is [email protected]
  • Hindi version of this advertisement is also being published separately. In case of any discrepancies are found in Hindi version, English version will be followed

  • Desirable Qualification: NET/ GPAT/ GATE/ RET qualified preferred for many JRF/ SRF posts; experience in relevant tools (HPLC/HPTLC, animal handling, SPSS/ Stata, molecular biology, etc.); knowledge of basic computer operations.
  • Experience: Required for several posts (e.g., 2–8 years post-Masters/PhD, retired experience for MLT, animal experimentation in virology, etc.).

  • Support posts (MTS/Office Assistant/Pharmacist/Lab Technician): Rs. 16,000–24,000
  • MLT: As per Ministry of Ayush guidelines for Consultants

  • Research Associate / Scientist C: Not exceeding 40 years

Educational Qualification

    OR

  • JRF (Chemistry): Postgraduate degree (M.Sc. or equivalent) in Chemistry with first division and National Eligibility Test (NET) qualification conducted by CSIR-UGC (NET), MHRD (GATE) or JEST.
  • JRF (Physics): Postgraduate degree (M.Sc. or equivalent) in Physics with first division and National Eligibility Test (NET) qualification conducted by CSIR-UGC (NET), MHRD (GATE) or JEST.

  • Candidates must report at 10:00 Hrs on the respective date of interview.
  • Candidates are required to produce original certificates/testimonials related to age, educational qualification, experience, and copies thereof at the time of interview.
  • Candidates must also produce copies of published research papers and thesis, if applicable.
  • Offer of fellowship does not confer any right for absorption in DRDO.

Selection Process

  • A skill test in driving will be conducted to the shortlisted candidates. The mode and other particulars of the same will be
  • The minimum qualifying marks to be secured in the Skill Test will be 45% for OC/EWS, 40% to the BC candidates and 35% for SC, ST
  • The candidates qualified in the Skill Test will be shortlisted in the ratio of 1:3 of the notified/available vacancies for certificate verification prior to the oral interview (Viva-voce) and the candidates who are eligible will be called for oral interview from the said ratio
  • Weightage marks will be given to the candidates presently working on contract or outsourcing basis in the Service of the High Court for the State of Telangana: Head Office of the Telangana State Legal Services Authority, Hyderabad; the Telangana High Court Legal Services Committee, Hyderabad; the Telangana Judicial Ministerial and Subordinate Service; the District Legal Services Authority and in the Mandal Legal Services Committees in the State of Telangana, based on the length of the service they have rendered.   • Merit list will be based on the consolidated marks obtained by the candidates in the skill test and viva-voce
  • Where two or more candidates get equal number of consolidated marks in the said Skill Test and oral interview, the elder in age will be considered for provisional selection. General Information / Instructions

  • Selection will be made as per the Service Rules of the High Court for the State of Telangana, 2019 (as amended from time to time).
  • Candidates resorting to bring any influence of any kind will be summarily disqualified.
  • No person who has more than one wife living or who has spouse living, marries in any case, in which such marriage is void by reason of its taking place during the life time of such spouse, shall be eligible for appointment by direct recruitment.
  • No person who has been dismissed from a State or Central Government service or from the service of Central or State Government undertaking or local or other authorities or who has been convicted by a Court of Law for an offence involving moral turpitude shall be eligible for appointment to the post.
  • This appointment shall be covered by the Contributory Pension Scheme (CPS).
  • No information will be sent to the unsuccessful candidates after announcement of the list of provisionally selected candidates.
  • All rights are reserved with the appointing authority to cancel the provisional selection of the candidates if the certificates of the provisionally selected candidates such as eligibility, educational qualification, and social status etc., are found to be in correct at any stage of the recruitment.
  • The prescribed Form of Application can be downloaded from the High Courts' website, viz., https://tshc.gov.in and print the same on a A4 size copy paper for the purpose of filling-in and submission.
  • Help Desk (Help Desk will function on all working days): i. Help Desk Land Line Telephone No.040-23688394. ii. Help Desk Email ID: [email protected]. iii. Working hours of Help Desk Office: From 10.30 A.M to 5.00P.M iv. Lunch Break: 1.30 P.M. to 2.30 P.M.

How to Apply

  • Applications are invited in the proforma application enclosed to this notification
  • The duly filled in applications should be sent by Speed post/ Courier or in person, duly superscribing on envelop as "APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF DRIVER- 2026", to the Registrar (Recruitment), High Court for the State of Telangana at Hyderabad - 500 066, on or before 28.02.2026 by 05:00 PM (Two separate self-addressed envelopes for communication to the applicant by the High Court, are also required to be submitted along with this application.)
  • Attested (to be attested by a Gazetted Officer) copies of certificates of prescribed academic qualification, such as, marks lists, pass certificate, certificate evidencing date of birth, Valid Driving Licence issued by competent authority substantiating the eligibility criteria as prescribed in this notification, caste certificate and relevant experience certificate
  • One passport size photograph is to be pasted on the application at right top corner. Further the applicants shall include 2 passport size photographs (not to be attested and not to be pasted anywhere on the application) along with the application. All three photographs shall be latest and identical
  • No-objection Certificate from the Employer (if employed anywhere)
  • After publication of the list of provisionally selected candidates, they will be called for original certificates verification on a date fixed for this purpose. They shall produce all the relevant original certificates on the prescribed date. If any candidate fails to produce any of the required certificates, his/her candidature will be rejected without any further correspondence
  • The unsigned, not properly filled and the applications received without necessary enclosures will be summarily rejected and applications received after the due date, for any reasons will not be entertained. Information will be sent to all the eligible applicants about the date, time and venue of Skill Test to be conducted. The information will also be placed in the website of the High Court

Eligibility Criteria – Telangana High Court Office Subordinate Recruitment 2026

Educational Qualification

  • Candidate must have passed any examination between 7th to 10th class or its equivalent.
  • Candidates having qualification higher than 10th class are not eligible.
  • Applicants must mention any work experience such as cooking, carpentry, plumbing, electrical, painting, etc., as relevant to duties at residences of Judicial Officers.
  • Educational qualification must be possessed as on the date of notification (02.02.2026).

Age Limit (as on 01-07-2026)

  • Minimum age: 18 years.
  • Maximum age: 46 years.

Age Relaxation (as per Telangana State & Subordinate Service Rules)

  • SC / ST / BC / EWS: 5 years.
  • Persons with Disabilities (PWD): 10 years.
  • For candidates working on contract or outsourcing basis in specified judicial/legal services – relaxation as per rules, provided they were within age limit at initial appointment and have at least 2 years of service by date of notification.

Reservation

  • Reservation applicable for SC, ST, BC, EWS, Persons with Disability (40% and above), and Women, as per Government of Telangana orders.
  • Community must be recognized as BC/SC/ST in the State of Telangana as per G.O.Ms references; otherwise, candidate is treated as Open Category.
  • 33 1/3% horizontal reservation for Women will be implemented.
  • Reservation for EWS will be as per relevant G.O.Ms issued by Government of Telangana.

Selection Process – Telangana High Court Office Subordinate 2026

OMR Based Examination & Viva-Voce

  • OMR-based written examination (objective type, multiple choice) – 45 marks.
  • Oral interview (Viva-voce) – 5 marks.
  • Question paper: General Knowledge, 45 questions, 1 mark each, duration 60 minutes.
  • Question paper will be in two languages – English and Telugu.

Minimum Qualifying Marks

  • OC & EWS: 45% in OMR examination.
  • BC: 40% in OMR examination.
  • SC / ST / PH: 35% in OMR examination.

Shortlisting & Weightage

  • Candidates qualified in OMR exam will be shortlisted in 1:3 ratio of notified/available vacancies for certificate verification and viva-voce.
  • Weightage marks will be given to candidates working on contract/outsourcing basis in notified judicial/legal services based on length of service, subject to minimum 2 years of service and securing minimum qualifying marks.

Merit List

  • Merit list will be prepared on the basis of marks secured in OMR examination and viva-voce.
  • In case of tie in total marks, elder candidate in age will be preferred.
  • If tie persists, candidate with higher marks in prescribed educational qualification will be considered.

Application / Examination Fee

  • OC & BC candidates: Rs. 600/- (excluding service charges).
  • SC / ST / EWS / PWD candidates: Rs. 400/- (excluding service charges).
  • Concessional fee of Rs. 400/- for SC/ST is applicable only to communities recognized as SC/ST in Telangana.
  • Fee must be paid online only; once paid, it is non-refundable under any circumstances.

How to Apply Online for Telangana High Court Office Subordinate Recruitment 2026

  1. Visit the official website of the High Court for the State of Telangana: https://tshc.gov.in.
  2. Click on the recruitment/notifications section and open the link for “Notification No. 101/2026 – Office Subordinate Recruitment”.
  3. Complete Part-A: One Time Profile Registration (OTPR) by entering your basic details to generate OTPR ID and password.
  4. Login using the OTPR ID and password and proceed to Part-B: Application Form for Office Subordinate posts.
  5. Fill in all required details carefully – personal details, educational qualification (7th to 10th class), community, disability (if any), and work experience (cooking, carpentry, plumbing, electrical, painting, etc.).
  6. Upload scanned copies of required certificates/documents in PDF format (as per instructions in the user guide) and recent passport-size photograph and signature, if required.
  7. Pay the applicable online application/examination fee as per your category through the available online payment modes.
  8. Submit the online application and take a printout / save the application and payment receipt for future reference.

Important: Candidates must keep all scanned certificates ready in PDF format before starting the online application. Particulars furnished in the online form will be treated as final, and any wrong information regarding category/caste may forfeit the claim for reservation.

Scribe Details Entry Window (for eligible PwBD candidates) 15.03.2026 to 19.03.2026
Computer Based Test (CBT) - Tentative Will be notified on RRB websites
Physical Efficiency Test (PET) Will be notified on RRC websites
Document Verification (DV) Will be notified on RRC websites
Medical Examination (ME) Will be notified on RRC websites

Selection Process for RRB Group D CEN 09/2025

The recruitment consists of 4 successive stages:

Stage 1: Computer Based Test (CBT)

Duration: 90 minutes (120 minutes for candidates using scribe)

Total Questions: 100 (Each of 1 mark)

Subject Number of Questions
General Science 25
Mathematics 25
General Intelligence and Reasoning 30
General Awareness and Current Affairs 20
TOTAL 100 Questions = 100 Marks

Exam Pattern:

  • Objective type with multiple choices
  • Questions available in English, Hindi, and 13 regional languages (Assamese, Bengali, Gujarati, Kannada, Konkani, Malayalam, Manipuri, Marathi, Odia, Punjabi, Tamil, Telugu, Urdu)
  • Negative Marking: 1/3 mark deducted for each wrong answer
  • Section-wise distribution may vary slightly in actual exam

Minimum Qualifying Marks:

  • UR: 40%
  • EWS: 40%
  • OBC-NCL: 30%
  • SC: 30%
  • ST: 30%
  • PwBD: May be relaxed by 2 marks in case of shortage

Syllabus (Indicative):

  • Mathematics: Number system, BODMAS, Decimals, Fractions, LCM, HCF, Ratio & Proportion, Percentages, Mensuration, Time & Work, Time & Distance, Simple & Compound Interest, Profit & Loss, Algebra, Geometry, Trigonometry, Elementary Statistics, Square root, Age Calculations, Calendar & Clock, Pipes & Cistern
  • General Intelligence & Reasoning: Analogies, Alphabetical & Number Series, Coding & Decoding, Mathematical operations, Relationships, Syllogism, Jumbling, Venn Diagram, Data Interpretation & Sufficiency, Conclusions & Decision making, Similarities & Differences, Analytical Reasoning, Classification, Directions, Statement-Arguments & Assumptions
  • General Science: Physics, Chemistry, Life Sciences of 10th standard level (CBSE)
  • General Awareness & Current Affairs: Science & Technology, Sports, Culture, Personalities, Economics, Politics, and other important subjects

Normalization: Marks will be normalized if CBT conducted in multiple sessions

Stage 2: Physical Efficiency Test (PET)

Shortlisting: 3 times the total vacancies (may vary) based on CBT merit

Nature: Qualifying (Mandatory to pass - marks not counted for final merit)

Candidate Type Test 1: Weight Carrying Test 2: Running
Male Candidates Lift and carry 35 kg weight for 100 meters in 2 minutes (in one chance, without putting down) Run 1000 meters in 4 minutes 15 seconds (in one chance)
Female Candidates Lift and carry 20 kg weight for 100 meters in 2 minutes (in one chance, without putting down) Run 1000 meters in 5 minutes 40 seconds (in one chance)
Transgender Candidates Same relaxed standards as Female candidates

Important PET Notes:

  • Two-stage test: First weight carrying, then running (after recovery gap)
  • Failing in weight carrying means elimination (no running test)
  • Weight carrying involves lifting sandbag (without handle) from waist-height bench and carrying without dropping
  • Candidates' responsibility to ensure medical fitness for PET - Railways not responsible for injuries
  • Exemptions from PET:
    • Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) - must pass medical examination
    • Course Completed Act Apprentices (CCAA)
    • Ex-Servicemen (ExSM)
  • Pregnant Candidates: Must submit self-declaration. If pregnant, PET deferred till 6 weeks post-confinement. Vacancy kept reserved.

Stage 3: Document Verification (DV)

  • Shortlisting: 1:1 ratio of vacancies based on CBT merit + PET qualification
  • Candidates must produce original certificates
  • No additional time given - absence leads to candidature cancellation
  • Scanned copies to be uploaded before DV at https://oirms-ir.gov.in/rrbdv
  • Certificates must be in English/Hindi (translated version required otherwise)
  • Hard copy of signed application form to be brought

Stage 4: Medical Examination (ME)

  • Conducted by Railway Medical Authorities
  • Must pass requisite medical fitness test as per IRMM
  • Visual acuity standards strictly enforced
  • Medical appeal option available (one final opportunity on payment)
  • Candidates found medically unsuitable will NOT be given alternative appointment

Final Merit & Selection

  • Based on CBT marks (after normalization if applicable)
  • Subject to PET qualification, DV clearance, and medical fitness
  • Post/Railway allotment as per candidate's preference, merit, medical fitness, and vacancy
  • In case of tie: Older candidate ranked higher; if age also same, alphabetical order of name (A to Z)
  • No right to appointment - RRB/RRC only recommends; appointment by Railway Administration

Reservation & Relaxation for RRB Group D CEN 09/2025

Vertical Reservation (Community-wise):

  • SC (Scheduled Caste)
  • ST (Scheduled Tribe)
  • OBC-NCL (Other Backward Classes - Non Creamy Layer)
  • EWS (Economically Weaker Sections)

Horizontal Reservation (across all communities):

  • Ex-Servicemen (ExSM)
  • Course Completed Act Apprentices (CCAA) trained in Railway Establishments
  • Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD)

Important Reservation Rules:

For OBC-NCL Candidates:

  • Must produce OBC-NCL certificate issued on or after 01.04.2025 but not later than 02.03.2026
  • Certificate must be as per central list (http://www.ncbc.nic.in)
  • Must submit self-declaration (Annexure IIA) at DV that they don't belong to Creamy Layer
  • Certificate must mention: "Does NOT belong to Creamy Layer as per DOPT OM 36012/22/93-Estt.(SCT) dated 08.09.93, modified vide OM 36033/1/2013-Estt.(Res.) dated 13.09.2017"
  • OBC in state list but not in central list: NOT eligible for reservation

For EWS Candidates:

  • NOT covered under SC/ST/OBC-NCL
  • Gross annual family income < Rs. 8 lakh for F.Y. 2024-25
  • Family should NOT own:
    • 5 acres or more of agricultural land, OR
    • Residential flat of 1000 sq. ft. or more, OR
    • Residential plot of 100 sq. yards or more (notified municipalities), OR
    • Residential plot of 200 sq. yards or more (other areas)
  • Family: Applicant, parents, siblings <18 years, spouse, children <18 years
  • Must possess valid Income & Asset Certificate (Annexure III) based on F.Y. 2024-25 income/assets

For PwBD Candidates:

  • Minimum 40% benchmark disability required for reservation/relaxation
  • Certificate as per Form V/VI of RPwD Rules 2024 (Annexure V-A/V-B)
  • Must submit Unique Disability Identity (UDID)
  • Suitability for posts indicated in Annexure-A
  • Eligible Disabilities:
    • VI (Visually Impaired): Blindness (B), Low Vision (LV)
    • HI (Hearing Impaired): Deaf (D), Hard of Hearing (HH)
    • LD (Locomotor Disability): OA, OL, OAL, BL, LC, DW, AAV, CP, SD (without neurological/limb dysfunction), SI (without neurological/limb dysfunction)
    • MD (Multiple Disabilities)
  • Temporary disability candidates NOT eligible for reservation (as per DePwD OM dated 17.12.2025)

For Ex-Servicemen (ExSM):

  • Must have valid Ex-Serviceman Certificate from Zila Sainik Board
  • Serving defense personnel expected to be released within 1 year can also apply
  • Must submit NOC with probable discharge date (Annexure VI-A) at DV
  • Declaration/Undertaking (Annexure VI) required at DV
  • ExSM who already secured civil employment using ExSM quota: NOT eligible for ExSM reservation (only age relaxation available)
  • Different medical standards applicable (Para 534 of IRMM)

For CCAA (Railway Establishments):

  • Must have completed Act Apprenticeship by 02.03.2026 (appeared in NCVT exam)
  • National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) from NCVT required at DV
  • Weightage: 1/3rd marks from NCVT examination added to CBT marks for merit
  • If NCVT weightage gives lower score, higher of the two will be considered
  • Exempted from PET
  • Can apply to any RRB (not just training Railway)

General Instructions for RRB Group D CEN 09/2025

Application Rules:

  • ONE application per candidate - Multiple applications will lead to rejection of ALL applications and debarment from future RRB/RRC exams
  • Choose only ONE RRB/Railway Zone (cannot be changed later)
  • Indicate post preferences within chosen Railway Zone
  • Partial options allowed (will be considered only for opted posts)
  • No change in preferences after submission
  • Online application only through official RRB websites (listed in Para 24.0)

Identity Authentication:

  • Strongly advised to authenticate using DigiLocker or Aadhaar during account creation
  • Aadhaar-seeded bank account mandatory for fee refund
  • Candidates using alternate Photo IDs will face stricter scrutiny at all stages

Account Creation:

  • If already created account for CEN 2024/2025, use same credentials
  • Valid mobile number and email ID mandatory (will remain unchanged throughout recruitment)
  • Details in 'Create an Account' form CANNOT be modified

Application Modification:

  • Allowed from 05.03.2026 to 14.03.2026
  • Fee: Rs. 250/- per modification (non-refundable)
  • Can modify any number of times (except 'Create Account' details and Chosen Railway)
  • If changing from SC/ST to UR/OBC/EWS or from ExSM/Female/PwBD to non-reserved: Pay fee difference (Rs. 250/-) in addition to modification fee
  • No modifications entertained after 14.03.2026

Live Photo & Signature Upload:

  • Live Photo: Captured during application (NOT pre-existing photo)
  • Stand/sit in front of camera at eye level, face centered, neutral expression
  • Non-white clothing (preferably dark colors), no cap/mask/glasses
  • Applications with blurred/non-compliant photos liable for rejection
  • Signature: Running handwriting in black ink on white paper (scanned)
  • NO BLOCK/CAPITAL/DISJOINTED LETTERS
  • JPG/JPEG format, 30-49 KB, 140×60 pixels minimum
  • Signature must match at all stages (CBT/DV/ME/Appointment)

Scribe Facility (for eligible PwBD candidates):

  • Eligible: Blindness, Locomotor Disability (Both Arms - BA), Cerebral Palsy
  • Others: Only with certificate from CMO/Civil Surgeon (Annexure V-G)
  • PwBD <40% with writing difficulty: Certificate as per Annexure V-E required
  • Scribe must register at rrbapply.gov.in (One-Time Registration - OTR)
  • Candidate must enter scribe's OTR number during 15.03.2026 to 19.03.2026 window
  • Scribe qualification: ONE step below candidate's qualification
  • One scribe per candidate; scribe cannot be a candidate in same CEN
  • Compensatory time: 20 minutes per hour of examination

Examination Centers:

  • Allocated based on technical/logistical feasibility
  • Candidates may have to travel to other cities/states
  • No change of center/date/shift allowed

Banned Items at Exam Center:

  • Mobile phones, pagers, watches, earphones, Bluetooth devices, microphones, health bands
  • Calculators, books, pen, paper, pencil, eraser, pouch, scale, writing pad
  • Belts, handbags, caps, purses, cameras, water bottles, food items
  • ONLY e-call letter allowed inside test center
  • Pen will be provided during exam
  • No cloak room - advised not to bring valuables
  • Do not apply henna on hands/feet (obstructs biometric capture)

Important Warnings:

  • Debarment for life if found using unfair means, impersonation, forgery, misbehavior
  • Provisions of "The Public Examinations (Prevention of Unfair Means) Act, 2024" applicable
  • Comprehensive post-exam analysis (log analysis, photo/biometric verification, CCTV review)
  • Beware of touts and fake websites - RRBs NEVER appoint agents/coaching centers
  • Selection purely on merit

How to Apply for RRB Group D CEN 09/2025

Step 1: Create an Account (if not already created)

  • Visit official RRB website from the list at Para 24.0
  • Click on "Create an Account" link
  • Authenticate using DigiLocker/Aadhaar (strongly recommended)
  • Enter valid mobile number and email ID (CANNOT be changed later)
  • Complete OTP verification
  • Create login credentials

Step 2: Fill Online Application

  • Login with created credentials
  • Select CEN 09/2025
  • Choose ONE RRB/Railway Zone (CANNOT be changed)
  • Fill personal details, educational qualifications
  • Select post preferences within chosen Railway
  • Choose examination language (English/Hindi/Regional)
  • Capture live photograph using webcam/mobile camera
  • Upload scanned signature (JPG/JPEG, 30-49 KB, black ink, running handwriting)
  • Upload SC/ST certificate (if claiming free travel pass)
  • Indicate scribe requirement (if applicable)
  • Verify all details carefully

Step 3: Pay Application Fee

  • Select payment mode: Internet Banking/Debit Card/Credit Card/UPI
  • Pay Rs. 500/- (General/EWS/OBC-NCL Male) or Rs. 250/- (SC/ST/PwBD/Female/ExSM/Transgender/Minorities/EBC)
  • Complete payment (all service charges borne by candidate)
  • Save payment receipt

Step 4: Final Submission

UPSC CSE 2026 – Preliminary Examination Pattern

The Civil Services (Preliminary) Examination is the first stage of the UPSC selection process. It is a screening test used to shortlist candidates for the Main Examination. Marks scored in Prelims are not counted in the final merit ranking.

Paper Subject Type Marks Duration
Paper I General Studies (GS) Objective (MCQs) 200 Marks 2 Hours
Paper II CSAT (Aptitude Test) Objective (MCQs) 200 Marks 2 Hours

Prelims Key Rules

  • Both papers are objective type (Multiple Choice Questions).
  • Paper II (CSAT) is qualifying in nature – minimum 33% marks required.
  • Marks of Paper I are considered for cutoff and shortlisting for Mains.
  • Negative marking applies: 1/3rd mark deducted for each wrong answer.
  • Leaving a question blank carries no penalty.

UPSC CSE 2026 – Main Examination Pattern

The Civil Services (Main) Examination is the second stage and consists of a written examination followed by an Interview/Personality Test. Marks obtained in the written papers and interview are counted for the final merit list.

Paper Subject Marks Nature
Paper A Compulsory Indian Language 300 Qualifying
Paper B English 300 Qualifying
Paper I Essay 250 Merit
Paper II General Studies I 250 Merit
Paper III General Studies II 250 Merit
Paper IV General Studies III 250 Merit
Paper V General Studies IV (Ethics) 250 Merit
Paper VI Optional Subject – Paper 1 250 Merit
Paper VII Optional Subject – Paper 2 250 Merit

Main Exam Structure

  • Total Written Papers: 9
  • Qualifying Papers: 2 (Indian Language & English)
  • Merit Papers: 7
  • Total Marks (Written): 1750

Interview / Personality Test

Stage Marks
Personality Test / Interview 275

Final Merit Calculation

  • Written Exam Marks: 1750
  • Interview Marks: 275
  • Total Merit Marks: 2025

Important Notes

  • Prelims marks are used only for qualification, not for final ranking.
  • Mains + Interview marks decide final service allocation.
  • Negative marking applies in Prelims only.
  • Candidates must qualify in both language papers to have their merit papers evaluated.

  • Candidates registered for the Ph.D. programme prior to July 11, 2009, shall be governed by the provisions of the then existing Ordinances/Bye-laws/Regulations of the Institution awarding the degree and such Ph.D. candidates shall be exempted from the requirement of NET/SLET/SET subject to fulfillment of specific conditions: Ph.D. degree awarded in regular mode, Ph.D. thesis evaluated by at least two external examiners, Open Ph.D. viva voce conducted, Candidate has published two research papers from Ph.D. work (at least one in refereed journal), Candidate has presented at least two papers based on Ph.D work in conferences/seminars sponsored/funded/supported by the UGC/ICSSR/CSIR or any similar agency
  • The fulfillment of these conditions is to be certified by the Registrar or the Dean (Academic Affairs) of the University concerned
  • The Academic score as specified in Appendix II for Universities and Colleges shall be considered for short-listing of the candidates for interview only, and the selections shall be based only on the performance in the interview as per UGC Regulations-2018 and as amended from time to time

Experience

  • Professor: A minimum of ten years of teaching experience in university/college as Assistant Professor/Associate Professor/Professor, and/or research experience at equivalent level at the University/National Level Institutions with evidence of having successfully guided doctoral candidate OR ten years experience as an outstanding professional from academic institutions/industry with significant contribution to the knowledge in the concerned discipline
  • Associate Professor: A minimum of eight years of experience of teaching and/or research in an academic/research position equivalent to that of Assistant Professor in a University, College or Accredited Research Institution/industry
  • Deputy Librarian: Eight years experience as an Assistant University Librarian/College Librarian with evidence of innovative library services including integration of ICT in library
  • Assistant Professor and Assistant Librarian: No specific years of experience required, but must have NET/SLET/SET qualification or Ph.D. degree exemption as per UGC norms

Desirable

  • For Professor positions: Published work of high quality, actively engaged in research with evidence of published work with a minimum of 10 research publications in the peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals and a total research score of 120
  • For Associate Professor positions: A minimum of seven publications in the peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals and a total research score of 75
  • For Deputy Librarian: Evidence of innovative library services including integration of ICT in library
  • For Assistant Librarian: A consistently good academic record with knowledge of computerization of a library

Salary/Stipend

  • Professor: Academic level 14 with rationalized entry pay of Rs. 1,44,200/- per month (Pre-revised scale of pay: Rs.37,400-67,000 with AGP-10,000)
  • Associate Professor/Deputy Librarian: Academic level 13A with rationalized entry pay of Rs. 1,31,400/- per month (Pre-revised scale of pay: Rs.37,400-67,000 with AGP-9,000)
  • Assistant Professor/Assistant Librarian: Academic level 10 with rationalized entry pay of Rs. 57,700/- per month (Pre-revised scale of pay: Rs.15,600-39,100 with AGP-6,000)
  • All pay scales are as per UGC/NCERT/Government of India norms and will be applicable as amended from time to time
  • Selected candidates will be entitled to other allowances and benefits as per Government of India/NCERT rules applicable from time to time

Age Limit (as on 20/02/2026)

  • Age of retirement on superannuation will be as per the UGC/NCERT, Government of India norms as amended from time to time and in force at the time of closing date of filling-up online application
  • The relaxation in age and percentage of marks to candidates belonging to SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/EWS/PWD categories is provided in accordance with the UGC/GOI/NCERT rules
  • Persons with Disability (PWD) having disability less than forty percent will not be considered. The disability certificate shall be from a competent medical board constituted by the central or state Government Hospital
  • Such persons should meet the prescribed criteria of physical disability of the respective category as per the Government of India rules

Application Fee

  • UR/OBC/EWS Candidates: Rs. 1000/- (Rupees One thousand only) through online payment mode only
  • Women applicants and applicants belonging to SC/ST/PWD: Exempted from payment of fee
  • No other mode of payment will be accepted other than online payment mode
  • Fee once paid shall not be refunded under any circumstances

Important Dates

Event Date & Time
Advertisement Number 177/2026
Commencement of Online Registration on NCERT website 31/01/2026 (10:00 AM)
Extended Last Date of Online Registration and apply online 06/03/2026 (Up to 05:00 PM)
Closing date for eligibility criteria 20/02/2026

Selection Process

  • For Assistant Professor Posts: Up to 50 candidates (category-wise) for the first vacancy and 05 candidates for every additional vacancy will be called for the interview in order of their rank/merit in the list as prepared by the Shortlisting Committee on the basis of marks scored by the candidates, which should not be less than academic score of 60 (Sixty) in any case. In case of tie of marks at the 50th place for 01 vacancy and tie of marks at 5th place for every additional vacancy, all candidates whose marks tie will be called for interview
  • For Professor and Associate Professor Posts: The existing criterion of minimum academic score as per UGC guidelines will be followed subject to the condition up to 10 candidates (category-wise) for the first vacancy and 05 candidates for every additional vacancy will be called for interview in order of their rank/merit in the list as prepared by the Shortlisting Committee on the basis of marks scored by the candidates. In case of tie of marks at the 10th place for 01 vacancy and tie of marks at 5th place for every additional vacancy, all candidates whose marks tie will be called for interview
  • The Academic score shall be considered for short-listing of the candidates for interview only, and the selections shall be based only on the performance in the interview
  • The list of shortlisted candidates will be displayed on the NCERT website
  • The shortlisted candidates will be allowed to appear for the interview only after verification of their eligibility
  • The registration will be provisional as the eligibility of the shortlisted candidate will be verified at the time of Interview from the original documents
  • All Certificates, Degrees and other documents must be produced in original for verification at the time of interview (if shortlisted), failing which the candidate may not be allowed to appear for the interview
  • Final result of the selected candidates will be displayed on NCERT website
  • The Council will not entertain any correspondence with the candidates about their non-selection in the recruitment
  • The decision of the NCERT in all matters relating to selection and allotment of posts/organizations to selected candidates will be final and binding on the candidates

General Information/Instructions

  • National Council of Educational Research and Training (NCERT) is an apex organization for Educational Research, Teacher Training and Development of Curriculum and Instructional material in school education
  • Positions are available at NCERT, New Delhi and at its constituent units located at Ajmer, Bhopal, Bhubaneswar, Mysuru and Shillong
  • Only Indian Nationals need to apply
  • Eligible and interested candidates are required to apply online only through the NCERT website www.ncert.nic.in at Announcement-Vacancy-Academic. No other means/mode of submission of applications will be accepted
  • The candidates must have a valid email id and mobile number through which he/she will get registered with the online application portal
  • Candidates should fill in the details to register and then fill the information in the online application form at the appropriate places very carefully
  • Fields with STAR (*) mark are mandatory and essential to be filled in by the candidate
  • After the required information have been provided, click submit button. However, before clicking "Submit" button, candidate must make sure that no changes are required and the information provided is correct and final. After application is submitted, no changes will be entertained
  • Candidates are required to upload their scanned recent/colour passport size photograph, applicant's signature and all the relevant documents. The candidates have to keep a copy of application with documents for record and the same to be produced at the time of verification of document/interview, if shortlisted
  • In case a candidate wishes to apply for more than one post, he/she should submit separate application online along with the requisite fee for each post applied for. All the online applications should be completed in all respects. Only one application for individual post from one applicant will be accepted

  • Candidate must indicate his/her caste/category in the appropriate column of the application form (SC, ST, UR, OBC (NCL) & EWS etc). Leaving the caste column blank would not automatically be assumed as an application for un-reserved category and the application will be rejected as incomplete
  • The OBC-Non Creamy Layer candidates will be required to submit a valid caste certificate for purpose of reservation in appointment to posts under Government of India/Central Government from a competent authority along with latest Non Creamy Layer certificate and self-declaration that he/she does not belong to the creamy layer as on the closing date of submission of applications
  • The EWS candidates will be required to submit a valid certificate for purpose of reservation in appointment to posts under Government of India/Central Government from a competent authority and self declaration
  • Number of vacancies may vary depending upon the actual requirement. NCERT reserves the right not to fill up any or all the posts or cancel the whole process of recruitment without assigning any reason
  • Mere fulfilling the minimum eligibility requirements does not entitle a candidate to be called for interview. NCERT reserves the right to restrict the number of candidates to be called for interview
  • The certificates, which are neither in English nor in Hindi, need to be translated preferably to either in English or in Hindi and the same shall be submitted along with the copy of the certificate in local language
  • The candidate who have received letter grades or grading points instead of marks, should provide conversion chart and percentage equivalent of their respective letter grades, issued by concerned board/university/institution
  • Any subsequent change of address/Telephone No./Email address should be promptly communicated to the Section Officer, Recruitment-1 Section, Room No. 12, 5th Floor, Zakir Hussain Block, NCERT, New Delhi- 110016
  • Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification and the candidature is liable to be summarily rejected
  • In order to avoid last minute rush, the candidates are advised in their own interest to apply well in time

  • Applicants serving under Government, Quasi-Government, Public Sector Undertaking and Autonomous Organizations should apply through proper channel and submit at the time of online application the permission letter from their present employer (No Objection Certificate)
  • The shortlisted non-local candidates will be entitled for reimbursement of Train fare restricted up to 3rd AC (except for Special trains like Rajdhani, Shatabadi, etc.) or the actual fare, whichever is less, on submission of tickets
  • Any litigation in the matter will be subject to the Delhi jurisdiction only
  • Candidates in their own interest are advised to remain updated with the selection/recruitment process by visiting the website www.ncert.nic.in regularly for any further instruction/information
  • In case of any query related to Advt. No. 177/2026, e-mail id of the section is [email protected]
  • Hindi version of this advertisement is also being published separately. In case of any discrepancies are found in Hindi version, English version will be followed

How to Apply

Eligibility Criteria

Post-wise Qualifications, Experience & Age Limits

  • Deputy Registrar (Group A, Level 12, UR-01)
    • Upper Age Limit: 50 years.
    • Qualification: Master’s Degree with at least 55% marks or equivalent grade.
    • Experience: 5 years administrative experience as Assistant Registrar in Level 10 or equivalent in Govt./Govt. research establishments/universities/statutory organizations/organizations of high repute.
  • Private Secretary (Group B, Level 7, UR-01)
    • Upper Age Limit: 38 years.
    • Qualification: I. Master’s Degree with 50% marks with excellent command over English. II. Computer key depression speed equivalent to 60 wpm. III. One-year Diploma/Proficiency Certificate in Computer and office applications from recognised institution.
    • Experience: 5 years relevant experience in Govt. organisations in Pay Level 6. Desirable: English stenography/shorthand speed 100 wpm.
  • Junior Assistant (Multi Skill) (Group C, Level 3, UR-01)
    • Upper Age Limit: 30 years.
    • Qualification: Bachelor’s Degree with 50% marks in any discipline with excellent computer proficiency in office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint etc.).
    • Experience: 3 years relevant experience in office practices / hospitality and catering services.
  • Senior Superintendent (Group B, Level 7, UR-01) – Deputation
    • Upper Age Limit: Not exceeding 56 years (as per DoPT OM).
    • Qualification: Master’s Degree in any discipline with at least 50% marks or equivalent grade.
    • Experience: At least 5 years in Pay Level 6 or above as Junior Superintendent or equivalent, handling Admin/Finance & Accounts/Academic/Legal/Statutory/Audit/Stores & Purchase/Establishment in Central/State Govt., funded institutes, universities or comparable institutions.
  • Senior Technical Officer (IT) (Group A, Level 11, UR-01)
    • Upper Age Limit: 50 years.
    • Qualification: B.E./B.Tech in relevant field with first class or equivalent (6.5/10 CGPA) and consistently excellent academic record.
    • Experience: 5 years relevant ICT experience in a post carrying Pay Level 10 or equivalent.
  • Technical Officer (Lab) (Group A, Level 10, UR-01)
    • Upper Age Limit: 40 years.
    • Qualification: M.Sc./BS-MS Degree in Instrumentation/Physical Science with first class or equivalent (6.5/10) and consistently excellent academic record.
    • Experience: 5 years proven research/laboratory experience in operation of scientific/technical equipment and support to academic/research framework in premier institutes, with total 5 years post-master’s lab/research experience.
  • Junior Technical Assistant (Lab) (Group C, Level 5, UR-01)
    • Upper Age Limit: 33 years.
    • Qualification: Bachelor’s Degree in Geology with at least 55% marks.
    • Experience: 5 years relevant experience in laboratory/academic/research establishments of national/international repute, handling equipment related to Earth & Environmental Sciences labs.
  • Assistant Engineer (Civil) (Group B, Level 7, UR-01)
    • Upper Age Limit: 38 years.
    • Qualification & Experience: Bachelor’s Degree in Civil Engineering with first class and 3 years relevant experience in Level 6 as Junior Engineer or above in institutional building construction/maintenance/design & planning as per CPWD norms. OR Diploma in Civil Engineering with first class and 5 years relevant experience in Level 6 as Junior Engineer or above in similar CPWD-norm based works.
  • Junior Engineer (Electrical) (Group B, Level 6, UR-01)
    • Upper Age Limit: 35 years.
    • Qualification & Experience: Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical/HVAC Engineering with first class and at least 5 years field experience in electrical/HVAC construction/maintenance works, preferably as per CPWD/PWD/Govt. norms. OR Diploma in Electrical/HVAC Engineering with first class and at least 8 years similar field experience.
  • Medical Officer (Group A, Level 10 + NPA, UR-01)
    • Upper Age Limit: 40 years.
    • Qualification: MBBS or equivalent included in any Schedule to the Indian Medical Council Act, 1956, registered in State/Indian Medical Register.
    • Experience: At least 5 years post-qualification experience after internship in a recognised large/multi-speciality hospital of good repute. Desirable: MD in General Medicine or equivalent, registered in State/Indian Medical Register.
  • Nurse (Group B, Level 7, UR-01)
    • Upper Age Limit: 38 years.
    • Qualification: Master’s Degree with 50% marks in Nursing from recognised University/Institution OR First Class B.Sc. (Nursing) 4-year Degree from recognised University/Institute, registered as Nurse & Midwife with Indian/State Nursing Council.
    • Experience: 5 years clinical experience in minimum 50-bedded hospital recognised by Central/State Govt./MCI.
  • Junior Library Superintendent (Group B, Level 6, 01 post reserved for PwBD – OA/OL/HH)
    • Upper Age Limit: 35 years.
    • Qualification: Master’s Degree in Library Science/Library & Information Science with 55% marks OR First class Bachelor’s Degree in Library Science/Library & Information Science.
    • Desirable: Diploma/Certificate in Computer Application/Digital Library Management/Library Automation or sufficient experience in library digitisation and networking.
    • Experience: 5 years in Library & Information Science in digital library management/automation/networking in Central/State Govt., autonomous bodies, universities, or higher education institutes.
  • Physical Education Instructor (Group B, Level 7, UR-01)
    • Upper Age Limit: 38 years.
    • Qualification: I. Master’s Degree in Physical Education and Sports/Sports Science with first class or 50% marks. II. Diploma in Coaching from NIS or equivalent. III. Must qualify prescribed physical fitness test as per UGC regulations.
    • Experience: I. 5 years in Central/State educational institutes/organisations of repute. II. Demonstrated meritorious performance in national/international events (at least twice in past 4 years). III. Representation at University/College/State/National level competitions. IV. Evidence of organising competitions and coaching camps of at least 2 weeks. V. Evidence of having produced good team/athlete performances at State/National/Inter-University level.
  • Junior Translator (Rajbhasha) (Group B, Level 6, UR-01)
    • Upper Age Limit: 35 years.
    • Qualification: Master’s Degree from recognised University in:
      • Hindi with English as compulsory/elective or medium at degree level, OR
      • English with Hindi as compulsory/elective or medium at degree level, OR
      • Any subject with Hindi medium and English as compulsory/elective or medium, OR
      • Any subject with English medium and Hindi as compulsory/elective or medium, OR
      • Any subject with both Hindi and English as compulsory/elective or one as medium and other as compulsory/elective at degree level.
    • Experience: At least 5 years office environment experience with Hindi/English typing skills, excellent computer skills for correspondence/files, and knowledge of translation (Hindi–English and vice versa).

Application Fee

  • Application Fee: Rs. 500 per post (non-refundable) to be paid online.
  • Exempted Categories: Women, SC, ST, Ex-servicemen, PwD and Transgender candidates (on uploading relevant self-attested certificates/ID).
  • Fee once paid will not be refunded under any circumstances.
  • Separate applications and separate fees are required for each post applied.

How To Apply

  • Applications must be submitted online only through IISER Berhampur website: www.iiserbpr.ac.in (online link under recruitment section).
  • No hard copy of application is required to be sent at the time of online submission.
  • During online application, candidates must upload legible self-attested copies (where applicable) of:
    • Educational qualifications and marksheets.
    • Experience certificates.
    • Caste/Community certificate, PwD/Transgender certificate, Ex-servicemen discharge certificate, etc.
    • Valid ID proof issued by State/Central Government.
  • Scan and upload photograph and signature as per specified guidelines:
    • Photo: Recent colour passport size, 200x230 px, 10–100 KB, .jpg/.jpeg, light background.
    • Signature: On white paper with black/blue pen, 140x60 px, 10–100 KB, .jpg/.jpeg; signature in CAPITAL letters not accepted.
  • All communication, including recruitment schedule, shortlist/rejection lists and updates, will be made via email and institute website; candidates must provide an active email ID and check the website regularly.
  • Candidates currently in Government/Semi-Government/Autonomous/PSU service must upload NOC-cum-Vigilance-cum-Experience Certificate in prescribed format at online submission stage.

Important Dates

Event Date / Time
Notification Date 31/12/2025
Opening date for online application 31/01/2026 – 09:00 hrs
Closing date for online application 02/03/2026 – 17:30 hrs
Crucial date for age, qualification & experience 02/03/2026

Instructions

  • IISER Berhampur promotes gender equality and encourages women applicants.
  • Eligibility regarding age, qualification and experience is reckoned as on 02/03/2026; degrees must be from recognised universities/institutes.
  • Age relaxation will be as per Government of India norms; SC/ST/OBC relaxations apply only against reserved vacancies and require valid community certificates issued before the advertisement date; no relaxation for these categories against UR posts.
  • For existing regular IISER Berhampur employees, there is no upper age limit, provided at least one year of service remains before superannuation on last date of application.
  • Deputation posts will follow DoPT guidelines; deputation term generally three years, extendable as per rules.
  • Institute may conduct written and/or trade tests, fix additional shortlisting criteria, and alter number of positions (including consequential vacancies) based on requirements.
  • Mere fulfilment of eligibility does not guarantee being called for test; shortlisting will be as per institute’s criteria and decision will be final; canvassing will lead to disqualification.
  • All documents and antecedents will be verified; submission of fake documents or suppression of information will lead to termination.
  • Probation period for regular positions is one year.
  • PWD eligibility and suitable disability categories/physical requirements are defined post-wise in the notification; minimum 40% disability is required for PwD reservation.
  • Interviews are dispensed with for Group C and Group B Non-Gazetted posts; selection will be based on written/trade tests as per DoPT OMs.
  • Any dispute with recruitment/selection will fall under jurisdiction of Courts/Tribunals at Berhampur, Ganjam, Odisha.
  • For technical issues during online application, candidates may write to: [email protected].

OPTCL Medical Officer Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details

Post Name Total Posts Location
Medical Officer (Contractual) Not Specified Power Hospital, OPTCL Colony, Bhoinagar, Bhubaneswar

Eligibility Criteria

Qualifications

  • Essential Educational Qualification: Must possess qualification of MBBS from the university recognized by Medical Council of India
  • The candidate must have a valid registration certificate under the Odisha Medical Registration Rule 1965
  • The candidate must be a citizen of India

Essential Qualifications

  • MBBS degree from a university recognized by Medical Council of India is mandatory
  • Valid registration certificate under the Odisha Medical Registration Rule 1965 is compulsory
  • All educational qualifications from HSC/10th onwards must be supported by original certificates for verification
  • Medical registration certificate must be produced at the time of personal interview

Experience

  • Candidate should have worked at least 15 years in a Government Hospital/Corporate hospital of SPSU/CPSU or equivalent hospital
  • The hospital should have multiple specialization with minimum 20 beds facility
  • The hospital must have proper diagnostic center and pharmacy
  • Details of work experience shall be clearly mentioned and supported by relevant documentary evidence
  • Retired doctors must furnish Last Pay Certificate (LPC) from the last Hospital/Organisation from which they have been retired
  • Experience certificates must be produced in original at the time of personal interview for verification

Desirable

  • Experience in hospital administration and management would be preferred
  • Knowledge of standard treatment protocols and hospital guidelines is desirable
  • Experience in conducting medical boards, health camps and awareness activities would be an added advantage

Salary/Stipend

  • For Retired Government Doctors: Fixed consolidated remuneration equal to "Pay minus Pension"
  • For Others: Consolidated remuneration of Rs. 80,000/- (Rupees Eighty Thousand only) per month
  • Annual Increment: 3% annual increment applicable for non-retired doctors
  • The selected candidate shall not be entitled for any other allowance or special pay over and above the consolidated remuneration
  • Mobile SIM Facility: Mobile SIM facility will be provided
  • Travelling Allowance: During the period of contractual engagement, candidate will be entitled to get Travelling Allowance for approved tours in line with the Corporation's prevailing norms
  • No other benefits, allowances or special pay will be provided apart from the consolidated remuneration mentioned above

Age Limit (as on 01/01/2026)

  • Maximum Age: 67 years as on 01/01/2026
  • Age Relaxation: Age relaxation may be considered for deserving candidates at the discretion of the management
  • The candidate must be an Indian national
  • Age proof must be submitted through HSC/10th standard certificate or equivalent examination certificate
  • Self-attested copy of age proof certificate must be attached with the application

Important Dates

Event Date
Advertisement Number MPP&R-07/2025-26
Notification Date 30/01/2026
Application Start Date 30/01/2026
Last Date for Submission of Application 27/02/2026 (5:00 PM)
Age Calculation Date 01/01/2026
Mode of Interview Personal Interview (Date to be notified)

Selection Process

  • Selection will be made through personal interview by a Selection Committee
  • Candidates are required to produce original certificates towards proof of age, experience, qualification and marks from HSC/10th onwards for the purpose of verification prior to personal interview
  • Medical registration certificate must be produced in original at the time of interview
  • Retired doctors must furnish Last Pay Certificate (LPC) from the last Hospital/Organisation from which they have been retired
  • Filling-up of vacancies is solely at the discretion of the Management based on suitability of candidates
  • No claim will arise for appointment, if vacancies are not filled due to un-suitability/insufficient number of candidates
  • Final selection of the candidates shall be subject to medical fitness
  • Appointment of selected candidates will be subject to having sound health and being physically and mentally fit in the Pre-Employment Medical Examination to be conducted as per the norms and standards of Medical Fitness

General Information/Instructions

  • Odisha Power Transmission Corporation Ltd. (OPTCL) is one of the largest State owned Power Utilities in the country, engaged in the business of Transmission of electricity in the State
  • The Corporation operates a well-equipped dispensary, known as 'Power Hospital' located at OPTCL Colony, Bhoinagar, Bhubaneswar
  • The Power Hospital provides health care services to the employees of OPTCL as well as employees of OHPC, GRIDCO and the community in and around the OPTCL colony including the underprivileged at a very affordable cost
  • The candidate should be free from any vigilance/criminal cases and must have a good character
  • Candidates working in State/Central Government/PSUs/Autonomous Bodies of Government shall produce a "No Objection Certificate (NOC)" at the time of Personal Interview
  • While applying for the above post, the applicant shall ensure that she/he fulfills the eligibility and other norms as mentioned, as on the specified dates and the particulars furnished are correct in all respects
  • In case it is detected at any stage of recruitment/selection that a candidate does not fulfill the eligibility norms and/or that she/he has furnished any incorrect/false information or has suppressed any material fact(s), his/her candidature will automatically stand cancelled
  • If any of the above shortcoming(s) are detected even after appointment, services are liable to be terminated without any notice
  • OPTCL Management reserves the right to cancel the recruitment process or change any term and condition if need so arises, without issuing any further notice or assigning any reason thereof at any stage
  • Details of work experience shall be clearly mentioned and supported by relevant documentary evidence, failing which the application may be liable to be rejected
  • Applications without supporting documents/incomplete/not fulfilling the prescribed criteria in any respect shall be rejected outright
  • This is a full time contractual appointment, hence the appointee shall not accept any other paid appointment or otherwise
  • Candidates are required to visit the OPTCL website www.optcl.co.in for any relevant information from time to time
  • For any guidance on filling up the Application and information regarding Advertisement and Application, the candidate may contact the Mobile Number: 9124153088 on all working days between 11 AM to 5 PM

Job Description & Responsibilities

  • Medical Officer shall be in charge of hospital administration and will be responsible for day to day functioning of the "Power Hospital" along with the duty of consultation/treatment of patients
  • Ensure timely procurement of medicines and other clinical items through coordination with the HR Department of OPTCL
  • Monitor procurement of new equipment for Power Hospital and make recommendations as and when required to augment healthcare facilities
  • Assignment and coordination of duties of hospital staff, supervision of nursing and paramedical staff during clinical duties, maintenance of discipline and duty rosters
  • Ensuring adherence to standard treatment protocols and hospital guidelines
  • Convene the Medical Board as and when required for comprehensive medical examination, disability assessment and verification for other service related benefits or any other medical opinion sought for by the organization
  • Responsible to conduct health camps and awareness activities in consultation with HR Department
  • Issue medical certificates, fitness reports as and when required
  • Ensure proper up keeping and maintenance of existing facilities in "Power Hospital"
  • Any other assignment entrusted from time to time

Tenure, Terms & Conditions

  • Initial Contract Period: The tenure of contract is initially for a period of 1 year, which is extendable on yearly basis up to 3 years based on performance and requirement of the organisation
  • Leave Entitlement: 10 days leave in a calendar year. In case of engagement during mid of the calendar year, leave will be reduced proportionately
  • Termination by Corporation: The engagement can be terminated at any time by the Corporation giving one month notice, if performance found to be unsatisfactory
  • In cases of any misconduct including but not limited to misappropriation, negligence or causing loss to the Corporation, engagement can be terminated without any prior notice
  • Resignation by Medical Officer: Medical Officer shall give one month notice/payment in lieu of notice period if intending to resign from the services of corporation
  • This is a full time contractual appointment, hence the appointee shall not accept any other paid appointment or otherwise
  • Mobile SIM facility will be provided apart from salary
  • Travelling Allowance for approved tours will be provided in line with the Corporation's prevailing norms
  • Final selection shall be subject to medical fitness
  • Appointment will be subject to having sound health and being physically and mentally fit in the Pre-Employment Medical Examination

How to Apply

  • Candidates are requested to download the application form from OPTCL website - www.optcl.co.in
  • The application form is available as Annexure-I in the official notification
  • The application superscribed as "Application for the post of Medical Officer" should be sent along with Bio-data
  • Attach attested recent passport size photograph to the application form
  • Include attested copies of certificates in support of date of birth, qualification and experience
  • Send the complete application to: GM (HRD) MPPR, 6th floor, OPTCL Tech Tower, Janpath, Saheed Nagar, Bhubaneswar-751007
  • Applications must reach before 27/02/2026 (5:00 PM)
  • Applications without supporting documents/incomplete/not fulfilling the prescribed criteria in any respect shall be rejected outright
  • The application format requires the following information:
    • Advertisement Number
    • Post applied for
    • Name of the candidate (In Capital letters)
    • Father's/Husband's Name
    • Marital Status
    • Date of Birth (As recorded in HSC or equivalent exam)
    • Communication Address and Permanent Address
    • Mobile No./Landline No. and E-Mail id
    • Educational Qualification (MBBS onwards) with self-attested copy of Certificates
    • Details of experience with self-attested copy of experience certificates
    • Declaration regarding Civil/Criminal/Vigilance cases or disciplinary proceedings
    • Recent colour Passport Size Photograph to be affixed
    • Signature of the Candidate with Date and Place
  • Candidate must provide details of educational qualifications from MBBS onwards including Name of Board/University/Institute, Duration of course, Year of Passing, and Area of Specialization
  • Experience details must include Name of Organization, Post Held, Period (From-To), Basic Salary, and Details of supporting documents
  • A solemn declaration must be signed stating that all information provided is true and correct to the best of knowledge and belief
  • For any guidance on filling up the Application and information regarding Advertisement, contact Mobile Number: 9124153088 on all working days between 11 AM to 5 PM
